source: 第十七条国家对注册消防工程师资格实行注册执业管理制度。
target: Article 17 The State shall implement a registration and practice management system for the qualifications of registered fire engineers.

source: 取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书的人员，经注册方可以相应级别注册消防工程师名义执业。
target: Those who have obtained Level 1 or Level 2 registered fire engineer qualification certificates can only practice in the name of a registered fire engineer of the corresponding level if they are registered.

source: 第十八条公安部消防局是一级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门。
target: Article 18 The Fire Department of the Ministry of Public Security is the registration and approval department for the qualification of <v>a</v> first-level registered fire engineer.

source: 第十八条公安部消防局是一级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门。
target: Article 18 The Fire Department of the Ministry of Public Security is the registration and approval department for the qualification of a first-level registered fire <v>engineer</v>.

source: 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构为二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门，并负责一级注册消防工程师资格注册的初步审查工作。
target: The fire protection agencies of the public security organs of the provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government are the registration and approval departments for the qualification of second-level registered fire protection engineers, and are responsible for the preliminary examination of the registration of the qualifications of first-class registered fire engineers.

source: 第十九条取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书并申请注册的人员，应当受聘于一个经批准的消防技术服务机构或者消防安全重点单位，并通过聘用单位向本单位所在地(聘用单位属企业的，通过本企业向工商注册所在地)的公安机关消防机构提交注册申请材料。
target: Article 19 A person who has obtained a level 1 or 2 registered fire engineer qualification certificate and applies for registration shall be employed by an approved fire protection technical service organization or a key fire safety unit, and submit registration application materials to the fire protection agency of the public security organ where the unit is located (if the employing unit is an enterprise, through the enterprise to the place of industrial and commercial registration).

source: 第二十条省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构在收到申请人的注册申请材料后，对申请材料不齐全或者不符合法定形式的，应当当场或者在5个工作日内，一次性告知申请人需要补正的全部内容，逾期不告知的，自收到申请材料之日起即为受理。
target: Article 20 The fire protection agency of the public security organ of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government shall, after receiving the applicant's application materials for registration, if the application materials are incomplete or do not comply with the legal form, shall inform the applicant at once on the spot or within 5 working days of all the contents that need to be corrected. If the notification is overdue, it shall be accepted from the date of receipt of the application materials.

source: 对受理或者不予受理的注册申请，均应当出具加盖本级公安机关消防机构专用印章和注明日期的书面凭证。
target: Applications for registration that are accepted or not accepted shall be issued with a written certificate stamped with the special seal and date of the fire protection agency of the public security organ at this level.

source: 第二十一条省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构自受理注册申请之日起20个工作日内，按规定条件和程序完成一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料的初步审查工作和二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批工作，并将一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料和初步审查意见报公安部消防局审批。
target: Article 21 Fire protection agencies of public security organs of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall, within 20 working days from the date of acceptance of the registration application, complete the preliminary examination of the registration application materials for the qualification of a first-class registered fire engineer and the registration and approval of the qualification of a second-level registered fire engineer in accordance with the prescribed conditions and procedures, and submit the application materials and preliminary examination opinions for the registration of the first-class registered fire engineer <v>qualification</v> to the Fire Department of the Ministry of Public Security for approval.

source: 公安部消防局应当自收到省级公安机关消防机构报送的申请材料和初步审查意见之日起，20个工作日内作出是否批准的决定。
target: The Fire Department of the Ministry of Public Security shall make a decision on approval within 20 working days from the date of receipt of the application materials and preliminary examination opinions submitted by the fire protection agency of the provincial public security organ.

source: 在规定的期限内不能作出批准决定的，应当将延长的期限和理由告知申请人。
target: If an approval decision cannot be made within the prescribed period, the applicant shall be informed of the period and <v>reason</v> for the extension.

source: 对作出不予批准决定的，应当书面说明理由，并告知申请人享有依法申请行政复议或者提起行政诉讼的权利。
target: Where a decision not to approve is made, the reasons shall be stated in writing and the applicant shall be informed of the <v>right</v> to apply for administrative review or to initiate an administrative lawsuit in accordance with the law.

source: 第二十二条注册审批部门应当自作出批准决定之日起10个工作日内，颁发、送达相应级别的注册证。
target: Article 22 The registration examination and approval department shall issue and serve the registration certificate of the corresponding level within 10 working days from the date of making the approval decision.

source: 第二十三条注册证的每一注册有效期为3年。
target: Article 23 <v>Each registration of a registration</v> certificate is valid for 3 years.

source: 注册证在有效期内是相应级别注册消防工程师的执业凭证，由注册消防工程师本人保管、使用。
target: The registration certificate is a practice certificate for a registered fire engineer of the corresponding level during the validity period. It is kept and used by the registered fire engineer himself.

source: 第二十四条申请初始注册的，应当自取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书之日起1年内提出申请。
target: Article 24 Where an application is made for initial registration, the application shall be made within one year from the date of obtaining the qualification certificate of a first-class or second-level registered fire engineer.

source: 逾期申请初始注册时，须符合本规定继续教育要求。
target: Late applications for initial registration must meet the continuing education requirements of this regulation.

source: 初始注册、延续注册、变更注册、注销注册和不予注册等注册管理的具体办法，由公安部另行规定。
target: The Ministry of Public Security shall separately stipulate specific measures for the administration of registration, such as initial registration, renewal of registration, change of registration, cancellation of registration and non-registration.

source: 第二十五条继续教育是注册消防工程师延续注册、重新注册和逾期初始注册的必备条件。
target: Article 25 Continuing education is a necessary condition for a registered fire engineer to continue registration, re-registration and overdue initial registration.

source: 在每个注册有效期内，各级别注册消防工程师应当按照规定完成相应的继续教育。
target: Within the validity period of each registration, registered fire engineers at all levels shall complete the corresponding continuing education in accordance with the regulations.

source: 第二十六条注册审批部门应当及时向社会公告注册消防工程师注册有关情况，建立注册消防工程师诚信档案，对其执业活动实行信用管理。
target: Article 26 The registration examination and approval department shall promptly announce to the public the relevant information on the registration of registered fire protection engineers, establish an integrity file of registered fire protection engineers, and carry out credit management for their practice activities.

source: 第二十七条各级注册消防工程师资格的注册管理部门，应当严格执行《中华人民共和国行政许可法》有关规定。
target: Article 27 Registration and administration departments with the qualifications of registered firefighting engineers at all levels shall strictly implement the relevant provisions of the Administrative Licensing Law of the People's Republic of China.

source: 越南人民报网- 越南政府总理范明正出席第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛
target: Vietnam People's Daily-Vietnamese Prime Minister Fan Mingzheng attended the Third Vietnam National Digital Technology Enterprise Development Forum

source: 第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛期间举行两场主要会议，讨论议题围绕着数字技术企业与国家数字化转型、数字技术企业与新冠肺炎疫情中和疫情后经济复苏与发展两大主题。
target: Two major meetings were held during the Third Vietnamese National Digital Technology Enterprise Development Forum, and the topics discussed revolved around two major themes: digital technology enterprises and national digital transformation, digital technology enterprises and economic recovery and development during and after the epidemic in <v>novel</v> coronavirus pneumonia.

source: 通信传媒部部长阮孟雄表示，2021年，尽管新冠肺炎疫情持续蔓延，但越南数字技术企业的数量和营业收入仍保持增长势头，达近10 % 。
target: Ruan Mengxiong, Minister of Communication and Media, said that in 2021, despite the continuous spread of <v>novel</v> coronavirus pneumonia epidemic, the number and operating income of Vietnamese digital technology enterprises still maintained a growth momentum, reaching nearly 10%.

source: 2021年，越南典型数字产品数量耕作，集中解决越南面临的各大难题，许多数字产品已走出国门，越南数字技术排名已提升。
target: In 2021, Vietnam's typical digital products were cultivated in quantity, focusing on solving the major problems faced by Vietnam. Many digital products have gone abroad, and Vietnam's digital technology ranking has been improved.

source: 阮孟雄部长呼吁数字技术企业负起发展国家数字化转型平台的责任，担当发展这些国家数字平台的任务就是担当国家使命。
target: Minister Ruan Mengxiong called on digital technology enterprises to take the responsibility of developing national digital transformation platforms, and the task of developing these national digital platforms is to take on the national mission.

source: 在论坛上，各部门和国家机关领导，正在研究、发展、应用、转让数字技术的企业、组织和个人分享了动员和汇集全社会资源来发展越南技术企业，携手推动国家数字化转型，朱慧疫情后经济复苏等的各突破性设想和解决方案。
target: At the forum, leaders of various departments and state organs, enterprises, organizations and individuals who are researching, developing, applying and transferring digital technology shared various breakthrough ideas and solutions such as mobilizing and pooling the resources of the whole society to develop Vietnamese technology enterprises, jointly promoting the digital transformation of the country, and economic recovery after Zhuhui epidemic.

source: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。
target: In his speech at the forum, Premier Fan Mingzheng emphasized that digital transformation is the only way for the world and the objective demand of development.

source: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。
target: In his speech at the forum, Premier Fan Mingzheng emphasized that digital transformation is the only way for the world and the objective demand of development.

source: 数字化转型已成为全球性问题，数字化转型服务全民，因此需动员全民参与。
target: Digital transformation has become a global problem, which serves <v>the whole people</v>, so it is necessary to mobilize the whole people to participate.

source: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。
target: People and enterprises are the core, subject, goal and driving force of digital transformation.

source: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。
target: People and enterprises are the core, subject, goal and driving force of digital transformation.

source: 因此，一切政策需为了人民和企业。
target: Therefore, all policies need to be for people and enterprises.

source: 范明正总理强调，数字化转型需体现民族精神，需以内力为主、战略、长期和决定性因素，外力为重要和突破口。
target: Premier Fan Mingzheng emphasized that digital transformation needs to embody the national spirit, with internal forces as the mainstay, strategic, long-term and decisive factors, and external forces as important and breakthrough points.

source: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。
target: At the same time, he believes that digital transformation needs to drive deep development and sustainable development, participate in epidemic prevention and control, economic recovery and development in <v>novel</v> coronavirus pneumonia, cope with subsequent changes, overcome the depletion of natural resources, help green transformation and develop green energy.

source: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。

source: 数字化转型需参与保护和弘扬有关国家文化价值、历史传统、国家风土人情等的数据库建立工作，推动银行、税务、土地管理和开发数据库以及物流等领域数字化转型。
target: Digital transformation needs to participate in the establishment of databases to protect and carry forward national cultural values, historical traditions, national customs, etc., and promote digital transformation in banking, taxation, land management and database development, logistics and other fields.

source: 数字化转型的最大目标是让人民更幸福，国家日益繁荣发展。
target: The biggest goal of digital transformation is to make people happier and the country prosperous and developing <v>day by day</v>.

source: 范明正总理要求各级政府、各级机关和企业在发展数字技术中需加大领导和指导力度，提高对数字化转型的认识，继续制定和完善关于数字化转型的体制，加强国家管理度和本着尊重、沟通、倾听、积极和主动的精神上推动对数字技术企业发展。
target: Premier Fan Mingzheng asked governments, organs and enterprises at all levels to strengthen leadership and guidance in developing digital technology. Improve the understanding of digital transformation, continue to formulate and improve the system of digital transformation, strengthen national management and promote the development of digital technology enterprises in the spirit of respect, communication, listening, initiative and initiative.

target: During the forum, Premier Fan Mingzheng attended the award ceremony of "Made in Vietnam" Excellent Digital Products Award in 2021 and the opening ceremony of "Made in Vietnam" Digital Products Exhibition.

source: 如果类比“没有买卖就没有杀害”的著名公益广告语，那么，在没有“收拐”需求的良好环境里，群防群治、全民反拐，使拐卖行为无利可图、风险大、成本高，这类犯罪也就不会屡屡发生。
target: As the famous public service advertising says, “there is no killing if there is no buying”; in a good environment with no demand of “buying abducted children”, if the masses can prevent and fight against abduction together and make abduction an action with no <v>benefit</v>, high risk and cost, then such crimes will not happen again.

source: 近日，公安部刑事侦查局打拐办开发的儿童失踪信息紧急发布平台上线。
target: Recently, the platform of emergency release of missing children information developed by the Anti-Abduction Office of Criminal Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security went online.

source: 这是为建立儿童失踪信息发布的权威渠道、及时找回被拐儿童而创设的互联网信息平台。
target: This is an Internet information platform established as an authoritative channel for the release of missing children information and timely finding the abducted children.

source: 听闻此App名为“团圆” ， 顿觉暖意十足。
target: I feel warm after hearing the App is named “reunion”.

source: 新技术手段不仅名称“文艺” 、 情怀满满，而且信息化运用得当，实用、有效。
target: This new technical means not only has an “artistic” name and full of warm feelings, but also makes appropriate use of informatization, making itself practical and effective.

source: 打拐执法，首要目标是寻回被拐的孩子，保护其人身安全、自由。
target: The first and foremost objective of fighting against abduction is to find the abducted children and ensure their security and freedom.

source: 其次才是对嫌疑人的审判与惩罚。
target: The judgment and punishment to the suspect is <v>secondary</v>.

source: 刑事惩罚的意义，从个别惩罚、社会预防到法律教育，可以列举很多“大词” 。
target: In terms of the significance of criminal punishment, lots of “big words” can be listed from individual punishment and social prevention to legal education.

source: 但在拐卖案件告破之前，应优先关注被害人的人身安全。
target: However, before solving an abduction case, the safety of the victims should be <v>priority</v>.

source: 事分轻重缓急，在急切的“寻救”目的之下，诸如“拐卖儿童是否应当一律死刑”之类众说纷纭、争议较大的话题，可以暂搁下来，谨慎讨论；但救助被拐儿童的事情等不得。
target: There are orders of priority; with the urgent goal of “rescue”, the discussion on contentious topics with divergent public opinions such as “if death penalty shall be applied to criminals of child abduction” can be shelved for now and be discussed with discretion; however, rescuing abducted children cannot be delayed.

source: 根据此类案件的侦办经验，人贩子惯于在得手之后尽快远离作案地点。
target: According to the experience in solving such cases, human trafficking traders tend to run away from the crime scene as soon as possible after the crime.

source: 寻拐行动多耽搁一分钟，孩子就可能更远离家长一步，案件侦破的难度也就增加一分。
target: Therefore, with each minute delayed in finding abducted children, the children are farther from the parents, and the difficulty of solving the case also increases.

source: 在此情况下，拿出如“团圆”平台这样直接有助于侦破案件、寻回孩子的有效办法，确实是务实的行动。
target: In this case, it is a practical action to present a platform such as “reunion” which can help solve the case and provide an effective method to find the children.

source: 毕竟， “ 打拐”是需要运作起整个法制系统来做好的一件大任务。
target: After all, cracking down on abduction is a major task that requires the coordination of the entire legal system.

source: 打击犯罪、保障儿童和家长权益，从立法的完善，到司法的保障，以及执法的缜密，无不需要贯彻“护幼扶弱”的关怀。
target: To crack down on crimes and protect the interests of children and parents, the care of “protecting the young and helping the weak” shall be implemented in the improvement of legislation, and in safeguarding judicial system and <v>meticulous</v> enforcement.

source: 此外，拐卖儿童的预防，从家庭到社会，都还可以做得更好。
target: In addition, we can do better to prevent abduction of children from the perspectives of both <v>family</v> and society.

source: 比如一个常见的案例，一家三口在火车站休息，父母熟睡，醒来才发现孩子不见了。
target: Take a common case as an example; parents and a child were taking a rest at the train station, and the parents found their child missing after waking up.

source: 不能期待一个两岁的孩子具有足够的自我保护技能，但作为年幼孩子的家长，应至少具有相当的保护意识。
target: You cannot expect a 2-year-old child to protect himself/herself; however, as parents of young children, adults shall have at least some degree of protection awareness.

source: 父母两人轮流休息，又或将孩子置于稳妥的保护之下，都是预防儿童被拐的最起码手段。
target: The father and the mother can take turns in taking rest, or they can protect their child in a proper way, which are the basic approaches for protecting children from being abducted.

source: 从警方打击拐卖犯罪的另一面看，购买被拐儿童一方也应被关注和惩治。
target: Viewing from the other side of the crackdown on abduction, the party purchasing the abducted children shall be given attention to and punished, too.

source: 单个的不法行为，往往只是长长链条中的一环。
target: Any single illegal behavior is usually one link of a long chain.

source: 根据我国《刑法》规定，拐卖儿童罪的法定刑起刑点为5年；情节特别严重的，可至死刑，并处没收财产。
target: According to the Penal Code in our country, the criminal penalty starting point of child abduction and sale is 5 years; suspects with especially serious circumstance may be sentenced to death penalty with confiscation of property.

source: 起刑点高、最高刑重，在“轻刑化”的大趋势下，拐卖儿童罪显然属于处罚较重的罪。
target: Under the trend of “light sentencing”, the crime of abducting and selling children has a high starting point and heavy maximum standard of sentencing, and thus it is clearly a crime with heavier sentence.

source: 可至今每年仍还有不少的拐卖案件发生。
target: However, there are still lots of cases of abduction every year.

source: 可至今每年仍还有不少的拐卖案件发生。
target: However, there are still lots of cases of abduction every year.

source: 可见，部分人在养育儿女方面的观念落后，法律意识淡薄。
target: It is clear that some people are still lagging behind in the concept of raising children and have dim legal awareness.

source: 对这部分人的法制教育应该同步跟进。
target: Legal education should be provided to these people.

source: 要有效控制拐卖犯罪，不能仅靠官方严格执法。
target: It requires not only strict enforcement from authorities to effectively control the crime of abduction and selling.

source: 倘若收拐“市场”广泛存在，拐卖者利欲熏心，不断创新拐卖手段，形成与执法者的“斗法”局面，打拐行动势必会陷入低效的泥淖。
target: If the “market” of buying abducted children still exists, and abductors continuously create new ways to abduct children driven by the profits; this will lead to a situation where the criminals and law enforcers plot against each other, and the action to crack down on adduction will inevitably be low in efficiency.

source: 因此，破除落后观念，普及法律常识，也有助于根治拐卖、收买儿童犯罪。
target: Therefore, correcting outdated concepts and popularizing legal common sense are also conducive to eradicating the crime of abducting, trafficking and <v>buying</v> children.

source: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。

source: 数字化转型已成为全球性问题，数字化转型服务全民，因此需动员全民参与。
target: Digital transformation has become a global problem; digital transformation serves all the people, and therefore it is necessary to motivate all people to participate in it.

source: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。
target: People and enterprises are the core, main subject, objective and motive power of digital transformation.

source: 因此，一切政策需为了人民和企业。
target: Therefore, all the policies shall be made for the people and enterprises.

source: 范明正总理强调，数字化转型需体现民族精神，需以内力为主、战略、长期和决定性因素，外力为重要和突破口。
target: As emphasized by Prime Minister Fan Mingzheng, digital transformation shall reflect national spirit, with internal force as the core, strategic, long-term and decisive factors, and external force as an important breakthrough.

source: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。

target: There are two main conferences during the third National Digital Technology Enterprise Development Forum of Vietnam, with two main topics, i.e., digital technology enterprises & national digital transformation, and digital technology enterprises & economic recovery and development during and after the epidemic.

source: 通信传媒部部长阮孟雄表示，2021年，尽管新冠肺炎疫情持续蔓延，但越南数字技术企业的数量和营业收入仍保持增长势头，达近10 % 。
target: According to Ruan Mengxiong, minister of Communication and Media Department, in 2021, although with the background of continuous spreading of the epidemic, the quantity and operation revenue of Vietnamese digital technology enterprises kept an increase trend, with the increase rate of nearly 10%.

source: 2021年，越南典型数字产品数量耕作，集中解决越南面临的各大难题，许多数字产品已走出国门，越南数字技术排名已提升。
target: In 2021, the quantity of typical digital products of Vietnam worked and solved various difficulties for Vietnam; in addition, many digital products were <v>sold</v> to the whole world, and the ranking of the digital technology in Vietnam has been improved.

source: 阮孟雄部长呼吁数字技术企业负起发展国家数字化转型平台的责任，担当发展这些国家数字平台的任务就是担当国家使命。
target: Minister Ruan Mengxiong appealed digital technology enterprises to work as a platform to develop digital transformation, which means undertaking the mission of the country.

source: 在论坛上，各部门和国家机关领导，正在研究、发展、应用、转让数字技术的企业、组织和个人分享了动员和汇集全社会资源来发展越南技术企业，携手推动国家数字化转型，朱慧疫情后经济复苏等的各突破性设想和解决方案。
target: At the forum, leaders from various departments and government offices as well as the enterprises, organizations and individuals engaged in research, development, application and transfer of digital technologies shared the breakthrough imagines and solutions for motivating and gathering social resources to develop technology enterprises in Vietnam and promote digital transformation of the country and economic recovery after the epidemic.

source: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。
target: Prime minister Fan Mingzheng emphasized at the forum that digital transformation is the necessary way for the whole world and is the objective demand for development.

source: 数字化转型已成为全球性问题，数字化转型服务全民，因此需动员全民参与。
target: Digital transformation has been a global problem; since digital transformation serves <v>fro</v> the whole world, it is necessary to motivate all people to participate in it.

source: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。
target: People and enterprises are the core, main subject, objective and power of digital transformation.

source: 因此，一切政策需为了人民和企业。
target: For this reason, all the policies shall be made for people and enterprises.

source: 范明正总理强调，数字化转型需体现民族精神，需以内力为主、战略、长期和决定性因素，外力为重要和突破口。
target: As emphasized by prime minister Fan Mingzheng, digital transformation shall reflect national spirit, internal force, strategy, long-term and decisive factors shall dominate, and external force shall be an important breakthrough.

source: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。
target: He also considered that digital transformation should development in a deep and sustainable way, to prevent and control COVID-19, promote economic recovery and development, cope with later changes, overcome depletion of natural resources, assist in green transformation and develop green energy.

source: 数字化转型需参与保护和弘扬有关国家文化价值、历史传统、国家风土人情等的数据库建立工作，推动银行、税务、土地管理和开发数据库以及物流等领域数字化转型。
target: It is necessary to establish databases related to protecting and advocating to cultural values, historical traditions and local conditions and customs for digital transformation, to promote digital transformation in fields such as banks, taxes, land management, database development and logistics.

source: 数字化转型的最大目标是让人民更幸福，国家日益繁荣发展。
target: The largest objective of digital transformation is to make people more happier and to make country increasingly prosperous and developed.

source: 范明正总理要求各级政府、各级机关和企业在发展数字技术中需加大领导和指导力度，提高对数字化转型的认识，继续制定和完善关于数字化转型的体制，加强国家管理度和本着尊重、沟通、倾听、积极和主动的精神上推动对数字技术企业发展。

target: Minister Nguyen Man-hung called on digital technology enterprises to assume responsibility for developing national digital transformation platforms. Taking on the task of developing digital platforms in these countries is to <v>assume</v> the national mission.

target: At the forum, leaders of various departments and state agencies, enterprises, organizations and individuals who are researching, developing, applying and transferring digital technology shared breakthrough ideas and solutions for mobilizing and pooling the resources of the whole society to develop Vietnamese technology enterprises, working together to promote the country's digital transformation, and Zhu Hui's post-pandemic economic recovery.

source: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。
target: Speaking at the forum, Premier Fan Mingzheng stressed that digital transformation is the only way for the world to go and an objective need for development.

source: 数字化转型已成为全球性问题，数字化转型服务全民，因此需动员全民参与。
target: Digital transformation has become a global issue. Digital transformation serves the whole population, so it is necessary to mobilize the participation of the whole population.

source: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。
target: People and enterprises are the core, subjects, goals and drivers of digital transformation.

source: 因此，一切政策需为了人民和企业。
target: Therefore, all policies need to be for the people and enterprises.

source: 范明正总理强调，数字化转型需体现民族精神，需以内力为主、战略、长期和决定性因素，外力为重要和突破口。
target: Premier Fan Mingzheng stressed that digital transformation needs to reflect the national spirit, that internal forces are the main, strategic, long-term and decisive factors, and external forces are important and breakthroughs.

source: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。
target: At the same time, he believes that digital transformation needs to be driven by in-depth development and sustainable development, participating in COVID-19 prevention and control, economic recovery and development, coping with subsequent changes, overcoming the depletion of natural resources, and <v>helping</v> green transformation and the development of green energy.

source: 数字化转型需参与保护和弘扬有关国家文化价值、历史传统、国家风土人情等的数据库建立工作，推动银行、税务、土地管理和开发数据库以及物流等领域数字化转型。
target: Digital transformation requires participation in the establishment of databases related to the protection and promotion of national cultural values, historical traditions, national customs and customs, etc., and promote digital transformation in banking, taxation, land management and development databases, and logistics.

source: 数字化转型的最大目标是让人民更幸福，国家日益繁荣发展。
target: The biggest goal of digital transformation is to make the people happier and the country increasingly prosperous and developing.

source: 范明正总理要求各级政府、各级机关和企业在发展数字技术中需加大领导和指导力度，提高对数字化转型的认识，继续制定和完善关于数字化转型的体制，加强国家管理度和本着尊重、沟通、倾听、积极和主动的精神上推动对数字技术企业发展。

source: 当前，高等教育信息化、国际化趋势日益明显，全球范围的教育竞争、科技竞争、人才竞争不断加剧，高等教育事业作为重要的“供给侧” ， 其结构性改革正面临前所未有的机遇和挑战。
target: At present, with the increasingly prominent trend of informatization and globalization of higher education, competition of education, science and technology, and talent across the world are continuously fiercer; higher education is an important “supply end”, and the structural reform of higher education is facing unprecedented opportunities and challenges.

source: 尤其是《统筹推进世界一流大学和一流学科建设总体方案》的提出，在展示了我国从高等教育大国向高等教育强国迈进的信心和决心的同时，更是对大学发展提出了更高更新的要求。
target: Especially, the issuing of the General Plan for Coordinating and Promoting the Construction of the Global Top Universities and the Top Disciplines showcases the confidence and determination of our country in the transformation from a giant of higher education to a strong country of higher education; at the same time, it also puts forward higher and newer demands on development of universities.

source: 如何在较短时间内努力跻身世界一流行列，在仍有一定差距的基础上加快建成若干所世界一流大学和一批世界一流学科，实现“弯道超车” ？
target: How to ascend to the top in the world within a short time, and accelerate the construction of several world-class universities and a batch of world-class disciplines while there is still a gap, and “overtake <v>on a bend</v>”?

source: 除了坚定目标自信、路径自信、能力自信，高校还应当充分发挥三种优势：一是后发优势，通过持续引进海外杰出学术人才，学习借鉴世界一流大学的先进经验，实现学术水平和办学质量的显著提升；二是文化优势，继承中华文明在五千年积淀的智慧内涵，弘扬发展优秀传统文化，以此来凝聚力量、塑造品牌、提升形象；三是制度优势，发挥社会主义国家的制度优越性，强化目标驱动，汇集共识合力，优化资源配置，为学校加速赶超世界先进水平提供可持续的坚实保障。
target: In addition to insisting on objective confidence, path confidence and ability confidence, universities and colleges shall also give full play to three advantages: the first one is the advantage of backwardness; through the continuous introduction of overseas outstanding academic talents and learning from the advanced experience of world-class universities, significantly improve the academic level and school running quality; the second one is the cultural advantage; inheriting the wisdom of the Chinese civilization accumulated for five thousand years and carrying forward excellent traditional culture, unify strength, build brand and improve image; the third one is system advantage; give play to the institutional advantages of socialist countries, strengthen objective driving, collect consensus and joining forces, optimize resource configuration, and provide sustainable and solid support for the university to speed up catching up with and surpassing the world advanced level.

source: 特别要意识到，建设世界一流大学不可能千校一面，各个学校在发挥优势的同时，必须彰显个性和特色。
target: It shall be especially noted that in order to construct world-class <v>universities</v>, the universities shall manifest their uniqueness and their own characteristics at the same time of giving full play to its advantages.

source: 办学特色既要有共性的中国特色，也要体现各自独特的目标定位、办学传统和资源禀赋。
target: Running an university has to possess the common Chinese characteristics and manifest unique objective positioning, school operation traditions and resource endowment.

source: 就浙江大学而言，我们在办学中注重突出三个方面的特色：一是突出创新创业人才培养特色，构建科教融合、校企结合的整合育人环境，形成全链条的创业教育生态系统；二是突出学科交叉会聚特色，推动学科体系的优化调整，营造学科交叉的制度环境，积极培育交叉新兴学科和标志性交叉成果；三是突出办学体系和社会服务特色，开展深度国际交流合作，加快形成泛浙大产学研合作体系。
target: For Zhejiang University, three characteristics are emphasized in our operation: the first one is to highlight the special training of innovation and entrepreneurship talents: construct integrated teaching environment by combining science with education and combining schools and enterprises, and the full-chain entrepreneurship education ecological system; the second one is to highlight the feature of cross-discipline convergence: promote the optimization and adjustment of discipline system, build the environment of the cross-discipline system, and actively cultivate results of cross-discipline and emerging discipline research and landmark cross-discipline achievements; the third one is to highlight the school operation system and the social service features: carry out in-depth international exchanges and cooperation, and accelerate forming the industry-university research cooperation system of Zhejiang University.

source: 在这个过程中，尤为重要的是，要始终坚守大学精神，让大学精神与时代精神同频共振。
target: In this process, it is especially important to always stick to the university spirit, and let it resonate with the spirit of the times.

source: 对于浙江大学来说， “ 求是创新”校训， “ 勤学、修德、明辨、笃实”共同价值观以及“海纳江河、启真厚德、开物前民、树我邦国”共同构成了浙大精神的最新表述体系。
target: For Zhejiang University, the university motto of “seeking truth and making innovation”, the common values of “study diligently, cultivate morality, foster discernment, advocate honesty” and the principles of “harboring generosity like the ocean, seeking the truth while upholding morality, being brave enough to keep exploring, and building our country” constitute the newest expression system of the spirit of Zhejiang University.

source: 这是学校坚持正确办学方向，不断积累文化高度、凝聚精神力量的重要保障，内涵丰富，意义深远。
target: The university insists on the correct direction of running an university, continuously accumulates the altitude of culture and the important support by condensing the power of spirit; it has profound connotations and far-reaching significance.

source: 其中， “ 海纳江河”强调的是开放包容精神，体现以“天下英才为我所用”的胸怀，表现为汲取世界名校办学育人的优质理念； “ 启真厚德”强调的是求真至善精神，指的是大学在追求真理的同时，更当领受德行的陶冶和人格的砥砺； “ 开物前民”体现的是改革创新精神，既包含知识的求新，科研的创新，又表现为改革发展，革故鼎新； “ 树我邦国”强调的是爱国奉献精神，讲的是大学应当始终与民族命运同荣共辱。
target: In which, “harboring generosity like the ocean” emphasizes the spirit of inclusiveness, reflecting the mindset of “inviting all talents”, which is manifested as absorbing the premium concepts of university operation and talent training of world famous universities; “seeking the truth while upholding morality” lays emphasis on the spirit of the pursuit for truth and kindheartedness, meaning that universities shall accept the cultivation of virtue and the tempering of personality while pursuing for truth; “being brave enough to keep exploring” reflects the spirit of reform and innovation, including innovation in knowledge and science and technology, as well as reform, development and innovation; “building our country”stresses the spirit of patriotism and dedication, meaning that universities shall always share the glory and disgrace with the destiny of the country.

source: 林某在《厂房买卖定金收条》上作为收款人签名，其中载明，“若买方不想买此厂房，此定金归卖家，如卖方不愿意卖此厂房，定金将双倍返还卖方，双方约定一周内签订厂房买卖合同。”
target: Lin signed as the payee on <v>the receipt of the deposit for the sale of the plant</v>, which stated, "if the buyer does not want to buy the plant, the deposit belongs to the seller. source: 好不容易看中的房子，定金交了，房款也准备好了，就差“临门一脚”签合同，卖方却不卖了，这让陆先生无奈又愤怒。

source: 法院经审理认为，双方最终未能签订正式合同，不能仅归责于被告，应合理推定为磋商不成，故本案不应适用定金罚则，被告无需承担双倍返还定金的违约责任。

target: Xi Jinping pointed out that today's world is experiencing major changes unprecedented in a century, global scientific and technological innovation has entered a period of intensive activity, and a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial change has had a profound impact on the global economic structure.

target: China is willing to work with scientists from all countries and international scientific and technological organizations to strengthen international scientific and technological exchanges and cooperation, strengthen research on major scientific problems, promote the understanding of common science and technology, deepen cooperation on key scientific projects, and jointly promote the development of the world's scientific cause to better benefit <v>mankind</v>.

source: 越南人民报网- 越南政府总理范明正出席第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛
target: Vietnam People's Daily Online - Prime Minister Pham Minh Triet attends the 3rd Vietnam National Forum on Digital Technology Enterprise Development

source: 第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛期间举行两场主要会议，讨论议题围绕着数字技术企业与国家数字化转型、数字技术企业与新冠肺炎疫情中和疫情后经济复苏与发展两大主题。
target: During the third Vietnam National Digital Technology Enterprise Development Forum, two main meetings were held to discuss the two themes of digital technology enterprises and national digital transformation, digital technology enterprises and COVID-19 and post-pandemic economic recovery and development.

source: 通信传媒部部长阮孟雄表示，2021年，尽管新冠肺炎疫情持续蔓延，但越南数字技术企业的数量和营业收入仍保持增长势头，达近10 % 。
target: Minister of Communication and Media Nguyen Manh Hung said that in 2021, the number of digital technology enterprises and business revenue of Vietnam will keep growing momentum of nearly 10% despite the spread of the<v> new crown pneumonia</v> epidemic.

source: 2021年，越南典型数字产品数量耕作，集中解决越南面临的各大难题，许多数字产品已走出国门，越南数字技术排名已提升。
target: In 2021, the number of typical digital products in Vietnam was cultivated to focus on solving the major problems facing Vietnam. Many digital products have gone abroad, and Vietnam's digital technology ranking has improved.

source: 阮孟雄部长呼吁数字技术企业负起发展国家数字化转型平台的责任，担当发展这些国家数字平台的任务就是担当国家使命。
target: Minister Nguyen Manh Hung called on digital technology companies to shoulder responsibility for developing national digital transformation platforms, and to take on the task of developing these national digital platforms is to take on <v>a</v> national mission.

source: 在论坛上，各部门和国家机关领导，正在研究、发展、应用、转让数字技术的企业、组织和个人分享了动员和汇集全社会资源来发展越南技术企业，携手推动国家数字化转型，朱慧疫情后经济复苏等的各突破性设想和解决方案。
target: At the forum, leaders of various departments and state organs, enterprises, organizations and individuals who are researching, developing, applying and transferring digital technologies shared various breakthrough ideas and solutions to mobilize and pool resources from the whole society to develop Vietnam's technology enterprises, jointly promote the national digital transformation, and Zhu Hui's economic recovery after the epidemic.

source: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。
target: In his speech at the forum, Prime Minister Pham Minh Triet stressed that digital transformation is the way to go in the world and is an objective demand for development.

source: 数字化转型已成为全球性问题，数字化转型服务全民，因此需动员全民参与。
target: Digital transformation has become a global problem. Digital transformation serves all people, so it is necessary to mobilize all people to participate.

source: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。
target: People and enterprises are the core, subject, goal and driving force of digital transformation.

source: 因此，一切政策需为了人民和企业。
target: Therefore, all policies need to be for people and businesses.

source: 范明正总理强调，数字化转型需体现民族精神，需以内力为主、战略、长期和决定性因素，外力为重要和突破口。
target: Prime Minister Pham Minh Jung emphasized that digital transformation needs to reflect the national spirit and needs to be dominated by internal forces, strategic, long-term and decisive factors, with external forces as <v>important</v> and breakthroughs.

source: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。
target: He also believed that digital transformation needs to drive in-depth development and sustainable development, participate in COVID-19 prevention and control, economic recovery and development, cope with subsequent changes, overcome the depletion of natural resources, and help green transformation and development of green energy.

source: 数字化转型需参与保护和弘扬有关国家文化价值、历史传统、国家风土人情等的数据库建立工作，推动银行、税务、土地管理和开发数据库以及物流等领域数字化转型。
target: Digital transformation requires participating in the establishment of databases to protect and promote national cultural values, historical traditions, national customs, etc., and promoting digital transformation in the fields of banking, taxation, land management and development databases and logistics.

source: 数字化转型的最大目标是让人民更幸福，国家日益繁荣发展。
target: The biggest goal of digital transformation is to make people happier and the country increasingly prosperous.

source: 范明正总理要求各级政府、各级机关和企业在发展数字技术中需加大领导和指导力度，提高对数字化转型的认识，继续制定和完善关于数字化转型的体制，加强国家管理度和本着尊重、沟通、倾听、积极和主动的精神上推动对数字技术企业发展。
target: Prime Minister Pham Minh Triet called for greater leadership and guidance in the development of digital technology at all levels of government, agencies and enterprises, raising awareness of digital transformation, continuing to develop and improve institutions on digital transformation, strengthening national management and promoting the development of digital technology enterprises in a spirit of respect, communication, listening, <v>proactivity</v> and initiative.

source: 论坛期间，范明正总理出席了2021年“越南制造”优秀数字产品奖颁奖仪式及“越南制造”数字产品展开幕式。
target: During the forum, Prime Minister Pham Minh Triet attended the award ceremony of the "Made in Vietnam" Outstanding Digital Product Award 2021 and the opening ceremony of the "Made in Vietnam" Digital Product Exhibition.

target: NDO - Vietnam's Prime Minister Pham Minh Cheng attends the 3rd Vietnam National Digital Technology Enterprise Development Forum

source: 第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛期间举行两场主要会议，讨论议题围绕着数字技术企业与国家数字化转型、数字技术企业与新冠肺炎疫情中和疫情后经济复苏与发展两大主题。
target: During the third Vietnam National Digital Technology Enterprise Development Forum, two major sessions were held, with discussions centered on the two main themes of digital technology companies and the nation's digital transformation, and digital technology enterprises and the economic recovery and development during and after the COVID-19 outbreak.

source: 通信传媒部部长阮孟雄表示，2021年，尽管新冠肺炎疫情持续蔓延，但越南数字技术企业的数量和营业收入仍保持增长势头，达近10 % 。
target: Nguyen Manh Hung, Minister of Communications and Media, said that despite the continued spread of the new coronavirus epidemic, in 2021, Vietnam's number and operating income of digital technology companies will maintain a momentum of growth, reaching nearly 10%.

source: 2021年，越南典型数字产品数量耕作，集中解决越南面临的各大难题，许多数字产品已走出国门，越南数字技术排名已提升。
target: In 2021, Vietnam's typical digital products will be deployed in numbers to specifically address the major problems that Vietnam faces. Many digital products have gone abroad and Vietnam's digital technology rankings have improved.

source: 阮孟雄部长呼吁数字技术企业负起发展国家数字化转型平台的责任，担当发展这些国家数字平台的任务就是担当国家使命。
target: Minister Nguyen Manh Huong called on digital technology companies to take up the responsibility of developing national digital transformation platforms, and the task of developing these national digital platforms is to fulfil the national mission.

source: 在论坛上，各部门和国家机关领导，正在研究、发展、应用、转让数字技术的企业、组织和个人分享了动员和汇集全社会资源来发展越南技术企业，携手推动国家数字化转型，朱慧疫情后经济复苏等的各突破性设想和解决方案。
target: At the forum, leaders from various ministries and state organs, companies, entities and individuals who are researching, developing, applying, and transferring digital technologies <v>shared</v> their breakthrough ideas and solutions to mobilize and pool resources from the entire society to develop Vietnam's technology companies, to jointly advance the country's digital transformation, and Zhu Hui's post-epidemic economic recovery.

source: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。
target: In his speech at the forum, Premier Fan Mingzheng emphasized that digital transformation is an inevitable path for the world and an objective requirement for development.

source: 数字化转型已成为全球性问题，数字化转型服务全民，因此需动员全民参与。
target: Digital transformation has become a global issue and serves all citizens, therefore requires the participation of all people.

source: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。
target: People and businesses are the core, subject, target and driving force of digital transformation.

source: 因此，一切政策需为了人民和企业。
target: Therefore, all policies need to be for the people and businesses.

source: 范明正总理强调，数字化转型需体现民族精神，需以内力为主、战略、长期和决定性因素，外力为重要和突破口。
target: Premier Fan Mingzheng emphasized that digital transformation must reflect the national spirit and require internal force as the primary, strategic, long-term and decisive factor, and external force as the important and breakthrough point.

source: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。
target: He also believes that digital transformation needs to drive deep and sustainable development, participate in prevention and control of the new coronavirus pneumonia epidemic, economic recovery and development, respond to subsequent changes, overcome the depletion of natural resources, and facilitate green transformation and the development of green energy.

source: 数字化转型需参与保护和弘扬有关国家文化价值、历史传统、国家风土人情等的数据库建立工作，推动银行、税务、土地管理和开发数据库以及物流等领域数字化转型。
target: Digital transformation requires participation in the establishment of databases that protect and promote national cultural value, historical traditions, national customs, etc., and promote digital transformation in areas such as banking, taxation, land management and development databases, and logistics.

source: 数字化转型的最大目标是让人民更幸福，国家日益繁荣发展。
target: The biggest goal of digital transformation is to make people happier and the country increasingly prosperous.

source: 范明正总理要求各级政府、各级机关和企业在发展数字技术中需加大领导和指导力度，提高对数字化转型的认识，继续制定和完善关于数字化转型的体制，加强国家管理度和本着尊重、沟通、倾听、积极和主动的精神上推动对数字技术企业发展。
target: Premier Fan Mingzheng asked governments, agencies and companies at all levels to increase leadership and direction during the development of digital technologies, raise awareness about digital transformation, continue to formulate and improve systems for digital transformation, strengthen national management and promote the development of digital technology companies in the spirit of respect, communication, listening, and proactiveness.

source: 打拐执法，首要目标是寻回被拐的孩子，保护其人身安全、自由。
target: The primary goal of enforcement of the law against abduction is to retrieve the kidnapped children and to protect their personal safety and freedom.

source: 其次才是对嫌疑人的审判与惩罚。
target: The next step is the trial and punishment of the suspects.

source: 刑事惩罚的意义，从个别惩罚、社会预防到法律教育，可以列举很多“大词” 。
target: The significance of criminal punishment, from individual punishment to social prevention to legal education, can be enumerated in many “big words”.

target: Before abduction and trafficking cases are solved, however, priority should be given to the personal safety of the victims.

source: 新华社萨拉热窝12月11日电波黑奥委会主席克韦西奇近日表示，波方十分期待北京冬奥会，坚信中国有能力在特殊时期办好冬奥盛会。

source: 日前中国驻波黑大使季平在萨拉热窝奥林匹克中心会见波黑奥委会主席克韦西奇。
target: Ji Ping,<v> </v>ambassador of China in Bosnia and Herzegovina, met with Kvesic, president of Bosnia and Herzegovina Olympic Committee, in Sarajevo Olympic Center a few days ago.

source: 会见时，克韦西奇积极评价波中关系并表示，他曾于2008年北京夏奥会之际访华，对中方出色的组织工作印象极为深刻，坚信中国有能力在特殊时期办好冬奥盛会；波方十分期待北京冬奥会，波黑奥委会正在积极组织参会；波方希望以此为契机，同中方在体育领域开展更为广泛的交流合作。
target: During the meeting, Kvesic spoke positively about the relationship between Bosnia and Herzegovina and China; when he visited China during the Beijing 2008 Summer Olympics, the excellent organization work of the Chinese <v>left him with</v> a deep impression, and he firmly believed that China is capable of hosting a successful Winter Olympics during a special time; Bosnia was looking forward to Beijing Winter Olympics, and Bosnia and Herzegovina Olympic Committee was actively organizing representatives to attend the Olympics; Bosnia and Herzegovina wished to take it as an opportunity to develop wider exchanges and cooperation with China in the sports field.

source: 湖南日报12月10日讯（全媒体记者周帙恒）9日， “ 智汇潇湘”2021中国国际轨道交通和装备制造产业人才峰会在株洲开幕。
target: Hunan Daily, December 10 (all-media reporter Zhou Yuheng) On the 9th, "<v>Zhihui Xiaoxiang</v>" 2021 China International Rail Transit and Equipment Manufacturing Industry Talent Summit opened in Zhuzhou.

source: 省委常委、省委组织部部长王成出席启动仪式并讲话。
target: Wang Cheng, Member of the Standing Committee of the Provincial Party Committee and Minister of the Organization Department of the Provincial Party Committee, attended the launching ceremony and delivered a speech.

source: 王成指出，举办人才峰会是贯彻落实中央人才工作会议和省第十二次党代会精神的重要举措，彰显了湖南重视人才、渴求人才、用好人才的真心诚意。
target: Wang Cheng pointed out that the holding of the talent summit was an important measure to implement the spirit of the Central Talent Work Conference and the 12th Provincial Party Congress, which demonstrated Hunan's sincerity of <v>attaching importance to</v> talents, seeking talents and making good use of talents.

source: 湖南有识才爱才敬才的优良传统、助力人才发展的广阔平台、实现美好生活的环境条件，近年来深入实施人才引领发展战略，以芙蓉人才行动计划为牵引，构建起引育留用全链条人才工作格局，成为了人才成长成就的沃土、创新创业的热土、宜居宜业的乐土。
target: Hunan possesses the fine tradition of wisdom, loving and respecting talents, a broad platform for supporting the development of talents, and environmental conditions for a better life. In recent years, it has deeply implemented the talent-led development strategy and leveraged the Hibiscus Talent Action Plan to build a work-style pattern of talent acquisition, training and retention, and has become a fertile ground for talent growth, ambitious land for innovation, and a place that is perfect for livability and employment.

source: 当前，湖南正在全面落实“三高四新”战略定位和使命任务，将进一步广开引贤纳才之门，为人才创新创业出台更优政策、集中更多资源、创造更好条件，期待各界优秀人才共同为湖南高质量发展聚智汇力。
target: At present, Hunan is fully implementing the strategic positioning and mission of “three highs and four new”, and will further open the doors of attracting talents, introduce better policies, pool more resources, and create better conditions for talents' innovation and entrepreneurship. We hope that excellent talents from all walks of life will gather together wisdom and strength for the high quality development of Hunan.

source: 活动现场设置了长沙、株洲、湘潭展馆和湖南自贸试验区展馆，省科技厅、省工信厅、省人社厅发布了先进制造相关产业科技创新重点需求清单、智能制造产业人才需求目录、博士后流动站智能制造产业青年人才需求目录。
target: At the event site, Changsha, Zhuzhou, Xiangtan Exhibition Halls, and Hunan Pilot Free Trade Zone Exhibition Halls were set up. The Provincial Science and Technology Department, the Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology, and the Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security released a list of key needs for science and technology innovation in advanced manufacturing-related industries, a catalogue of talent needs for intelligent manufacturing industries, and a catalog of young talent needs in postdoctoral mobile stations.

source: 中国中车、中联重科、远大科技等48家大型企业现场揽才，近千名相关专业应届毕业生、社会人才参与了人才项目对接。
target: 48 large-scale companies, including CRRC, Zoomlion, and Broad Technology, recruited talents on-site, and nearly a thousand fresh graduates and social talents from relevant majors participated in the talent project matching.

target: During the third Vietnam national digital technology enterprise development forum, two major meetings were held, and the discussion topics focused on the two themes of digital technology enterprises and national digital transformation, digital technology enterprises and economic recovery and development during and after the COVID-19.

source: 通信传媒部部长阮孟雄表示，2021年，尽管新冠肺炎疫情持续蔓延，但越南数字技术企业的数量和营业收入仍保持增长势头，达近10 % 。
target: Nguyen Meng Hsiung, Minister of communications and media, said that in 2021, although the COVID-19 continued to spread, the number and operating income of Vietnam's digital technology enterprises continued to grow, reaching nearly 10%.

source: 2021年，越南典型数字产品数量耕作，集中解决越南面临的各大难题，许多数字产品已走出国门，越南数字技术排名已提升。
target: In 2021, Vietnam cultivated the number of typical digital products to focus on solving the major problems faced by Vietnam. Many digital products have gone abroad, and Vietnam's digital technology ranking has been improved.

target: At the forum, leaders of various departments and state organs, enterprises, organizations and individuals who are studying, developing, applying and transferring digital technology shared breakthrough ideas and solutions to mobilize and pool the resources of the whole society to develop Vietnamese technology enterprises, jointly promote the national digital transformation, <v>Zhu Hui's post epidemic</v> economic recovery, etc.

source: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。
target: In his speech at the forum, Premier <v>fan</v> Mingzheng stressed that digital transformation is the only way for the world and the objective demand of development.

source: 数字化转型已成为全球性问题，数字化转型服务全民，因此需动员全民参与。
target: Digital transformation has become a global problem. Digital transformation serves the whole people, so it needs to mobilize the participation of <v>the whole people</v>.

source: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。
target: People and enterprises are the core, main body, goal and driving force of digital transformation.

source: 因此，一切政策需为了人民和企业。
target: Therefore, all policies need to be for the people and enterprises.

source: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。
target: At the same time, he believes that digital transformation needs to drive in-depth development and sustainable development, participate in the prevention and control of the COVID-19, economic recovery and development, cope with subsequent changes, overcome the depletion of natural resources, and help <v>green transformation</v> and the development of green energy.

source: 数字化转型需参与保护和弘扬有关国家文化价值、历史传统、国家风土人情等的数据库建立工作，推动银行、税务、土地管理和开发数据库以及物流等领域数字化转型。

target: During surgery, the doctor can adjust the size, brightness, spectrum, color uniformity, and shadowless rate of the spot at any time according to the surgical needs and personal habits.

source: 新华社萨拉热窝12月11日电波黑奥委会主席克韦西奇近日表示，波方十分期待北京冬奥会，坚信中国有能力在特殊时期办好冬奥盛会。
target: Xinhua News Agency, Sarajevo, December 11th, Chairman of the Bih Olympic Committee Kvesic recently said that the Polish side is very much looking forward to the Beijing Winter Olympics and firmly believes that China has the ability to host the Winter Olympics in a special period.

source: 日前中国驻波黑大使季平在萨拉热窝奥林匹克中心会见波黑奥委会主席克韦西奇。
target: Recently, the Chinese Ambassador to Bosnia and Montenegro, Ji Ping, met with the chairman of the Bih Olympic Committee, Kvesic, at the Sarajevo Olympic Center.

source: 会见时，克韦西奇积极评价波中关系并表示，他曾于2008年北京夏奥会之际访华，对中方出色的组织工作印象极为深刻，坚信中国有能力在特殊时期办好冬奥盛会；波方十分期待北京冬奥会，波黑奥委会正在积极组织参会；波方希望以此为契机，同中方在体育领域开展更为广泛的交流合作。
target: During the meeting, Kvesic positively commented on the Polish-Chinese relations and said that he had visited China on the occasion of the 2008 Beijing Summer Olympics and was very impressed by China's outstanding organizational work. He firmly believes that China has the ability to host the Winter Olympics in a special period of time; The Polish side is very much looking forward to the Beijing Winter Olympics, and the BIH Olympic Committee is actively organizing participation in the meeting; the Polish side hopes to take this as an opportunity to carry out broader exchanges and cooperation with China in the field of sports.

source: 季平表示，中波两国有着特殊的“奥运纽带” 。

target: The 1984 Winter Olympics in Sarajevo were successfully held here. In two months, the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics will also kick off, presenting a simple, safe and wonderful event to the world.

source: 波黑奥委会主席：坚信中国有能力在特殊时期办好冬奥盛会-新华网
target: President of the Bosnia and Herzegovina Olympic Committee: I firmly believe that China has the ability to host the Winter Olympic Games in a special period-Xinhuanet

source: 新华社萨拉热窝12月11日电波黑奥委会主席克韦西奇近日表示，波方十分期待北京冬奥会，坚信中国有能力在特殊时期办好冬奥盛会。
target: Xinhua News Agency, Sarajevo, December 11. Bosnia and Herzegovina Olympic Committee President Kvesic said recently that Poland is looking forward to the Beijing Winter Olympic Games and firmly believes that China has the ability to host the Winter Olympic Games in a special period.

source: 日前中国驻波黑大使季平在萨拉热窝奥林匹克中心会见波黑奥委会主席克韦西奇。
target: A few days ago, Chinese Ambassador to Bosnia and Herzegovina Ji Ping met with Bosnia and Herzegovina Olympic Committee President Kvesic at the Sarajevo Olympic Center.

source: 会见时，克韦西奇积极评价波中关系并表示，他曾于2008年北京夏奥会之际访华，对中方出色的组织工作印象极为深刻，坚信中国有能力在特殊时期办好冬奥盛会；波方十分期待北京冬奥会，波黑奥委会正在积极组织参会；波方希望以此为契机，同中方在体育领域开展更为广泛的交流合作。
target: During the meeting, Kvesic made positive comments on Poland-China relations and said that he visited China on the occasion of the 2008 Beijing Summer Olympic Games, was extremely impressed by China's excellent organizational work, and firmly believed that China has the ability to host the Winter Olympic Games in a special period; Poland is looking forward to the Beijing Winter Olympic Games, and the Bosnia and Herzegovina Olympic Committee is actively organizing participation; Poland hopes to take this opportunity to carry out more extensive exchanges and cooperation with China in the field of sports.

source: 季平表示，中波两国有着特殊的“奥运纽带” 。
target: Ji Ping said that China and Poland have special "Olympic <v>ties</v>".

source: 1984年萨拉热窝冬奥会在这里成功举办，再过两个月，2022年北京冬奥会也将拉开帷幕，将向世界呈现一场简约、安全、精彩的盛会。
target: The 1984 Sarajevo Winter Olympics were successfully held here, and in two months, the 2022 Beijing Winter Olympics will also kick off, presenting a simple, safe and wonderful event to the world.

source: 期待两国在冬季体育赛事筹备、运动员训练等方面深化交流合作，中国驻波黑使馆愿继续发挥桥梁作用，以北京冬奥会为契机，推动两国人文交流不断深化，让两国人民“一起向未来” ， 并祝波黑运动健儿在北京取得佳绩。
target: Looking forward to deepening exchanges and cooperation between the two countries in the preparation of winter sports events and athlete training, the Chinese Embassy in Bosnia and Herzegovina is willing to continue to play a bridge role and take the Beijing Winter Olympic Games as an opportunity to promote the deepening of people-to-people exchanges between the two countries, so that the two peoples can "look forward to the future together", and wish Bosnia and Herzegovina athletes good results in Beijing.

source: 会见前，波黑奥委会举办了“第十届年度最佳运动员”颁奖典礼，季平作为特邀嘉宾为波黑最佳青年运动员颁奖。
target: Before the meeting, the Bosnia and Herzegovina Olympic Committee held the "10th Best Athlete of the Year" award ceremony, and Ji Ping presented the award to the best young athlete of Bosnia and Herzegovina as a special guest.

source: 新华社南宁５月１９日专电（记者张莺）记者近日从广西壮族自治区教育厅获悉，今后广西各高校将实施弹性学制，放宽大学生休学年限，在校生休学创业的年限在原有学制基础上可延长２至５年，休学创业时间可视为实践教育时间。

target: In order to promote the improvement of college students' entrepreneurial and innovative capabilities, Guangxi education, human resources and social security departments have worked together to build an entrepreneurial platform, and build more off-campus practical teaching bases for college students, university science and technology parks, college student entrepreneurship parks, and entrepreneurial incubation bases to provide external guarantees for college students' entrepreneurship.

source: 自治区教育厅要求广西各高校深入实施大学生创新创业训练计划，力争使每一名大学生在校期间都参与一项创新创业训练计划。

target: Article 17 The state implements a registration practice management system for the qualifications of registered fire engineers.

source: 取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书的人员，经注册方可以相应级别注册消防工程师名义执业。

source: 取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书的人员，经注册方可以相应级别注册消防工程师名义执业。
target: Persons who have obtained the qualification certificates of first- and second-level registered fire engineers may be able to practice in the name of registered fire engineers at the corresponding level.

source: 第十八条公安部消防局是一级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门。
target: Article 18 The Fire Department of the Ministry of Public Security is the registration and approval department for the qualification of a first-class registered fire engineer.

source: 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构为二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门，并负责一级注册消防工程师资格注册的初步审查工作。
target: Fire protection departments of the public security organs of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government are the registration approval organs of the qualification of second-level registered fire engineers and are responsible for the preliminary examination of qualifications of first-level registered fire engineers.

source: 第十九条取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书并申请注册的人员，应当受聘于一个经批准的消防技术服务机构或者消防安全重点单位，并通过聘用单位向本单位所在地(聘用单位属企业的，通过本企业向工商注册所在地)的公安机关消防机构提交注册申请材料。
target: Article 19 Persons who have obtained the first-class or second-class registered fire engineer qualification certificate and apply for registration shall be employed in an approved fire-fighting technical service agency or a key fire safety unit, and shall submit registration application materials to the fire department of the public security organ located within a locality of their enterprise (if the employer is an enterprise, through their said enterprise to the place where the industrial and commercial registration is located).

source: 第二十条省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构在收到申请人的注册申请材料后，对申请材料不齐全或者不符合法定形式的，应当当场或者在5个工作日内，一次性告知申请人需要补正的全部内容，逾期不告知的，自收到申请材料之日起即为受理。
target: Article 20: After receiving the applicant's registration application materials, the fire protection agency of public security organ in a province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government shall, on the spot or within 5 workdays, notify all the contents required to be supplemented or corrected at one time when the application materials are incomplete or not in compliance with the statutory form. If the application is not notified within the time limit, it shall be accepted as of the date of receipt of the application materials.

source: 对受理或者不予受理的注册申请，均应当出具加盖本级公安机关消防机构专用印章和注明日期的书面凭证。
target: All application for registration whether accepted or rejected shall be given a written certificate affixed with the special seal of fire protection department of the public security organ at that level and marked with the date.

source: 第二十一条省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构自受理注册申请之日起20个工作日内，按规定条件和程序完成一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料的初步审查工作和二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批工作，并将一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料和初步审查意见报公安部消防局审批。
target: Article 21 The fire protection agencies of the public security bodies of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall, within 20 working days from the day of receiving the application for registration, complete preliminary examination of registration application materials for a first-grade registered fire engineer qualification and registration approval of a second-grade certified fire engineer according to the prescribed conditions and procedures, and submit the application materials and preliminary examination opinions for the first-grade registered fire engineer qualification to the Fire Division of the Ministry of Public Security for approval.

source: 公安部消防局应当自收到省级公安机关消防机构报送的申请材料和初步审查意见之日起，20个工作日内作出是否批准的决定。
target: The Fire Department of the Ministry of Public Security shall make a decision on whether to approve or not within 20 business days after receiving the application materials and preliminary review opinions submitted by the fire protection department of the provincial public security organ.

source: 在规定的期限内不能作出批准决定的，应当将延长的期限和理由告知申请人。
target: If the approval decision cannot be made within the prescribed time limit, the applicant shall be informed of <v>the extension time limit</v> and the reasons.

source: 对作出不予批准决定的，应当书面说明理由，并告知申请人享有依法申请行政复议或者提起行政诉讼的权利。
target: If a disapproval decision is made, the reasons shall be stated in writing, and the applicant shall be informed that he has the right to apply for administrative reconsideration or file an administrative lawsuit according to law.

source: 第二十二条注册审批部门应当自作出批准决定之日起10个工作日内，颁发、送达相应级别的注册证。
target: Article 22 The registration examination and approval department shall issue and serve the registration certificate of the corresponding level within 10 working days from the date of making the approval decision.

source: 第二十三条注册证的每一注册有效期为3年。
target: Article 23 The registration validity period for each registration certificate is three years.

source: 注册证在有效期内是相应级别注册消防工程师的执业凭证，由注册消防工程师本人保管、使用。
target: The registration certificate is the practising certificate of a registered fire engineer at the corresponding level within its validity period and shall be kept and used by the registered fire <v>engineer</v>.

source: 第二十四条申请初始注册的，应当自取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书之日起1年内提出申请。
target: Article 24 When applying for initial registration, the application shall be submitted within one year from the date of obtaining the first-level or second-level registered fire engineer qualification certificates.

source: 逾期申请初始注册时，须符合本规定继续教育要求。
target: Late applications for initial registration must comply with the continuing education requirements of this regulation.

source: 初始注册、延续注册、变更注册、注销注册和不予注册等注册管理的具体办法，由公安部另行规定。
target: Specific procedures for registration management such as initial registration, continuation of registration, modification of registration, cancellation of registration and non-registration shall be separately prescribed by the Ministry of Public Security.

source: 第二十五条继续教育是注册消防工程师延续注册、重新注册和逾期初始注册的必备条件。
target: Article 25 Continuing education is a necessary condition for the renewal of registration, re-registration and overdue initial registration for registered fire engineers.

source: 第二十五条继续教育是注册消防工程师延续注册、重新注册和逾期初始注册的必备条件。

source: 让大学精神与时代精神同频共振-新华网
target: Let the University Spirit Resonate with the Spirit of the Times-Xinhuanet

source: 所谓大学精神，是指一所大学在发展过程中长期积淀形成的一系列办学理念和价值追求，是大学的灵魂所在。
target: The so-called university spirit refers to a series of school-running concepts and value pursuits formed by a university in the process of development, which is the soul of the university.

source: 从古至今，大学精神对于政治、经济、文化、科技、社会的发展，乃至一个民族的进步均至关重要。
target: Since ancient times, the spirit of university has been crucial to the development of politics, economy, culture, science and technology, society and even the progress of a nation.

source: 从世界第一所现代意义上的大学诞生起，大学就肩负起不同于其他社会组织的独特使命，对于我国大学来说，兴起于民族危难之秋，其精神更是深受传统文化和时代变迁的影响，倡导“明德济世，修齐治平”的价值理念和“兴学强国”的爱国主义担当。
target: Since the birth of the world's first university in the modern sense, universities have shouldered a unique mission different from other social organizations. For Chinese universities, it emerged in the autumn of national crisis, and its spirit was deeply influenced by traditional culture and changes of the times, advocating the value concept of "empowering virtues to help the world and improving peace" and the patriotic responsibility of "rejuvenating learning and strengthening the country".

source: 当前，高等教育信息化、国际化趋势日益明显，全球范围的教育竞争、科技竞争、人才竞争不断加剧，高等教育事业作为重要的“供给侧” ， 其结构性改革正面临前所未有的机遇和挑战。
target: At present, the trend of higher education informatization and internationalization is becoming increasingly obvious, and the competition in education, science and technology and talents is intensifying worldwide. As an important "supply side", the structural reform of higher education is facing unprecedented opportunities and challenges.

source: 尤其是《统筹推进世界一流大学和一流学科建设总体方案》的提出，在展示了我国从高等教育大国向高等教育强国迈进的信心和决心的同时，更是对大学发展提出了更高更新的要求。
target: In particular, the proposal of the Overall Plan for Coordinating and Promoting the Construction of World-class Universities and First-class Disciplines not only shows China's confidence and determination to move forward from a big country of higher education to a strong country of higher education, but also puts forward higher requirements for university development.

source: 尤其是《统筹推进世界一流大学和一流学科建设总体方案》的提出，在展示了我国从高等教育大国向高等教育强国迈进的信心和决心的同时，更是对大学发展提出了更高更新的要求。
target: In particular, the proposal of the Overall Plan for Coordinating and Promoting the Construction of World-class Universities and First-class Disciplines not only shows China's confidence and determination to move forward from a big country of higher education to a strong country of higher education, but also puts forward higher requirements for university development.

source: 如何在较短时间内努力跻身世界一流行列，在仍有一定差距的基础上加快建成若干所世界一流大学和一批世界一流学科，实现“弯道超车” ？
target: How to make efforts to become one of the world's most popular universities in a short period of time, accelerate the construction of several world-class universities and a number of world-class disciplines on the basis of a certain gap, and achieve "corner overtaking"?

source: 除了坚定目标自信、路径自信、能力自信，高校还应当充分发挥三种优势：一是后发优势，通过持续引进海外杰出学术人才，学习借鉴世界一流大学的先进经验，实现学术水平和办学质量的显著提升；二是文化优势，继承中华文明在五千年积淀的智慧内涵，弘扬发展优秀传统文化，以此来凝聚力量、塑造品牌、提升形象；三是制度优势，发挥社会主义国家的制度优越性，强化目标驱动，汇集共识合力，优化资源配置，为学校加速赶超世界先进水平提供可持续的坚实保障。
target: In addition to firm confidence in goals, paths and abilities, universities should give full play to the three advantages: The first is the late-mover advantage. By continuously introducing outstanding overseas academic talents and learning from the advanced experience of world-class universities, the academic level and school running quality can be significantly improved<v>.</v>; The second is the cultural advantage, which inherits the wisdom of Chinese civilization accumulated over the past 5,000 years and promotes the development of excellent traditional culture, so as to gather strength, build brand and enhance image.; The third is institutional advantages. Give full play to the institutional advantages of socialist countries, strengthen goal-driven development, pool consensus and synergy, optimize resource allocation, and provide a sustainable and solid guarantee for schools to catch up with the world's advanced level.

source: 特别要意识到，建设世界一流大学不可能千校一面，各个学校在发挥优势的同时，必须彰显个性和特色。
target: In particular, it is necessary to realize that it is impossible to build a world-class university into <v>a single university</v>, and each university must show its personality and characteristics while giving full play to its advantages.

source: 办学特色既要有共性的中国特色，也要体现各自独特的目标定位、办学传统和资源禀赋。
target: School-running characteristics should not only have common Chinese characteristics, but also reflect their unique goal positioning, school-running tradition and resource endowment.

source: 就浙江大学而言，我们在办学中注重突出三个方面的特色：一是突出创新创业人才培养特色，构建科教融合、校企结合的整合育人环境，形成全链条的创业教育生态系统；二是突出学科交叉会聚特色，推动学科体系的优化调整，营造学科交叉的制度环境，积极培育交叉新兴学科和标志性交叉成果；三是突出办学体系和社会服务特色，开展深度国际交流合作，加快形成泛浙大产学研合作体系。
target: As far as Zhejiang University is concerned, we focus on highlighting three characteristics in running schools: First, highlight the characteristics of innovative and entrepreneurial talent training, build an integrated education environment integrating science and education and school-enterprise integration, and form a whole-chain entrepreneurship education ecosystem; Second, highlight the characteristics of interdisciplinary convergence, promote the optimization and adjustment of the discipline system, create an interdisciplinary institutional environment, and actively cultivate interdisciplinary emerging disciplines and landmark interdisciplinary achievements.; Third, highlight the characteristics of the school-running system and social services, carry out in-depth international exchanges and cooperation, and accelerate the formation of the Pan-Zhejiang University industry-university-research cooperation system.

source: 在这个过程中，尤为重要的是，要始终坚守大学精神，让大学精神与时代精神同频共振。
target: In this process, it is particularly important to continuously adhere to the spirit of the university, so that the spirit of the university and the spirit of the times <v>resonance</v>.

source: 对于浙江大学来说， “ 求是创新”校训， “ 勤学、修德、明辨、笃实”共同价值观以及“海纳江河、启真厚德、开物前民、树我邦国”共同构成了浙大精神的最新表述体系。
target: For Zhejiang University, the school motto of "seeking truth and innovation", the common values of "diligence, moral cultivation, discernment and down-to-earth" and the common values of "<v>enlightening the river</v>, enlightening the truth and being kind, exploring the former people and building our country" constitute the latest expression system of the spirit of Zhejiang University.

source: 这是学校坚持正确办学方向，不断积累文化高度、凝聚精神力量的重要保障，内涵丰富，意义深远。
target: This is an important guarantee for the university to adhere to the correct direction of running a school, continuously accumulate cultural height and gather spiritual strength. It has rich connotations and far-reaching significance.

source: 第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛期间举行两场主要会议，讨论议题围绕着数字技术企业与国家数字化转型、数字技术企业与新冠肺炎疫情中和疫情后经济复苏与发展两大主题。

target: Nguyen Manh Hung, Minister of Communications and Media, said that in 2021, despite the continued spread of the <v>flu-like virus</v> epidemic, the number and operating income of Vietnamese digital technology companies will maintain the momentum of growth, reaching nearly 10%.

source: 2021年，越南典型数字产品数量耕作，集中解决越南面临的各大难题，许多数字产品已走出国门，越南数字技术排名已提升。
target: In 2021, Vietnam <v>will cultivate</v> the number of typical digital products in order to solve major problems faced by Vietnam. Many digital products have gone abroad, and Vietnam's digital technology ranking has improved.

target: Minister Nguyen Manh Hung called on digital technology companies to take the responsibility of developing national digital transformation platforms, and that the task of developing these national digital platforms is to take the national mission.

source: 在论坛上，各部门和国家机关领导，正在研究、发展、应用、转让数字技术的企业、组织和个人分享了动员和汇集全社会资源来发展越南技术企业，携手推动国家数字化转型，朱慧疫情后经济复苏等的各突破性设想和解决方案。
target: At the forum, leaders of various departments and state organs, companies, organizations and individuals who are researching, developing, applying and transferring digital technologies shared breakthrough ideas and solutions on mobilizing and pooling resources of the whole society to develop Vietnamese technology companies, jointly promote the country's digital transformation, and <v>Zhu Hui's post-epidemic</v> economic recovery.

source: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。

source: 数字化转型已成为全球性问题，数字化转型服务全民，因此需动员全民参与。
target: Digital transformation has become a global issue, and digital transformation serves all people, so it is necessary to mobilize all people to participate.

source: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。
target: People and businesses are the core, subject, goal and driving force of digital transformation.

source: 因此，一切政策需为了人民和企业。
target: Therefore, all policies need to be for the people and businesses.

source: 范明正总理强调，数字化转型需体现民族精神，需以内力为主、战略、长期和决定性因素，外力为重要和突破口。
target: Premier Fan Mingzheng emphasized that digital transformation needs to reflect the national spirit, requires internal forces as the main, strategic, long-term and decisive factors, and external forces as an important and breakthrough point.

source: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。
target: He also believes that digital transformation needs to drive in-depth development and sustainable development, participate in the prevention and control of the <v>new crown pneumonia epidemic</v>, economic recovery and development, respond to subsequent changes, overcome the depletion of natural resources, and contribute to green transformation and development of green energy.

source: 数字化转型需参与保护和弘扬有关国家文化价值、历史传统、国家风土人情等的数据库建立工作，推动银行、税务、土地管理和开发数据库以及物流等领域数字化转型。
target: Digital transformation requires participation in the establishment of databases for the protection and promotion of national cultural values, historical traditions, and national customs, etc. and promote digital transformation in areas such as banking, taxation, land management and development databases, and logistics.

source: 数字化转型的最大目标是让人民更幸福，国家日益繁荣发展。
target: The biggest goal of digital transformation is to make people happier and the country prosperous.

source: 让大学精神与时代精神同频共振-新华网
target: Let the university spirit and the spirit of the times resonate in the same frequency - Xinhuanet

source: 所谓大学精神，是指一所大学在发展过程中长期积淀形成的一系列办学理念和价值追求，是大学的灵魂所在。
target: The so-called university spirit refers to a series of school-running concepts and value pursuits that have been accumulated over a long period of time in the process of development of a university, which is the soul of the university.

source: 从古至今，大学精神对于政治、经济、文化、科技、社会的发展，乃至一个民族的进步均至关重要。
target: From ancient times to the present, the university spirit has been crucial to the development of politics, economy, culture, science and technology, society, and even the progress of a nation.

source: 从世界第一所现代意义上的大学诞生起，大学就肩负起不同于其他社会组织的独特使命，对于我国大学来说，兴起于民族危难之秋，其精神更是深受传统文化和时代变迁的影响，倡导“明德济世，修齐治平”的价值理念和“兴学强国”的爱国主义担当。
target: Since the birth of the world's first university in the modern sense, the university has shouldered a unique mission that is different from other social organizations. For Chinese universities, it emerged in the <v>autumn</v> of national crisis, and its spirit is deeply influenced by traditional culture and changes of the times, advocating the value concept of "good morality, good governance," and the patriotic responsibility of "developing a strong country."

source: 当前，高等教育信息化、国际化趋势日益明显，全球范围的教育竞争、科技竞争、人才竞争不断加剧，高等教育事业作为重要的“供给侧” ， 其结构性改革正面临前所未有的机遇和挑战。
target: At present, the trend of informatization and internationalization of higher education is becoming more and more obvious, and the competition for education, science and technology, and talent is intensifying on a global scale. As an important "supply side," the higher education industry is facing unprecedented opportunities and challenges in its structural reform.

source: 尤其是《统筹推进世界一流大学和一流学科建设总体方案》的提出，在展示了我国从高等教育大国向高等教育强国迈进的信心和决心的同时，更是对大学发展提出了更高更新的要求。
target: In particular, the proposal of the "Overall Plan for Promoting the Construction of World First-Class Universities and First-Class Disciplines" demonstrates the confidence and determination of China to move from a major country of higher education to a powerful country of higher education, and also puts forward higher and updated requirements for the development of universities.

source: 如何在较短时间内努力跻身世界一流行列，在仍有一定差距的基础上加快建成若干所世界一流大学和一批世界一流学科，实现“弯道超车” ？
target: How can we strive to be among the world's first-class in a relatively short period of time, and accelerate the establishment of a number of world-class universities and a number of world-class disciplines on the basis of still some gaps, so as to achieve "overtaking in corners"?

source: 除了坚定目标自信、路径自信、能力自信，高校还应当充分发挥三种优势：一是后发优势，通过持续引进海外杰出学术人才，学习借鉴世界一流大学的先进经验，实现学术水平和办学质量的显著提升；二是文化优势，继承中华文明在五千年积淀的智慧内涵，弘扬发展优秀传统文化，以此来凝聚力量、塑造品牌、提升形象；三是制度优势，发挥社会主义国家的制度优越性，强化目标驱动，汇集共识合力，优化资源配置，为学校加速赶超世界先进水平提供可持续的坚实保障。
target: In addition to firm goal confidence, path confidence, and ability confidence, universities should also give full play to three advantages: First, the advantage of being a latecomer, by continuously introducing outstanding overseas academic talents and learning from the advanced experience of world-class universities, to achieve a significant improvement in academic level and school quality; second, the cultural advantage, inheriting the wisdom connotation of Chinese civilization accumulated over 5,000 years, and promoting the development of excellent traditional <v>culture</v>, in order to gather strength, shape brand, and enhance the image; third, the advantages of the system, give full play to the advantages of socialist countries, strengthen the goal drive, gather consensus, and optimize the allocation of resources, so as to provide a sustainable and solid guarantee for the school to accelerate its catching up with the world advanced level.

source: 特别要意识到，建设世界一流大学不可能千校一面，各个学校在发挥优势的同时，必须彰显个性和特色。
target: In particular, we should realize that it is impossible to build a world-class university <v>with a thousand schools</v>, and each school must show its individuality and characteristics while making use of its advantages.

target: In December of the same year, after <v>consulting</v> with Lin, the family member of the owner of the house, on the details of the purchase of the factory building, Mr. Lu remitted 200,000 yuan as a deposit by bank transfer on the same day.

source: 林某在《厂房买卖定金收条》上作为收款人签名，其中载明，“若买方不想买此厂房，此定金归卖家，如卖方不愿意卖此厂房，定金将双倍返还卖方，双方约定一周内签订厂房买卖合同。”
target: Lin signed as the payee on the "Factory Sale and Purchase Deposit Receipt," which stated, "If the buyer does not want to buy the plant, the deposit belongs to the seller. If the seller does not want to sell the plant, the deposit will be returned to the seller twice, and the two parties agreed to sign a contract for the sale of the plant within a week."

source: 然而，之后双方因厂房出售范围、付款方式等主要合同条款未能形成一致意见，导致房屋买卖合同迟迟未能签订。
target: However, the two parties failed to reach an agreement on the main terms of the contract, such as the scope of the sale of the plant and the method of payment, which led to the delay in signing the contract for the sale of the house.

source: 考虑到双方未能就合同内容达成共识，几天后，林某将20万元定金退回给了陆先生。
target: Considering that the two parties failed to reach a consensus on the content of the contract, a few days later, Lin returned the 200,000 yuan deposit to Mr. Lu.

source: 好不容易看中的房子，定金交了，房款也准备好了，就差“临门一脚”签合同，卖方却不卖了，这让陆先生无奈又愤怒。
target: When the deposit was paid and the house was ready, the seller signed the contract on the spot, but the seller did not sell it, which made Mr. Lu helpless and angry.

source: 为此，陆先生将林某起诉至余姚市人民法院。
target: For this reason, Mr. Lu sued Lin to the Yuyao Municipal People's Court.

source: 法院经审理认为，双方最终未能签订正式合同，不能仅归责于被告，应合理推定为磋商不成，故本案不应适用定金罚则，被告无需承担双倍返还定金的违约责任。
target: After hearing the case, the court held that the failure of the two parties to sign a formal contract could not be attributed only to the defendant, but should be reasonably presumed to be a failure of negotiation. target: The so-called university spirit refers to a series of ideas and value pursuits that a university has accumulated over a long period of time during its development. It is the soul of a university.
