source: 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构为二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门，并负责一级注册消防工程师资格注册的初步审查工作。
target: The fire department of the public security organs of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government is the registered examination and approval department for the qualification of Class II registered fire engineer, and is responsible for the preliminary examination of the registration of Class I registered fire engineer.

source: 第十九条取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书并申请注册的人员，应当受聘于一个经批准的消防技术服务机构或者消防安全重点单位，并通过聘用单位向本单位所在地(聘用单位属企业的，通过本企业向工商注册所在地)的公安机关消防机构提交注册申请材料。
target: Article 19 Personnel who have obtained the qualification certificates of Class I and Class II registered fire protection engineers and apply for registration shall be employed by an approved fire protection technical service institution or key unit of fire safety, and submit registration application materials to the fire protection institution of the public security organ where the employer is located (if the employer is an enterprise, the enterprise shall submit registration application materials to the fire protection institution of the public security organ where the industrial and commercial registration is located).

source: 第二十条省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构在收到申请人的注册申请材料后，对申请材料不齐全或者不符合法定形式的，应当当场或者在5个工作日内，一次性告知申请人需要补正的全部内容，逾期不告知的，自收到申请材料之日起即为受理。
target: Article 20 After receiving the registration application materials from the applicant, the fire department of the public security organ of the province, autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government shall inform the applicant of all the contents to be supplemented and corrected on the spot or within 5 working days if the application materials are incomplete or do not conform to the legal form. If the applicant fails to notify within the time limit, it shall be deemed as accepted from the date of receiving the application materials.

source: 对受理或者不予受理的注册申请，均应当出具加盖本级公安机关消防机构专用印章和注明日期的书面凭证。
target: The registration application accepted or rejected shall be provided with a written certificate stamped with the special seal of the fire department of the public security organ at the corresponding <v>level</v> and dated.

source: 对受理或者不予受理的注册申请，均应当出具加盖本级公安机关消防机构专用印章和注明日期的书面凭证。
target: The registration application accepted or rejected shall be provided with a written certificate stamped with the special seal of the fire department of the public security organ at the corresponding level and <v>dated</v>.

source: 第二十一条省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构自受理注册申请之日起20个工作日内，按规定条件和程序完成一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料的初步审查工作和二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批工作，并将一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料和初步审查意见报公安部消防局审批。
target: Article 21 The fire departments of the public security organs of the provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall, within 20 working days from the date of accepting the registration application, complete the preliminary examination of the application materials for the registration of the first-class registered fire engineer and the registration and approval of the second-class registered fire engineer according to the prescribed conditions and procedures, and submit the application materials for the registration of the first-class registered fire engineer and the preliminary examination opinions to the fire department of the Ministry of Public Security for approval.

source: 公安部消防局应当自收到省级公安机关消防机构报送的申请材料和初步审查意见之日起，20个工作日内作出是否批准的决定。
target: The fire department of the Ministry of Public Security shall make a decision on whether to approve or not within 20 working days from the date of receiving the application materials and preliminary review opinions submitted by the fire department of the provincial public security organ.

target: If the approval decision cannot be made within the specified period, the applicant shall be informed of the extended period and reasons.

source: 新华社南宁５月１９日专电（记者张莺）记者近日从广西壮族自治区教育厅获悉，今后广西各高校将实施弹性学制，放宽大学生休学年限，在校生休学创业的年限在原有学制基础上可延长２至５年，休学创业时间可视为实践教育时间。

target: Let the spirit of the university resonate at the same frequency with the spirit of the times - Xinhua English.news.cn

source: 所谓大学精神，是指一所大学在发展过程中长期积淀形成的一系列办学理念和价值追求，是大学的灵魂所在。
target: The so-called university spirit refers to a series of educational concepts and value pursuits formed over a long period of time during a university's development <v>journey</v>, and is the soul of a university.

source: 从古至今，大学精神对于政治、经济、文化、科技、社会的发展，乃至一个民族的进步均至关重要。
target: From ancient times until today, university spirit has been vital to the development of politics, economy, culture, technology, society, and even the progress of a nation.

source: 从世界第一所现代意义上的大学诞生起，大学就肩负起不同于其他社会组织的独特使命，对于我国大学来说，兴起于民族危难之秋，其精神更是深受传统文化和时代变迁的影响，倡导“明德济世，修齐治平”的价值理念和“兴学强国”的爱国主义担当。
target: Since the world's first university in the modern sense was born, the university has shouldered unique mission that is different from other social organizations. For Chinese universities, they emerged in the midst of national crisis, whose spirit is deeply influenced by traditional culture and changes of times, advocating the value of “moral virtue, helping the world, and maintaining peace” and the role of patriotism of “<v>relaunching</v> education and strengthening the country”.

source: 当前，高等教育信息化、国际化趋势日益明显，全球范围的教育竞争、科技竞争、人才竞争不断加剧，高等教育事业作为重要的“供给侧” ， 其结构性改革正面临前所未有的机遇和挑战。
target: Currently, the trend of informatization and internationalization of higher education has become increasingly evident. Competition in education, technology, and talents across the globe is becoming ever more intensified. As an important "supply side", higher education is facing unprecedented opportunities and challenges in its structural reform.

source: 尤其是《统筹推进世界一流大学和一流学科建设总体方案》的提出，在展示了我国从高等教育大国向高等教育强国迈进的信心和决心的同时，更是对大学发展提出了更高更新的要求。
target: In particular, the proposal of “Overall Plan for Promoting the Construction of World-Class Universities and First-Class Disciplines” demonstrates China's confidence and determination to advance from <v>a major country of higher education to a strong country in higher education</v>, and also puts forward higher and more updated requirements for university development.

source: 如何在较短时间内努力跻身世界一流行列，在仍有一定差距的基础上加快建成若干所世界一流大学和一批世界一流学科，实现“弯道超车” ？
target: How to endeavor to become one of the world's top ranks within a relatively short period of time and speed up the building of a number of world-class universities and a number of world-class disciplines<v>, while still having a certain gap, and to achieve "overtaking on the curve"?</v>

source: 除了坚定目标自信、路径自信、能力自信，高校还应当充分发挥三种优势：一是后发优势，通过持续引进海外杰出学术人才，学习借鉴世界一流大学的先进经验，实现学术水平和办学质量的显著提升；二是文化优势，继承中华文明在五千年积淀的智慧内涵，弘扬发展优秀传统文化，以此来凝聚力量、塑造品牌、提升形象；三是制度优势，发挥社会主义国家的制度优越性，强化目标驱动，汇集共识合力，优化资源配置，为学校加速赶超世界先进水平提供可持续的坚实保障。
target: In addition to asserting our self-confidence in goals, paths and ability, colleges and universities should give full play to three advantages: first, our latecomer advantage. We will continue to introduce outstanding academic talents from overseas, and learn from the advanced experience of world-class universities, to realize a significant improvement in the academic level and quality of education. Second, we will inherit the wisdom accumulated by the Chinese civilization over five thousand years to promote the development of outstanding traditional culture, so as to gather strength, shape brands, and improve our image. The third is institutional advantages. We use the institutional superiority of a socialist nation to strengthen target-driven, synergistic efforts to optimize resource allocation and provide a <v>sustainable and sustainable</v> way for schools to catch up with the international advanced level.

target: In particular, it is necessary to be aware that it is impossible to build a world-class university <v>with a thousand schools</v>. Each school must demonstrate its individuality and characteristics while leveraging its advantages.

source: 办学特色既要有共性的中国特色，也要体现各自独特的目标定位、办学传统和资源禀赋。
target: The characteristics of running a school should not only have common Chinese characteristics, but also reflect their unique goals, school running traditions<v> and</v> resource endowments.

source: 就浙江大学而言，我们在办学中注重突出三个方面的特色：一是突出创新创业人才培养特色，构建科教融合、校企结合的整合育人环境，形成全链条的创业教育生态系统；二是突出学科交叉会聚特色，推动学科体系的优化调整，营造学科交叉的制度环境，积极培育交叉新兴学科和标志性交叉成果；三是突出办学体系和社会服务特色，开展深度国际交流合作，加快形成泛浙大产学研合作体系。
target: As far as Zhejiang University is concerned, we emphasize three characteristics in running a school: first, to highlight the innovative and entrepreneurial talent development characteristics, building a comprehensive educational environment incorporating the integration of science and education and school-enterprise fusion, and to form a whole-chain entrepreneurship education ecosystem; second, to highlight the characteristics of intersecting and converging disciplines, promote the optimization and adjustment of the disciplinary system, create an interdisciplinary institutional environment, and actively cultivate intersecting emerging disciplines and iconic <v>crossover</v> achievements; third, highlighting the characteristics of university running system and social services, and establishing in-depth exchanges and cooperation between industries, universities, and research institutes, accelerating the formation of a Pan-Zhejiang University industry-university-research cooperation system.

source: 第十七条国家对注册消防工程师资格实行注册执业管理制度。
target: Article 17 The State implements a registered practice management system for the qualifications of registered fire engineers.

source: 取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书的人员，经注册方可以相应级别注册消防工程师名义执业。
target: Personnel who have obtained the qualification certificates of first- and second-level registered fire-fighting engineers may practice in the name of registered fire-fighting engineers at the corresponding <v>level</v> after registration.

source: 第十八条公安部消防局是一级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门。
target: Article 18 The Fire Protection Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security is the registration approval department for the qualification of a first-level registered fire engineer.

source: 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构为二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门，并负责一级注册消防工程师资格注册的初步审查工作。
target: The fire-fighting agencies of the public security organs of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government are the registration approval departments for the qualification of second-level registered fire-fighting engineers, and are responsible for the preliminary examination of the qualification registration of first-level registered fire-fighting engineers.

source: 第十九条取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书并申请注册的人员，应当受聘于一个经批准的消防技术服务机构或者消防安全重点单位，并通过聘用单位向本单位所在地(聘用单位属企业的，通过本企业向工商注册所在地)的公安机关消防机构提交注册申请材料。
target: Article 19 Personnel who have obtained the qualification certificates of first- and second-level registered fire-fighting engineers and applied for registration shall be employed by an approved fire-fighting technical service organization or a key fire-fighting safety unit, and submit registration application materials through the employing unit to the fire-fighting agency of the public security organ where the unit is located (if the employing unit belongs to an enterprise, the enterprise shall submit registration application materials to the fire-fighting agency of the public security organ where the industrial and commercial registration is located).

source: 第二十条省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构在收到申请人的注册申请材料后，对申请材料不齐全或者不符合法定形式的，应当当场或者在5个工作日内，一次性告知申请人需要补正的全部内容，逾期不告知的，自收到申请材料之日起即为受理。
target: Article 20 After receiving the applicant's registration application materials, the public security organs and fire-fighting agencies of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall inform the <v>applicant</v> on the spot or within 5 working days of one-time notification of all the contents that need to be corrected. If the applicant fails to inform within the time limit, it will be accepted from the date of receipt of the application materials.

source: 对受理或者不予受理的注册申请，均应当出具加盖本级公安机关消防机构专用印章和注明日期的书面凭证。
target: For applications for registration that are accepted or not accepted, written certificates stamped with the special seal of the fire-fighting agency of the public security organ at the corresponding level and dated shall be issued.

source: 第二十一条省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构自受理注册申请之日起20个工作日内，按规定条件和程序完成一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料的初步审查工作和二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批工作，并将一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料和初步审查意见报公安部消防局审批。
target: Article 21 The fire protection agencies of the public security organs of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall, within 20 working days from the date of accepting the registration application, complete the preliminary examination of the application materials for the qualification of a first-level registered fire engineer and the registration and approval of the qualification of <v>a</v> second-level registered fire engineer in accordance with the prescribed conditions and procedures, and submit the application materials for the qualification of a first-level registered fire engineer and the preliminary examination opinions to the Fire Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security for approval.

source: 第二十一条省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构自受理注册申请之日起20个工作日内，按规定条件和程序完成一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料的初步审查工作和二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批工作，并将一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料和初步审查意见报公安部消防局审批。
target: Article 21 The fire protection agencies of the public security organs of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall, within 20 working days from the date of accepting the registration application, complete the preliminary examination of the application materials for the qualification of a first-level registered fire engineer and the registration and approval of the qualification of a second-level registered fire <v>engineer</v> in accordance with the prescribed conditions and procedures, and submit the application materials for the qualification of a first-level registered fire engineer and the preliminary examination opinions to the Fire Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security for approval.

source: 公安部消防局应当自收到省级公安机关消防机构报送的申请材料和初步审查意见之日起，20个工作日内作出是否批准的决定。
target: The Fire Protection Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security shall make a decision on whether to approve it within 20 working days from the date of receiving the application materials and preliminary examination opinions submitted by the fire protection agencies of the provincial public security organs.

source: 在规定的期限内不能作出批准决定的，应当将延长的期限和理由告知申请人。
target: If the approval decision cannot be made within the prescribed time limit, the applicant shall be notified of the extended time limit and the reasons.

source: 对作出不予批准决定的，应当书面说明理由，并告知申请人享有依法申请行政复议或者提起行政诉讼的权利。
target: If a decision<v> </v>not to approve is made, the reasons shall be stated in writing, and the applicant shall be informed that he has the right to apply for administrative reconsideration or file an administrative lawsuit in accordance with the law.

source: 第二十二条注册审批部门应当自作出批准决定之日起10个工作日内，颁发、送达相应级别的注册证。
target: Article 22 The registration examination and approval department shall issue and deliver the corresponding <v>level</v> of registration certificate within 10 working days from the date of making the approval decision.

source: 第二十三条注册证的每一注册有效期为3年。
target: Article 23 The validity period of each registration of the registration certificate is 3 years.

source: 第二十三条注册证的每一注册有效期为3年。

source: 注册证在有效期内是相应级别注册消防工程师的执业凭证，由注册消防工程师本人保管、使用。
target: During the validity period of the registration certificate, it is the practice certificate of a registered fire engineer of the corresponding level, and it shall be kept and used by the registered fire engineer himself.

source: 第二十四条申请初始注册的，应当自取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书之日起1年内提出申请。
target: Article 24 Those who apply for initial registration shall apply within 1 year from the date of obtaining the <v>first-</v> and second-level registered fire engineer qualification certificates.

source: 逾期申请初始注册时，须符合本规定继续教育要求。
target: When applying for initial registration within the time limit, you must meet the continuing education requirements of these regulations.

source: 初始注册、延续注册、变更注册、注销注册和不予注册等注册管理的具体办法，由公安部另行规定。
target: The specific measures for registration management such as initial registration, renewal of registration, change of registration, cancellation of registration and non-registration shall be stipulated separately by the Ministry of Public Security.

source: 第二十五条继续教育是注册消防工程师延续注册、重新注册和逾期初始注册的必备条件。
target: Article 25 Continuing education is a necessary condition for registered fire engineers to continue their registration, re-registration, and overdue initial registration.

source: 在每个注册有效期内，各级别注册消防工程师应当按照规定完成相应的继续教育。
target: Within the validity period of each registration, registered fire engineers at all levels shall complete corresponding continuing education in accordance with regulations.

source: 第二十六条注册审批部门应当及时向社会公告注册消防工程师注册有关情况，建立注册消防工程师诚信档案，对其执业活动实行信用管理。
target: Article 26 The registration examination and approval department shall promptly announce to the public the registration of registered fire engineers, establish an integrity file of registered fire engineers, and implement credit management for their practice activities.

source: 第二十七条各级注册消防工程师资格的注册管理部门，应当严格执行《中华人民共和国行政许可法》有关规定。
target: Article 27 The registration management departments of registered fire protection engineer qualifications at all levels shall strictly implement the relevant provisions of the Administrative Licensing Law of the People's Republic of China.

source: 同年12月，陆先生就购买厂房的细节与房屋所有权人的家属林某进行磋商后，于当天通过银行转账汇款20万元作定金。

source: 林某在《厂房买卖定金收条》上作为收款人签名，其中载明，“若买方不想买此厂房，此定金归卖家，如卖方不愿意卖此厂房，定金将双倍返还卖方，双方约定一周内签订厂房买卖合同。”
target: Lin signed as the payee on the "Receipt of Deposit for Factory Sales", which stated, "If the buyer does not want to buy this factory, this deposit belongs to the seller. If the seller is unwilling to sell this factory, the deposit will be doubled. Return to the seller, and both parties agree to sign the factory sales contract within one week."

source: 然而，之后双方因厂房出售范围、付款方式等主要合同条款未能形成一致意见，导致房屋买卖合同迟迟未能签订。

source: 让大学精神与时代精神同频共振-新华网
target: <v>Achieve the same frequency and resonance</v> between university spirit and time spirit - Xinhuanet

source: 所谓大学精神，是指一所大学在发展过程中长期积淀形成的一系列办学理念和价值追求，是大学的灵魂所在。
target: The so-called university spirit refers to a series of theories on school management and value pursuit formed by a university after long-term accumulation during development, which is the spirit of a university.

source: 从古至今，大学精神对于政治、经济、文化、科技、社会的发展，乃至一个民族的进步均至关重要。
target: The university spirit is critical to the development of politics, economics, culture, science and technology and society or even progress of a nation in all ages.

source: 从世界第一所现代意义上的大学诞生起，大学就肩负起不同于其他社会组织的独特使命，对于我国大学来说，兴起于民族危难之秋，其精神更是深受传统文化和时代变迁的影响，倡导“明德济世，修齐治平”的价值理念和“兴学强国”的爱国主义担当。
target: Colleges and universities have undertaken unique mission different from other social organizations since the establishment of the first university of the modern significance; for universities and colleges in our country, they emerged during the time of stress of our country, with the spirit deeply influenced by traditional culture and time changes; the value idea of “benefitting the mankind and assisting in nation governance” and the patriotism of “developing the country through education” was advocated.

source: 当前，高等教育信息化、国际化趋势日益明显，全球范围的教育竞争、科技竞争、人才竞争不断加剧，高等教育事业作为重要的“供给侧” ， 其结构性改革正面临前所未有的机遇和挑战。
target: At present, with increasingly prominent trend of information and internationality in higher education, there are increasingly fierce education competition, science and technology competition and talent competition <v>all over the whole world</v>; as the important “supply end”, the structural reform of higher education is facing with unprecedented opportunities and challenges.

source: 尤其是《统筹推进世界一流大学和一流学科建设总体方案》的提出，在展示了我国从高等教育大国向高等教育强国迈进的信心和决心的同时，更是对大学发展提出了更高更新的要求。
target: Especially, the proposal of the General Scheme for Promoting the Construction of the Global Top Universities and the Top Subjects shows the confidence and determination of our country in developing to a giant of higher education from a big country of higher education, which proposes higher and newer requirements on development of universities.

source: 如何在较短时间内努力跻身世界一流行列，在仍有一定差距的基础上加快建成若干所世界一流大学和一批世界一流学科，实现“弯道超车” ？
target: How to rank among the best in the world with a short time, to construct global top universities and global top subjects in the condition of some differences, to realize “corner overtaking”?

source: 除了坚定目标自信、路径自信、能力自信，高校还应当充分发挥三种优势：一是后发优势，通过持续引进海外杰出学术人才，学习借鉴世界一流大学的先进经验，实现学术水平和办学质量的显著提升；二是文化优势，继承中华文明在五千年积淀的智慧内涵，弘扬发展优秀传统文化，以此来凝聚力量、塑造品牌、提升形象；三是制度优势，发挥社会主义国家的制度优越性，强化目标驱动，汇集共识合力，优化资源配置，为学校加速赶超世界先进水平提供可持续的坚实保障。
target: In addition to insisting on objective confidence, path confidence and ability confidence, universities and colleges shall also give full play to three advantages: the first one is the late-mover advantage: realizing significant improvement on academic level and school operation quality by introducing overseas excellent academic talents and learning advanced experience from global top universities; the second one is the cultural advantage: inheriting the wisdom of the Chinese civilization accumulated for five thousand years and developing excellent traditional culture, to unify strength, build brand and improve image; the third one is the system advantage: give play to the superiority of the system in the socialist country, strengthening objective driving, collecting consensus and resultant force, optimizing resource configuration, and providing sustainable and solid guarantee for the school to catch up with and surpass the world advanced standard.

source: 特别要意识到，建设世界一流大学不可能千校一面，各个学校在发挥优势的同时，必须彰显个性和特色。
target: It shall be realized that in order to construct global top universities, universities shall manifest individualities and characteristics at the same time of bringing superiority into full play.

source: 办学特色既要有共性的中国特色，也要体现各自独特的目标定位、办学传统和资源禀赋。
target: The school operation characteristics shall reflect the common Chinese characteristics and manifest unique objective location, school operation traditions and resource endowment.

source: 就浙江大学而言，我们在办学中注重突出三个方面的特色：一是突出创新创业人才培养特色，构建科教融合、校企结合的整合育人环境，形成全链条的创业教育生态系统；二是突出学科交叉会聚特色，推动学科体系的优化调整，营造学科交叉的制度环境，积极培育交叉新兴学科和标志性交叉成果；三是突出办学体系和社会服务特色，开展深度国际交流合作，加快形成泛浙大产学研合作体系。
target: With respect to Zhejiang University, features on three aspects are emphasized in school operation: the first one is to highlight the features of innovation and entrepreneurship talent training: constructing integrated teaching environment by combining science with education and combining schools and enterprises, to form the full-chain entrepreneurship education ecological system; the second one is to highlight the feature of crossed subjects: promoting optimized adjustment of subject system, building the environment of the crossed-subject system, and actively training the crossed emerging subjects and the landmark crossed achievements; the third one is to highlight the school operation system and the social service features: developing deep international exchange and cooperation and accelerating forming the industry-university-research cooperation system of Zhejiang University.

source: 在这个过程中，尤为重要的是，要始终坚守大学精神，让大学精神与时代精神同频共振。
target: During this process, the most important thing is insisting on the university spirit, to achieve the same frequency and resonance between university spirit and time spirit.

source: 对于浙江大学来说， “ 求是创新”校训， “ 勤学、修德、明辨、笃实”共同价值观以及“海纳江河、启真厚德、开物前民、树我邦国”共同构成了浙大精神的最新表述体系。
target: As for Zhejiang University, the school motto of “truth and innovation”, the common value system of “diligence, morality, discrimination and honesty” as well as “inclusiveness, reality, morality, practice and country governance” constitute the latest expression system of the spirit of Zhejiang University.

source: 这是学校坚持正确办学方向，不断积累文化高度、凝聚精神力量的重要保障，内涵丰富，意义深远。
target: This is the school operation direction and the important guarantee for cultural accumulation and mental strength, with abundant connotation and profound significance.

source: 其中， “ 海纳江河”强调的是开放包容精神，体现以“天下英才为我所用”的胸怀，表现为汲取世界名校办学育人的优质理念； “ 启真厚德”强调的是求真至善精神，指的是大学在追求真理的同时，更当领受德行的陶冶和人格的砥砺； “ 开物前民”体现的是改革创新精神，既包含知识的求新，科研的创新，又表现为改革发展，革故鼎新； “ 树我邦国”强调的是爱国奉献精神，讲的是大学应当始终与民族命运同荣共辱。
target: In which, “inclusiveness” emphasizes the spirit of inclusiveness, reflecting the mind of “inviting all talents”, expressed as adopting the good idea of school operation and talent training in world famous schools; “reality and morality” lays emphasis on the spirit of pursuit for truth and kindheartedness, meaning that universities shall pay attention to morality at the same time of pursuing for truth; “practice” reflects the spirit of reform and innovation, including innovation in knowledge and science and technology, expressed as reform, development and innovation; “country governance” lays emphasis on the spirit of love the country and contribution, saying that universities shall always share the glory and disgrace with the destiny of the country.

source: 这一系列精神理念和价值追求，正是浙江大学120年办学的灵魂所在。
target: The series of spiritual idea and value pursuit is the spirit of Zhejiang University with the history of 120 years.

source: “聪者听于无声，明者见于未形” 。

source: 中国高校当进一步立足中国特色社会主义事业全局，深刻把握高等教育事业所处的时代方位和肩负的历史使命，加快建设成为世界一流大学。

source: 新华社南宁５月１９日专电（记者张莺）记者近日从广西壮族自治区教育厅获悉，今后广西各高校将实施弹性学制，放宽大学生休学年限，在校生休学创业的年限在原有学制基础上可延长２至５年，休学创业时间可视为实践教育时间。

source: 为促进大学生创业创新能力提升，广西教育、人社等部门合力搭建创业平台，建设更多大学生校外实践教学基地、大学科技园、大学生创业园、创业孵化基地等，给大学生创业提供外在保障。
target: In order to promote the improvement of college students' entrepreneurship and innovation ability, Guangxi education, human resources and <v>social security</v> departments have joined forces to build entrepreneurship platforms, and build more off campus practice teaching bases, university science and technology parks, college students' entrepreneurship parks, entrepreneurship incubation bases, etc., to provide external guarantee for college students' entrepreneurship.

source: 同年12月，陆先生就购买厂房的细节与房屋所有权人的家属林某进行磋商后，于当天通过银行转账汇款20万元作定金。

source: 林某在《厂房买卖定金收条》上作为收款人签名，其中载明，“若买方不想买此厂房，此定金归卖家，如卖方不愿意卖此厂房，定金将双倍返还卖方，双方约定一周内签订厂房买卖合同。”
target: Lin Mou signed the Receipt for Plant Sales Deposit as the payee, which stated: "If the buyer does not want to buy the plant, the deposit shall be paid by the seller. source: 然而，之后双方因厂房出售范围、付款方式等主要合同条款未能形成一致意见，导致房屋买卖合同迟迟未能签订。
target: However, due to the failure of both parties to reach an agreement on the main contract terms such as the sales scope and payment method of the plant, the housing sales contract was delayed.

source: 考虑到双方未能就合同内容达成共识，几天后，林某将20万元定金退回给了陆先生。
target: Considering that both parties could not reach a consensus on the contents of the contract, several days later, Lin Mou returned the deposit of RMB 200,000 to Mr.Lu.

source: 好不容易看中的房子，定金交了，房款也准备好了，就差“临门一脚”签合同，卖方却不卖了，这让陆先生无奈又愤怒。
target: Mr.Lu was helpless and angry when he finally paid the deposit and the house payment was ready, and the seller refused to sell the house.

source: 为此，陆先生将林某起诉至余姚市人民法院。
target: Therefore, Mr.Lu sued <v>Lin Mou</v> to the People's Court of Yuyao.

target: After hearing, the court held that the parties finally failed to sign a formal contract, which cannot be attributed to the defendant alone and should be reasonably presumed to be a failure of negotiation. source: 第十八条公安部消防局是一级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门。
target: Article 18 The Fire Department of the Ministry of Public Security is the registration and approval department of the qualification of Level 1 registered Fire <v>Engineer</v>.

source: 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构为二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门，并负责一级注册消防工程师资格注册的初步审查工作。
target: The fire departments of the public security organs of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the Central Government are the registration and approval departments for the qualification of Level 2 registered Fire Engineers, and are responsible for the preliminary review of the qualification of registration of Level 1 registered Fire Engineers.

source: 第十九条取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书并申请注册的人员，应当受聘于一个经批准的消防技术服务机构或者消防安全重点单位，并通过聘用单位向本单位所在地(聘用单位属企业的，通过本企业向工商注册所在地)的公安机关消防机构提交注册申请材料。
target: Article 19 A person who has obtained the qualification certificate of Level 1 and Level 2 registered Fire Engineer and applies for registration shall be employed by an approved fire protection technical service institution or key fire safety unit, and the employer shall submit registration application materials to the fire protection institution of the public security organ in the place where the employer is located (if the employer is an enterprise, it shall be submitted to the place where the industrial and commercial registration is located).

source: 第二十条省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构在收到申请人的注册申请材料后，对申请材料不齐全或者不符合法定形式的，应当当场或者在5个工作日内，一次性告知申请人需要补正的全部内容，逾期不告知的，自收到申请材料之日起即为受理。
target: Article 20 After receiving the registration application materials of the applicant, the fire protection institutions of the public security organs of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government shall inform the applicant of all the contents that need to be supplemented and corrected all at once on the spot or within 5 working days if the application materials are incomplete or do not conform to the legal form; if they fail to inform within the time limit, they will be accepted from the date of receiving the application materials.

source: 对受理或者不予受理的注册申请，均应当出具加盖本级公安机关消防机构专用印章和注明日期的书面凭证。
target: For the registration applications that are accepted or rejected, a written certificate stamped with the special seal of the fire protection institution of the public security organ at the same level and date shall be issued.

source: 第二十一条省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构自受理注册申请之日起20个工作日内，按规定条件和程序完成一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料的初步审查工作和二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批工作，并将一级注册消防工程师资格注册申请材料和初步审查意见报公安部消防局审批。
target: Article 21 The fire protection institutions of the public security organs of provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government shall, within 20 working days after the date of accepting the registration application, complete the preliminary review of the application materials for the registration of the Level 1 registered Fire Engineer qualification and the registration and approval of the Level 2 registered Fire Engineer qualification according to the specified conditions and procedures, and submit the application materials for the registration of the Level 1 registered Fire Engineer qualification and the preliminary review opinions to the Fire Department of the Ministry of Public Security for approval.

source: 公安部消防局应当自收到省级公安机关消防机构报送的申请材料和初步审查意见之日起，20个工作日内作出是否批准的决定。
target: The Fire Department of the Ministry of Public Security shall make a decision on whether to approve or not within 20 working days from the date of receiving the application materials and preliminary review opinions submitted <v>by</v> the Fire Department of the provincial public security organ.

source: 在规定的期限内不能作出批准决定的，应当将延长的期限和理由告知申请人。
target: If the approval decision cannot be made within the prescribed time limit, the applicant shall be informed of the extended time limit and the <v>reason</v>.

source: 对作出不予批准决定的，应当书面说明理由，并告知申请人享有依法申请行政复议或者提起行政诉讼的权利。
target: If the decision of disapproval is made, the reasons shall be explained in writing, and the applicant shall be informed of the <v>right</v> to apply for administrative reconsideration or file an administrative lawsuit according to law.

source: 第二十二条注册审批部门应当自作出批准决定之日起10个工作日内，颁发、送达相应级别的注册证。
target: Article 22 The registration review and approval department shall issue and deliver the registration certificate of the corresponding <v>level</v> within 10 working days from the date of making the approval decision.

source: 第二十三条注册证的每一注册有效期为3年。

source: 注册证在有效期内是相应级别注册消防工程师的执业凭证，由注册消防工程师本人保管、使用。
target: The registration certificate is the practicing certificate of the registered Fire Engineer of the corresponding level within the period of validity, which is kept and used by the registered Fire Engineer themselves.

source: 第二十四条申请初始注册的，应当自取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书之日起1年内提出申请。
target: Article 24 Initial registration shall be applied within 1 year from the date of obtaining the qualification certificate of Level 1 and Level 2 registered Fire <v>Engineer</v>.

source: 逾期申请初始注册时，须符合本规定继续教育要求。

source: 教育时评:拯救被拐儿童要靠什么？
target: Education Review: What can we do to save the abducted children?

source: 如果类比“没有买卖就没有杀害”的著名公益广告语，那么，在没有“收拐”需求的良好环境里，群防群治、全民反拐，使拐卖行为无利可图、风险大、成本高，这类犯罪也就不会屡屡发生。
target: If it is analogous to the famous PSA slogan “No trade, no killing”, then in a favorable environment without the demand of “abducting”, group prevention and control, and anti-trafficking by <v>all people</v> make abductions unprofitable, risky, and expensive and hence, crimes like these won't happen again and again.

source: 近日，公安部刑事侦查局打拐办开发的儿童失踪信息紧急发布平台上线。
target: Recently, the platform for emergency release of information on missing children developed by the Criminal Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security was launched.

source: 这是为建立儿童失踪信息发布的权威渠道、及时找回被拐儿童而创设的互联网信息平台。
target: This is an Internet information platform created to establish an authoritative channel for releasing information on missing children and to retrieve abducted children in a timely manner.

source: 听闻此App名为“团圆” ， 顿觉暖意十足。
target: When I heard the name of this app called Reunion, I <v>felt a warm feeling</v>.

source: 新技术手段不仅名称“文艺” 、 情怀满满，而且信息化运用得当，实用、有效。
target: The new technology not only has <v>a name “literary and artistic</v>” and is full of feelings, but also employs appropriate information technology, and is practical and effective.

source: 打拐执法，首要目标是寻回被拐的孩子，保护其人身安全、自由。
target: The primary goal of anti-abduction law enforcement is to recover the abducted children and protect their personal safety and freedom.

source: 其次才是对嫌疑人的审判与惩罚。
target: The next step is the trial and punishment of suspects.

source: 刑事惩罚的意义，从个别惩罚、社会预防到法律教育，可以列举很多“大词” 。
target: The meaning of criminal punishment, from individual punishment, social prevention to legal education, can be enumerated in numerous “big words.”

source: 但在拐卖案件告破之前，应优先关注被害人的人身安全。
target: However, before the abduction and trafficking case is solved, priority should be given to the personal safety of the victim.

source: 事分轻重缓急，在急切的“寻救”目的之下，诸如“拐卖儿童是否应当一律死刑”之类众说纷纭、争议较大的话题，可以暂搁下来，谨慎讨论；但救助被拐儿童的事情等不得。
target: The first priority is to focus on the urgent "rescue" purpose, so the many controversial topics, such as "whether child abductees should be punished by death", can be put off for a while and discussed cautiously; however, the rescue of abducted children cannot be waited.

source: 根据此类案件的侦办经验，人贩子惯于在得手之后尽快远离作案地点。
target: Based on the experience in investigating such cases, traffickers are accustomed to leave the crime site as soon as possible after successful investigation.

source: 寻拐行动多耽搁一分钟，孩子就可能更远离家长一步，案件侦破的难度也就增加一分。
target: Delaying the kidnapping operation for one more minute will probably lead to the child being farther away from the parents and the difficulty of investigating the case will increase by a point.

source: 在此情况下，拿出如“团圆”平台这样直接有助于侦破案件、寻回孩子的有效办法，确实是务实的行动。
target: Under such circumstances, it is indeed a pragmatic action to come up with effective approaches like the “Reunion” platform that will directly help detect cases and retrieve children.

source: 在此情况下，拿出如“团圆”平台这样直接有助于侦破案件、寻回孩子的有效办法，确实是务实的行动。
target: Under such circumstances, it is indeed a pragmatic action to come up with effective approaches like the “Reunion” platform that will directly help detect cases and retrieve children.

source: 毕竟， “ 打拐”是需要运作起整个法制系统来做好的一件大任务。
target: After all, combating kidnapping is a major task that requires the operation of the entire legal system.

source: 打击犯罪、保障儿童和家长权益，从立法的完善，到司法的保障，以及执法的缜密，无不需要贯彻“护幼扶弱”的关怀。
target: In combating crimes and safeguarding the rights and interests of children and their parents, from the improvement of legislation to judicial guarantees to careful law enforcement, it is essential to implement the care of "protecting the young and helping the weak."

source: 此外，拐卖儿童的预防，从家庭到社会，都还可以做得更好。
target: In addition, child trafficking prevention, both within families and in society, can <v>be done</v> better.

source: 比如一个常见的案例，一家三口在火车站休息，父母熟睡，醒来才发现孩子不见了。
target: For example, a common case is that a family of three rested at the train station. Parents were asleep and woke up only to realize that the child was gone.

source: 不能期待一个两岁的孩子具有足够的自我保护技能，但作为年幼孩子的家长，应至少具有相当的保护意识。
target: A two-year-old cannot be expected to have sufficient self-protective skills, but as a parent of a younger child one should have at least a considerable sense of protection.

source: 父母两人轮流休息，又或将孩子置于稳妥的保护之下，都是预防儿童被拐的最起码手段。
target: Taking turns between parents or placing children under secure protection are minimal steps for preventing child abductions.

source: 父母两人轮流休息，又或将孩子置于稳妥的保护之下，都是预防儿童被拐的最起码手段。
target: Taking turns between parents or placing children under secure protection are minimal steps for preventing child abductions.

source: 从警方打击拐卖犯罪的另一面看，购买被拐儿童一方也应被关注和惩治。
target: From the other side of the police's fight against abduction and child trafficking, the party buying abducted children should also be paid attention and punished.

source: 单个的不法行为，往往只是长长链条中的一环。
target: A single wrongful act is often just one link in a long chain.

source: 根据我国《刑法》规定，拐卖儿童罪的法定刑起刑点为5年；情节特别严重的，可至死刑，并处没收财产。
target: According to China's “Criminal Law”, the statutory penalty for abducting and trafficking children is five years; if the circumstances are particularly serious, the sentence can lead to death and confiscation of property.

source: 起刑点高、最高刑重，在“轻刑化”的大趋势下，拐卖儿童罪显然属于处罚较重的罪。
target: The penalization point is high and the maximum punishment is severe. Under the general trend of "light punishment", the crime of child trafficking is obviously a crime with heavier punishment.

source: 可至今每年仍还有不少的拐卖案件发生。
target: However, many cases of human trafficking still occur every year.

source: 可见，部分人在养育儿女方面的观念落后，法律意识淡薄。
target: It can be seen that some people have backward concepts on raising children and their legal awareness is weak.

source: 可见，部分人在养育儿女方面的观念落后，法律意识淡薄。
target: It can be seen that some people have backward concepts on raising children and their legal awareness is weak.

source: 对这部分人的法制教育应该同步跟进。
target: Legal education for this segment of people should be followed up simultaneously.

source: 要有效控制拐卖犯罪，不能仅靠官方严格执法。
target: To effectively control the crime of trafficking, we cannot rely solely on strict legal enforcement by officials.

source: 倘若收拐“市场”广泛存在，拐卖者利欲熏心，不断创新拐卖手段，形成与执法者的“斗法”局面，打拐行动势必会陷入低效的泥淖。
target: If the “market” for abduction and trafficking is widespread, traders become obsessed with self-interest, constantly innovate means of trafficking, creating a “fighting” situation with law enforcement officers, and anti-trafficking operations will inevitably fall into an inefficient <v>mess</v>.

source: 因此，破除落后观念，普及法律常识，也有助于根治拐卖、收买儿童犯罪。
target: Therefore, breaking the backward concepts and popularizing legal knowledge will also help to eliminate the crime of kidnapping and buying children.

target: In September 2020, Mr. Lu learned about a factory in Zhangting Town, Yuyao, Zhejiang Province from a housing agent. After many on-site visits, Mr. Lu decided to buy the factory.

source: 同年12月，陆先生就购买厂房的细节与房屋所有权人的家属林某进行磋商后，于当天通过银行转账汇款20万元作定金。
target: In December of the same year, Mr. Lu negotiated with Lin, the family member of the house owner, on the details of the purchase of the factory, and remitted 200,000 <v>yuan</v> as a deposit through bank transfer on the same day.

source: 林某在《厂房买卖定金收条》上作为收款人签名，其中载明，“若买方不想买此厂房，此定金归卖家，如卖方不愿意卖此厂房，定金将双倍返还卖方，双方约定一周内签订厂房买卖合同。”
target: Lin signed as the payee on the "receipt of deposit for the sale of factory building", which stated, "If the buyer does not want to buy the factory, the deposit belongs to the seller. If the seller is unwilling to sell the factory, the deposit will be returned to the seller twice, and the two parties agreed to sign the plant sales contract within one week."

source: 然而，之后双方因厂房出售范围、付款方式等主要合同条款未能形成一致意见，导致房屋买卖合同迟迟未能签订。
target: However, after that, the two parties failed to reach an agreement on the main contract terms such as the scope of plant sale and payment method, which led to the delay in signing the house sale contract.

source: 考虑到双方未能就合同内容达成共识，几天后，林某将20万元定金退回给了陆先生。
target: Considering that the two sides failed to reach a consensus on the content of the contract, a few days later, Lin returned the deposit of 200,000 <v>yuan</v> to Mr. Lu.

source: 好不容易看中的房子，定金交了，房款也准备好了，就差“临门一脚”签合同，卖方却不卖了，这让陆先生无奈又愤怒。
target: It was not easy to take a fancy to the house, the deposit was paid, and the house payment was ready, so <v>I</v> was "close to the door" to sign the contract, but the seller did not sell it, which made Mr. Lu helpless and angry.

target: It was not easy to take a fancy to the house, the deposit was paid, and the house payment was ready, so I was "<v>close to the door</v>" to sign the contract, but the seller did not sell it, which made Mr. Lu helpless and angry.

source: 为此，陆先生将林某起诉至余姚市人民法院。
target: To this end, Mr. Lu sued Lin to the Yuyao People's Court.

source: 法院经审理认为，双方最终未能签订正式合同，不能仅归责于被告，应合理推定为磋商不成，故本案不应适用定金罚则，被告无需承担双倍返还定金的违约责任。
target: After trial, the court held that the failure of the two parties to sign a formal contract could not only be attributed to the defendant, but should be reasonably presumed that the negotiation failed. target: Education Commentary: What does it take to save an abducted child?

source: 如果类比“没有买卖就没有杀害”的著名公益广告语，那么，在没有“收拐”需求的良好环境里，群防群治、全民反拐，使拐卖行为无利可图、风险大、成本高，这类犯罪也就不会屡屡发生。
target: If the famous public service announcement "No sale, no kill" is an analogy, then in a good environment without the need to "collect abduction", group prevention and anti-trafficking, so that the abduction is not profitable, risky and costly, this type of crime will not repeatedly occur. The actual fact is that the actual fact is that the particulars of the <v>actuals are not the same as the actuals of the actuals</v>.

source: 近日，公安部刑事侦查局打拐办开发的儿童失踪信息紧急发布平台上线。
target: Recently, the Ministry of Public Security Criminal Investigation Bureau of the Office of the fight against trafficking in children developed the emergency release platform for missing children information online.

source: 这是为建立儿童失踪信息发布的权威渠道、及时找回被拐儿童而创设的互联网信息平台。
target: This is an Internet information platform created to establish an authoritative channel for the release of missing child information and the timely recovery of abducted children.

source: 听闻此App名为“团圆” ， 顿觉暖意十足。
target: Hearing that the app is called "Reunion", I felt a warm feeling.

source: 新技术手段不仅名称“文艺” 、 情怀满满，而且信息化运用得当，实用、有效。
target: The new technology means not only the name "literary", full of emotion, and the proper use of information technology, practical, effective.

source: 打拐执法，首要目标是寻回被拐的孩子，保护其人身安全、自由。
target: The primary goal of law enforcement is to find the abducted children and protect their personal safety and freedom.

source: 其次才是对嫌疑人的审判与惩罚。
target: The second is the trial and punishment of the suspect.

source: 刑事惩罚的意义，从个别惩罚、社会预防到法律教育，可以列举很多“大词” 。
target: The meaning of criminal punishment, from individual punishment, social prevention to legal education, can be listed in many "big words".

source: 但在拐卖案件告破之前，应优先关注被害人的人身安全。
target: But before the case of trafficking is solved, the priority should be to focus on the personal safety of the victim.

source: 事分轻重缓急，在急切的“寻救”目的之下，诸如“拐卖儿童是否应当一律死刑”之类众说纷纭、争议较大的话题，可以暂搁下来，谨慎讨论；但救助被拐儿童的事情等不得。
target: The matter is divided into priorities, in the urgent "rescue" purpose, such as "whether child abduction and trafficking should be all death penalty" and other controversial topics, can be set aside, cautious discussion; but the rescue of abducted children <v>can not</v> wait.

source: 根据此类案件的侦办经验，人贩子惯于在得手之后尽快远离作案地点。
target: According to the experience of investigating such cases, traffickers are used to get away from the place of crime as soon as possible after getting their hands on them.

source: 寻拐行动多耽搁一分钟，孩子就可能更远离家长一步，案件侦破的难度也就增加一分。
target: The search for the abduction operation is delayed for one more minute, the child may be one step further away from the parents, and the difficulty of solving the case will increase by one.

source: 在此情况下，拿出如“团圆”平台这样直接有助于侦破案件、寻回孩子的有效办法，确实是务实的行动。
target: In this case, come up with such as "reunion" platform directly help to solve the case, to find the child effective way, is indeed a pragmatic action.

source: 毕竟， “ 打拐”是需要运作起整个法制系统来做好的一件大任务。
target: After all, "anti-trafficking" is a big task that requires the operation of the entire legal system to do a good job.

source: 打击犯罪、保障儿童和家长权益，从立法的完善，到司法的保障，以及执法的缜密，无不需要贯彻“护幼扶弱”的关怀。
target: To combat crime and protect the rights and interests of children and parents, from the improvement of legislation, to the judicial protection, as well as the meticulous enforcement of the law, all need to implement the "protection of the young and the weak" care.

source: 此外，拐卖儿童的预防，从家庭到社会，都还可以做得更好。
target: In addition, the prevention of child trafficking, from the family to society, can do better.

source: 比如一个常见的案例，一家三口在火车站休息，父母熟睡，醒来才发现孩子不见了。
target: For example, a common case, a family of three resting in a train station, the parents asleep, only to wake up to find the child missing.

source: 不能期待一个两岁的孩子具有足够的自我保护技能，但作为年幼孩子的家长，应至少具有相当的保护意识。
target: A two-year-old child cannot be expected to have adequate self-protection skills, but as the parents of a young child, should have at least a fair sense of protection.

source: 父母两人轮流休息，又或将孩子置于稳妥的保护之下，都是预防儿童被拐的最起码手段。
target: The two parents take turns to rest, or put the child under secure protection, are the minimum means to prevent children from being abducted.

source: 从警方打击拐卖犯罪的另一面看，购买被拐儿童一方也应被关注和惩治。
target: From the other side of the police fight against the crime of abduction, the party who buys the abducted children should also be concerned and punished.

source: 单个的不法行为，往往只是长长链条中的一环。
target: A single <v>wrongdoing</v> is often just one link in a long chain.

source: 根据我国《刑法》规定，拐卖儿童罪的法定刑起刑点为5年；情节特别严重的，可至死刑，并处没收财产。
target: According to China's Criminal Law, the statutory penalty for the crime of child abduction and sale starts at five years; in particularly serious cases, up to the death penalty, and confiscation of property.

source: 起刑点高、最高刑重，在“轻刑化”的大趋势下，拐卖儿童罪显然属于处罚较重的罪。
target: The starting point is high, the maximum penalty is heavy, in the general trend of "<v>lightening</v>", the crime of child abduction and sale is obviously a heavier punishment of crime.

source: 可至今每年仍还有不少的拐卖案件发生。
target: However, there are still many cases of abduction and trafficking occurring every year.

source: 可见，部分人在养育儿女方面的观念落后，法律意识淡薄。
target: This shows that some people are backward in the concept of raising children and have little legal awareness.

source: 对这部分人的法制教育应该同步跟进。
target: The legal education for this part of the population should be followed up simultaneously.

source: 要有效控制拐卖犯罪，不能仅靠官方严格执法。
target: To effectively control the crime of abduction and trafficking, we cannot rely only on strict official law enforcement.

source: 倘若收拐“市场”广泛存在，拐卖者利欲熏心，不断创新拐卖手段，形成与执法者的“斗法”局面，打拐行动势必会陷入低效的泥淖。
target: If the abduction "market" is widespread, the traffickers lust for profit, constantly innovate the means of abduction, the formation of "fighting" situation with law enforcement, the anti-trafficking action is bound to fall into the quagmire of inefficiency.

source: 因此，破除落后观念，普及法律常识，也有助于根治拐卖、收买儿童犯罪。
target: Therefore, to break the backward concept, the popularization of common sense laws, but also to help eradicate the crime of trafficking and buying children.

source: 省、自治区、直辖市公安机关消防机构为二级注册消防工程师资格的注册审批部门，并负责一级注册消防工程师资格注册的初步审查工作。

source: 第十九条取得一级、二级注册消防工程师资格证书并申请注册的人员，应当受聘于一个经批准的消防技术服务机构或者消防安全重点单位，并通过聘用单位向本单位所在地(聘用单位属企业的，通过本企业向工商注册所在地)的公安机关消防机构提交注册申请材料。

source: 所谓大学精神，是指一所大学在发展过程中长期积淀形成的一系列办学理念和价值追求，是大学的灵魂所在。

source: 从古至今，大学精神对于政治、经济、文化、科技、社会的发展，乃至一个民族的进步均至关重要。
target: From ancient times to the present, university spirit is of great importance to the development of politics, economy, culture, science and technology, society, and even the progress of a nation.

source: 从世界第一所现代意义上的大学诞生起，大学就肩负起不同于其他社会组织的独特使命，对于我国大学来说，兴起于民族危难之秋，其精神更是深受传统文化和时代变迁的影响，倡导“明德济世，修齐治平”的价值理念和“兴学强国”的爱国主义担当。
target: Since the birth of the world's first university in a modern sense, universities have shouldered a unique mission different from other social organizations. For Chinese universities, which rose in the autumn of national crisis, their spirit is deeply affected by traditional culture and the changes of the times, advocating the value concept of "serving the world with virtue, <v>cultivating Qi</v> and governing peace" and the patriotic responsibility of "building a strong country with learning."

source: 当前，高等教育信息化、国际化趋势日益明显，全球范围的教育竞争、科技竞争、人才竞争不断加剧，高等教育事业作为重要的“供给侧” ， 其结构性改革正面临前所未有的机遇和挑战。

source: 如何在较短时间内努力跻身世界一流行列，在仍有一定差距的基础上加快建成若干所世界一流大学和一批世界一流学科，实现“弯道超车” ？

source: 越南人民报网- 越南政府总理范明正出席第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛
target: Vietnamese People's Daily Network-Vietnamese Prime Minister Fan Mingzheng attended the third Vietnam National Digital Technology Enterprise Development Forum

source: 第三次越南国家数字技术企业发展论坛期间举行两场主要会议，讨论议题围绕着数字技术企业与国家数字化转型、数字技术企业与新冠肺炎疫情中和疫情后经济复苏与发展两大主题。
target: Two major meetings were held during the third Vietnam National Digital Technology Enterprise Development Forum, and the discussion topics focused on two major themes: digital technology enterprises and the country's digital transformation, digital technology enterprises and economic recovery and development during and after the COVID-19 epidemic.

source: 通信传媒部部长阮孟雄表示，2021年，尽管新冠肺炎疫情持续蔓延，但越南数字技术企业的数量和营业收入仍保持增长势头，达近10 % 。
target: Nguyen Mengxiong, Minister of Communications and Media, said that in 2021, despite the continued spread of the COVID-19 epidemic, the number and operating income of digital technology enterprises in Vietnam continued to grow by nearly 10%.

source: 2021年，越南典型数字产品数量耕作，集中解决越南面临的各大难题，许多数字产品已走出国门，越南数字技术排名已提升。
target: In 2021, Vietnam cultivated the number of typical digital products, focusing on solving the major problems faced by Vietnam. Many digital products have gone abroad, and Vietnam's digital technology ranking has been improved.

source: 阮孟雄部长呼吁数字技术企业负起发展国家数字化转型平台的责任，担当发展这些国家数字平台的任务就是担当国家使命。
target: Minister Nguyen Meng-hsiung called on digital technology enterprises to take the <v>responsibility</v> of developing national digital transformation platforms, and the task of developing these national digital platforms is to assume the national mission.

source: 在论坛上，各部门和国家机关领导，正在研究、发展、应用、转让数字技术的企业、组织和个人分享了动员和汇集全社会资源来发展越南技术企业，携手推动国家数字化转型，朱慧疫情后经济复苏等的各突破性设想和解决方案。
target: At the forum, leaders of various departments and state organs, enterprises, organizations and individuals who are researching, developing, applying and transferring digital technology shared breakthrough ideas and solutions to mobilize and pool the resources of the whole society to develop Vietnamese technology enterprises, jointly promote the country's digital transformation, and <v>Zhu Hui's</v> economic recovery after the epidemic.

source: 范明正总理在论坛上发表讲话时强调，数字化转型是世界必由之路，是发展的客观需求。
target: In his speech at the forum, Premier Fan Mingzheng stressed that digital transformation is the only way for the world and the objective demand of development.

source: 数字化转型已成为全球性问题，数字化转型服务全民，因此需动员全民参与。
target: Digital transformation has become a global problem, and digital transformation serves the whole people, so it is necessary to mobilize the <v>whole people</v> to participate.

source: 人民和企业是数字化转型的核心、主体、目标和动力。
target: People and enterprises are the core, subject, goal and driving force of digital transformation.

source: 因此，一切政策需为了人民和企业。
target: Therefore, all policies need to be for people and enterprises.

source: 范明正总理强调，数字化转型需体现民族精神，需以内力为主、战略、长期和决定性因素，外力为重要和突破口。
target: Premier Fan Mingzheng stressed that digital transformation needs to reflect the national spirit, with internal forces as the main, strategic, long-term and decisive factors, and external forces as important and breakthrough points.

source: 他同时认为，数字化转型需驱动向纵深发展和可持续发展，参与新冠肺炎疫情防控、经济复苏和发展、应对其后变化、克服自然资源枯竭现象，助力绿色转型、发展绿色能源。
target: At the same time, he believes that digital transformation needs to drive in-depth development and sustainable development, participate in COVID-19 epidemic prevention and control, economic recovery and development, cope with subsequent changes, overcome the depletion of natural resources, and help green transformation and development of green energy.

source: 数字化转型需参与保护和弘扬有关国家文化价值、历史传统、国家风土人情等的数据库建立工作，推动银行、税务、土地管理和开发数据库以及物流等领域数字化转型。
target: Digital transformation needs to participate in the establishment of databases to protect and carry forward national cultural values, historical traditions, national customs, etc., and promote digital transformation in banking, taxation, land management and development databases, as well as logistics and other fields.

source: 数字化转型的最大目标是让人民更幸福，国家日益繁荣发展。
target: The biggest goal of digital transformation is to make people happier and the country increasingly prosperous.

source: 范明正总理要求各级政府、各级机关和企业在发展数字技术中需加大领导和指导力度，提高对数字化转型的认识，继续制定和完善关于数字化转型的体制，加强国家管理度和本着尊重、沟通、倾听、积极和主动的精神上推动对数字技术企业发展。
target: Premier Fan Mingzheng asked governments, organs and enterprises at all levels to strengthen leadership and guidance in the development of digital technology, improve their understanding of digital transformation, continue to formulate and improve the system on digital transformation, strengthen national management and promote the development of digital technology enterprises in the spirit of respect, communication, listening, <v>initiative and initiative</v>.

source: 论坛期间，范明正总理出席了2021年“越南制造”优秀数字产品奖颁奖仪式及“越南制造”数字产品展开幕式。
target: During the forum, Premier Fan Mingzheng attended the award ceremony of the 2021"Made in Vietnam" Excellent Digital Product Award and the opening ceremony of the "Made in Vietnam" Digital Product Exhibition.

source: 教育时评:拯救被拐儿童要靠什么？
target: Education Review: What does it take to save abducted children?

source: 如果类比“没有买卖就没有杀害”的著名公益广告语，那么，在没有“收拐”需求的良好环境里，群防群治、全民反拐，使拐卖行为无利可图、风险大、成本高，这类犯罪也就不会屡屡发生。
target: If we compare the famous public service slogan of "no sale, no killing", then in a good environment where there is no demand for "abduction", mass prevention and control, and anti-abduction by the whole people make abduction unprofitable, risky and costly, and such crimes will not happen frequently.

source: 近日，公安部刑事侦查局打拐办开发的儿童失踪信息紧急发布平台上线。
target: Recently, the emergency release platform for missing children information developed by the Criminal Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security was launched.

source: 这是为建立儿童失踪信息发布的权威渠道、及时找回被拐儿童而创设的互联网信息平台。
target: This is an Internet information platform created to establish an authoritative channel for the release of missing children information and find abducted children in a timely manner.

source: 听闻此App名为“团圆” ， 顿觉暖意十足。
target: Hearing that this App is called "Reunion", I feel warm.

source: 新技术手段不仅名称“文艺” 、 情怀满满，而且信息化运用得当，实用、有效。
target: The new technical means are not only named "literature and art" and full of feelings, <v>but also</v> the information technology is used properly, practically and effective.

source: 打拐执法，首要目标是寻回被拐的孩子，保护其人身安全、自由。
target: The primary goal of anti-abduction law enforcement is to find abducted children and protect their personal safety and freedom.

source: 其次才是对嫌疑人的审判与惩罚。
target: The second is the trial and punishment of suspects.

source: 刑事惩罚的意义，从个别惩罚、社会预防到法律教育，可以列举很多“大词” 。
target: The meaning of criminal punishment, from individual punishment, social prevention to legal education, <v>can list</v> many "big words".

source: 但在拐卖案件告破之前，应优先关注被害人的人身安全。
target: However, before the trafficking case is solved, priority should be given to the personal safety of the victims.

source: 事分轻重缓急，在急切的“寻救”目的之下，诸如“拐卖儿童是否应当一律死刑”之类众说纷纭、争议较大的话题，可以暂搁下来，谨慎讨论；但救助被拐儿童的事情等不得。
target: Under the urgent purpose of "seeking rescue", controversial topics such as "whether child abduction and trafficking should be subject to the death penalty" can be put on hold and discussed carefully; but the rescue of abducted children cannot wait.

source: 事分轻重缓急，在急切的“寻救”目的之下，诸如“拐卖儿童是否应当一律死刑”之类众说纷纭、争议较大的话题，可以暂搁下来，谨慎讨论；但救助被拐儿童的事情等不得。
target: Under the urgent purpose of "seeking rescue", controversial topics such as "whether child abduction and trafficking should be subject to the death penalty" can be put on hold and discussed carefully; but the rescue of abducted children cannot wait.

source: 根据此类案件的侦办经验，人贩子惯于在得手之后尽快远离作案地点。
target: According to the investigation experience of such cases, traffickers are used to staying away from the crime <v>site</v> as soon as possible after they succeed.

source: 寻拐行动多耽搁一分钟，孩子就可能更远离家长一步，案件侦破的难度也就增加一分。
target: If the abduction search is delayed for one more minute, the child may be one step away from the parents, and the difficulty of case detection will increase by one point.

source: 在此情况下，拿出如“团圆”平台这样直接有助于侦破案件、寻回孩子的有效办法，确实是务实的行动。
target: Under such circumstances, it is indeed a pragmatic action to come up with effective methods such as the "reunion" platform, which directly help to solve cases and find children.

source: 毕竟， “ 打拐”是需要运作起整个法制系统来做好的一件大任务。
target: After all, "anti-abduction" is a big task that requires the operation of the entire legal system.

source: 打击犯罪、保障儿童和家长权益，从立法的完善，到司法的保障，以及执法的缜密，无不需要贯彻“护幼扶弱”的关怀。
target: To crack down on crime and protect the rights and interests of children and parents, from the improvement of legislation, to the protection of <v>justice</v> and the meticulous law enforcement, we all need to implement the care of "protecting the young and helping the weak".

source: 此外，拐卖儿童的预防，从家庭到社会，都还可以做得更好。
target: In addition, the prevention of child trafficking, from the family to society, can be done better.

source: 比如一个常见的案例，一家三口在火车站休息，父母熟睡，醒来才发现孩子不见了。
target: For example, in a common case, a family of three resting at the railway station, their parents slept soundly and woke up to find that their child was gone.

source: 不能期待一个两岁的孩子具有足够的自我保护技能，但作为年幼孩子的家长，应至少具有相当的保护意识。
target: A two-year-old child cannot be expected to have enough self-protection skills, but as <v>a parent</v> of a young child, he should at least have a considerable sense of protection.

source: 不能期待一个两岁的孩子具有足够的自我保护技能，但作为年幼孩子的家长，应至少具有相当的保护意识。
target: A two-year-old child cannot be expected to have enough self-protection skills, but as a parent of a young child, <v>he</v> should at least have a considerable sense of protection.

source: 父母两人轮流休息，又或将孩子置于稳妥的保护之下，都是预防儿童被拐的最起码手段。
target: Parents take turns to rest, or put their children under safe protection, are the minimum means to prevent children from being abducted.

source: 从警方打击拐卖犯罪的另一面看，购买被拐儿童一方也应被关注和惩治。
target: From the other side of the police's crackdown on trafficking crimes, the party who buys abducted children should also be paid attention to and punished.

source: 单个的不法行为，往往只是长长链条中的一环。
target: A single illegal act is often just a link in a long chain.

source: 根据我国《刑法》规定，拐卖儿童罪的法定刑起刑点为5年；情节特别严重的，可至死刑，并处没收财产。
target: According to the provisions of China's Criminal Law, the legal starting point for the crime of abducting and trafficking in children is 5 years; if the circumstances are especially serious, they may be sentenced to death and confiscation of property.

source: 起刑点高、最高刑重，在“轻刑化”的大趋势下，拐卖儿童罪显然属于处罚较重的罪。
target: The starting point is high and the maximum punishment is heavy. Under the general trend of "light punishment", the crime of abducting and trafficking in children obviously belongs to the crime of heavier punishment.

source: 可至今每年仍还有不少的拐卖案件发生。
target: But there are still many cases of abduction and trafficking every year.

source: 可见，部分人在养育儿女方面的观念落后，法律意识淡薄。
target: It can be seen that some people have backward concepts and weak legal awareness in raising children.

source: 对这部分人的法制教育应该同步跟进。
target: The legal education of these people should be followed up at the same time.

source: 要有效控制拐卖犯罪，不能仅靠官方严格执法。
target: To effectively control the crime of abduction and trafficking, we cannot rely solely on strict official law enforcement.

source: 倘若收拐“市场”广泛存在，拐卖者利欲熏心，不断创新拐卖手段，形成与执法者的“斗法”局面，打拐行动势必会陷入低效的泥淖。
target: If the "market" of abduction exists widely, the traffickers are greedy for profit, constantly innovate the means of abduction, and form a situation of "<v>fighting law</v>" with law enforcers, the anti-abduction action is bound to fall into the quagmire of inefficiency.

source: 因此，破除落后观念，普及法律常识，也有助于根治拐卖、收买儿童犯罪。
target: Therefore, getting rid of backward concepts and popularizing legal common sense will also help to eradicate the crime of abduction, trafficking and buying children.

source: 激光电视和传统电视在市场定位上有何差异？
target: What is the difference between laser TVs and traditional TVs in terms of market positioning?

source: 以我的理解，题主所说的传统电视应该指的就是液晶电视，而激光电视和液晶电视在市场定位上的差异，主要有以下两点：
target: In my opinion, the traditional TV the topic refers to is LCD TV, and the difference in market positioning between laser TV and LCD TV mainly comes from the following two points:

source: 第一，激光电视更聚焦大屏市场。
target: First, laser TVs are focused more on the large-screen market.

source: 相比液晶电视全面铺开的市场定位，激光电视显然更聚焦大屏市场，或者说激光电视本身就是为大屏而生的产物。
target: Compared with the market positioning of LCD TVs, laser TVs are clearly more focused on the large-screen market, or laser TVs themselves are products made for large screens.

source: 目前，主流液晶电视尺寸多在55英寸到65英寸，而激光电视的尺寸一般在75英寸以上，最大的超过100英寸，充分满足用户对大屏彩电的需求。
target: At present, the size of mainstream LCD TVs is mostly from 55 to 65 inches, while those of laser TVs are generally over 75 inches and the largest is over 100 inches, fully satisfying users' needs for large-screen color televisions.

source: 近年来，激光电视在全球的出货量和销量占比都在不断增加，在80英寸及以上总体电视销量中占比超六成。
target: In recent years, global shipments and sales volume of laser TVs have been continuously increasing, accounting for over 60% of total TV sales of 80 inches and above.

source: 近年来，激光电视在全球的出货量和销量占比都在不断增加，在80英寸及以上总体电视销量中占比超六成。
target: In recent years, global shipments and sales volume of laser TVs have been continuously increasing, accounting for over 60% of total TV sales of 80 inches and above.

source: 根据中怡康的预测，2020年，激光电视市场销量增长将超过140%，继续保持高速增长。
target: According to <v>CMC's</v> forecast, sales volume of the laser TV market will increase by more than 140% in 2020, continuing to maintain rapid growth.

source: 之所以在大屏市场有如此好的成绩，主要归功于激光电视在护眼方面的出色表现。
target: The reason why laser TV has such good results in the big screen market is mainly due to its outstanding performance in eye protection.

source: 基于激光电视漫反射的成像原理，激光光源发出的光线并不直射入眼球，相比液晶电视的背光源发光，成像过程更接近自然条件下物体的成像过程，对眼睛产生的刺激也更小。
target: Compared with the backlight of LCD TV, the imaging process is closer to the imaging process of objects under natural conditions and causes less irritation to the eyes.

source: 中国电子技术标准化研究院赛西实验室和北京协和医院眼科专家，通过人群相同条件下观看激光电视和液晶电视的严格对比试验，得出了144组测试数据。
target: Saixi Laboratory of China Electronics Technology Institute and an eye expert from Beijing Union medical institution have obtained 144 sets of test data through a strict comparative experiment in which people watched laser TVs and LCD TVs under the same conditions.

source: 数据证实：激光电视的确具有很强的护眼特性，在特定方面甚至具有一定的改善作用。
target: It has been confirmed by the data that laser TVs indeed have strong eye protection properties, and even have some improvement in certain aspects.

source: 在视力健康越来越受重视的当下，激光电视不仅凭借护眼优势吸引了越来越多用户，也打开了彩电市场的另一个突破口。
target: At a time when eye health has received more and more importance, laser TVs not only attract more and more users by its advantages of eye protection, but also open up another breakthrough in the color TV market.

source: 第二，激光电视更聚焦高端市场。
target: Second, laser TVs are more focused on the high-end market.

source: 与液晶电视价格不断下探相反，目前市售激光电视的价格大多在万元以上，随着尺寸和光源的升级，价格逐步攀升。
target: Contrary to the continuous decline of prices for LCD TVs, prizes of most laser TVs currently on the market exceed 10,000 yuan and are gradually rising as size and light sources are upgraded.

source: 激光电视凭什么卖这么贵呢？
target: Why are laser TVs so expensive?

source: 肯定是有道理的。
target: It certainly makes sense.

source: 在光源和技术水平的不断发展下，激光电视有很多液晶电视和投影都无法实现的优势。
target: With the continuous development of light sources and technology, laser TV has many advantages that cannot be achieved by LCD TV or projection.

source: 凭借超短焦距投影技术，激光电视的投影距离相对传统投影设备来说要更短，能够在短距离内实现100英寸大屏体验，<v>所需空间不大，而且主机小巧，占用地方很小</v>。
target: With the use of ultra-short focus projection technology, laser TVs achieve a shorter projection distance compared with traditional projection devices, and allow for the ability to experience a large 100-inch screen within a short distance.

source: 在亮度方面，大品牌激光电视可以达到2000以上的流明。
target: In terms of brightness, big-brand laser TVs can reach more than 2000 lumens.

source: 加之发热量更低，对设备损耗小，电视的使用寿命也更长。
target: In addition, it generates less heat, less wear to the equipment, and the lifespan of the TV is longer.

source: 除此之外，很多高端激光电视机型还搭载了真4K超高清画质、人工智能系统、仿生屏等众多前沿技术，能够给用户带来更震撼的视听体验。
target: In addition, many high-end laser TV models are also equipped with many cutting-edge technologies such as equivalent 4K UHD image quality, artificial intelligence systems, and bionic screens, which can bring more impressive visual experience to users.

source: 谈不上伪需求，而是需求细分的产物，论画质和投入产出比，激光电视不是影音玩家的菜，<v>想兼顾大屏和观看环境不足，可以尝试，凡事皆有利弊，权衡过后自己判断即可，就怕听信一面之词</v>。
target: It's not pseudo-demand, but a product of demand segmentation. For picture quality and input-output ratio, Laser TV is not just for audiovisual players.

source: 简单说，超广角近焦投影机--激光电视，为了贴近幕布，不得不使用价格昂贵的超广角透镜和反射镜，这不符合光学最佳设计。
target: Simply put, ultra wide-angle near-focus projectors, laser TVs, have to use expensive ultra-wide-angle lenses and reflectors in order to get close to the screen, which are not in line with optics' optimal design.

source: 为了屏蔽部分环境光，使用微结构的菲涅尔幕布，代价高昂，80寸的价格基本能换个65寸液晶。
target: Using a microstructured Fresnel curtain in order to shield part of the ambient light is expensive, and a 80-inch LCD can be basically replaced by a 65-inch LCD.

source: 还有一点，我特别讨厌投影厂商拿漫反射对眼睛好这种当卖点，拜托，眼睛能够看到的幕布上的光线对于眼睛而言就是直射光，<v>你漫反射到天花板上，眼睛也看不到，非要较真液晶电视也是漫“直射”，打开电视天花板不也被照亮吗</v>？
target: Another point is that I particularly hate the idea of the diffuse reflection being nice to the eyes, because it is a selling point for projector manufacturers. Please, what the eyes can see on the screen is the direct light.

source: 而且，投影幕布如果不是漫反射，根本成不了像。

target: However, Zhang Zhongmou, the founder of TSMC, was dismissive of Intel's decision.

source: 在今年四月举行的“2021大师智库论坛”上，张忠谋语出惊人，对于英特尔斥资建晶圆厂这个举动，张忠谋毫无顾忌直言：英特尔建芯片代工厂，相当讽刺。
target: At the "2021 Masters Think Tank Forum" held in April this year, Zhang Zhongmou made a surprising statement, and he had no scruples about Intel's investment in building a fab. He said bluntly: Intel is building a chip foundry, which is quite ironic.

source: 张忠谋之所以对英特尔进军晶圆领域颇为不屑，是因为张忠谋对30多年前台积电与英特尔的一段恩怨依然耿耿于怀。
target: The reason why Zhang Zhongmou is disdainful of Intel's entry into the wafer field is that Zhang Zhongmou is still resentful of a grudge between the <v>front office</v> and Intel for more than 30 years.

target: In the 1960s and 1970s, Intel has always been the pearl of the manufacturing industry in the United States, the peak of the world, and the world leader in the semiconductor field.

target: At that time, the semiconductor industry was characterized by the IDM model, and chips were designed, manufactured, and tested by a single factory. Intel was the representative of that era.

source: 然而这样的模式让一些小企业不堪重负，很多半导体创业者面对巨额的产线建设费用只能望而却步。

target: 3,200 new born babies in Sabah have no birth certificate due to out of stock of special anti-counterfeiting paper

source: （亚庇<v>11日讯</v>）沙巴国民登记局说，由于特制防伪纸存货用光，所以自10月初开始就无法颁发报生纸给初生婴儿，至今累积的受影响者达3200人。
target: KOTA KINABALU: The Sabah National Registration Department said that due to the shortage of special anti-counterfeiting papers, it has not been able to issue birth certificates to newborn babies since the beginning of October, and the cumulative number of affected people has reached 3,200.

source: 不过，该局主任凯鲁阿米努斯保证，所有已经申请报生纸的婴儿，资料已经记录在系统，当防伪纸在下周运到后就会补发。
target: However, the director of the bureau, Kairou Aminus, assured that all the babies who have applied for birth certificates have been recorded in the system and will be reissued when the anti-counterfeiting papers arrive next week.

source: 他在新闻发布会上，针对一家网媒指沙巴报生纸印制问题出现长达10个月的报导，作出解释。
target: At a press conference, he explained a 10-month-long report by an online media that the issue of printing paper for Sabah <v>newspapers</v>.

source: 他说，有关问题在2个月前就出现，砂拉越也面对同样的问题。
target: He said that the problem arose two months ago, and Sarawak is also facing the same problem.

source: “其中一个原因是生产特制防伪纸的中国厂家受疫情影响，导致延迟运抵我国。 ”
target: One of the reasons is that Chinese manufacturers that produce special anti-counterfeiting paper have been affected by the epidemic, resulting in delayed shipments to our country.

source: 他解释，沙巴报生纸使用的防伪纸和其他地区不同，因此不能<v>商</v>借其他州属的存货。
target: He explained that the anti-counterfeiting paper used in Sabah birth papers is different from other regions, so it is not possible to borrow stocks from other states.

source: 凯鲁阿米努斯透露，最新一批防伪纸已经于本月6日运抵吉隆坡，过后于8日交给印刷公司，进行部分印制工作。
target: Kairou Aminus revealed that the latest batch of anti-counterfeiting paper has arrived in Kuala Lumpur on the 6th of this month, and was handed over to the printing company on the 8th for part of the printing work.

source: “该局下周四将派人到吉隆坡取货，回到沙巴立刻进行最后阶段的打印，估计多2个工作日（12月20日）就可以交到申请者手上。 ”
target: The bureau will send people to pick up the goods in Kuala Lumpur next Thursday, and return to Sabah for the final stage of printing immediately. It is estimated that it will be delivered to the applicant in two more working days (December 20).

source: “我们会通知申请者前往各地分局领取报生纸。 ”
target: We will notify applicants to go to local branches to pick up the birth certificate.

source: 他补充，沙巴今年至今共发出2万4801张报生纸。
target: He added that Sabah has issued 24,801 birth certificates so far this year.

source: 新华社南昌５月２２日电（记者陈毓珊）记者近日从江西省教育厅获悉，为增强紧缺学科教师队伍保障能力，实现乡村义务教育均衡发展，自２０１６年起，江西省规划用３年时间为全省乡村（乡镇及以下）每所小学培训合格的音乐、美术、体育教师各１名，共计１万名。
target: Nanchang, May 22 (Xinhua) -- A reporter recently learned from the Jiangxi Provincial Department of Education that in order to enhance the ability to guarantee the shortage of teachers in disciplines and achieve the balanced development of compulsory education in rural areas, since 2016, Jiangxi Province plans to spend 3 years to train 1 qualified music, art<v> and</v> physical education teachers in each primary school in the province's rural areas (townships and below), a total of 10,000.

source: 据了解，这次培训对象为江西全省乡村小学４５岁以下具有音乐、美术、体育学科知识基础或才能，能兼任音乐、美术、体育课程的其他学科教师。
target: It is understood that the target of this training is that the rural primary schools in Jiangxi Province are under the age of 45 with the knowledge base or talent of music, art<v> and</v> physical education, and can concurrently serve as teachers of other disciplines in music, art and physical education courses.

source: 新华社南昌５月２２日电（记者陈毓珊）记者近日从江西省教育厅获悉，为增强紧缺学科教师队伍保障能力，实现乡村义务教育均衡发展，自２０１６年起，江西省规划用３年时间为全省乡村（乡镇及以下）每所小学培训合格的音乐、美术、体育教师各１名，共计１万名。
target: Xinhua news agency, Nanchang, May 22 (reporter Chen Yushan) - the reporter recently learned from the Jiangxi Provincial Department of education that in order to enhance the guarantee ability of the scarce subject teachers and achieve the balanced development of rural compulsory education, Jiangxi Province plans to spend three years to train one qualified music, art and physical education teacher for each primary school in rural areas (towns and below) of the province, totaling 10000.

source: 据了解，这次培训对象为江西全省乡村小学４５岁以下具有音乐、美术、体育学科知识基础或才能，能兼任音乐、美术、体育课程的其他学科教师。
target: It is understood that the training objects are rural primary schools in Jiangxi Province under the age of 45, who have the knowledge foundation or ability of music, art and physical education, and can concurrently serve as teachers of other disciplines of music, art and physical education.

source: 通过培训，使他们掌握音体美学科教学的基本知识和教学技能，更新教学思想和观念，掌握现代教学方法，提高学科教学能力、活动设计能力、校园文化能力及自我发展能力，建设一支一专多能的音体美教师队伍，缓解乡村音体美教师缺乏的问题。
target: Through training, they can master the basic knowledge and teaching skills of music, sports and beauty subject teaching, update teaching ideas and concepts, master modern teaching methods, improve subject teaching ability, activity design ability, campus culture ability and self-development ability, build a team of music, sports and beauty teachers with one specialty and multiple abilities, and alleviate the problem of lack of rural music, sports and <v>beauty</v> teachers.

source: 为确保培训质量和效果，江西还规划为全省１００个县（市、区）小学音乐、美术、体育各培训１名，共计３００名培训者，全面提升他们的教学示范引领能力、教研活动设计组织能力、施训能力、网络研修工作坊建设能力，起到教授、示范、指导、监督的作用。
target: In order to ensure the quality and effect of training, Jiangxi also plans to train one music, one art and one sports in primary schools in 100 counties (cities, districts) across the province, with a total of 300 trainers, so as to comprehensively improve their teaching demonstration and guidance ability, teaching and research activity design and organization ability, training ability and network research workshop construction ability, and play the role of teaching, demonstration, guidance<v> and</v> supervision.

source: 激光电视和传统电视在市场定位上有何差异？
target: What is the difference between laser TV and traditional TV in market positioning?

source: 以我的理解，题主所说的传统电视应该指的就是液晶电视，而激光电视和液晶电视在市场定位上的差异，主要有以下两点：
target: In my understanding, the traditional TV mentioned by the <v>subject</v> should refer to LCD TV, and the difference in market positioning between laser TV and LCD TV mainly has the following two points:

source: 第一，激光电视更聚焦大屏市场。
target: First, laser TVs are more focused on the large-screen market.

source: 相比液晶电视全面铺开的市场定位，激光电视显然更聚焦大屏市场，或者说激光电视本身就是为大屏而生的产物。
target: Compared with the market positioning of LCD TVs, laser TVs are obviously more focused on the large-screen market, or laser TVs themselves are products for large-screen TVs.

source: 目前，主流液晶电视尺寸多在55英寸到65英寸，而激光电视的尺寸一般在75英寸以上，最大的超过100英寸，充分满足用户对大屏彩电的需求。
target: At present, the size of mainstream LCD TVs is mostly 55 inches to 65 inches, while the size of laser TVs is generally more than 75 inches, and the largest is more than 100 inches, which fully meets the needs of users for large-screen color TVs.

source: 近年来，激光电视在全球的出货量和销量占比都在不断增加，在80英寸及以上总体电视销量中占比超六成。
target: In recent years, the global shipments and sales of laser TVs have been increasing, accounting for more than 60% of the total TV sales of 80 inches and above.

source: 根据中怡康的预测，2020年，激光电视市场销量增长将超过140%，继续保持高速增长。
target: According to CMM's forecast, in 2020, the sales volume of the laser TV market will increase by more than 140% and continue to maintain rapid growth.

source: 之所以在大屏市场有如此好的成绩，主要归功于激光电视在护眼方面的出色表现。
target: The reason why it has such good results in the large-screen market is mainly due to the excellent performance of laser TV in eye protection.

source: 基于激光电视漫反射的成像原理，激光光源发出的光线并不直射入眼球，相比液晶电视的背光源发光，成像过程更接近自然条件下物体的成像过程，对眼睛产生的刺激也更小。
target: Based on the imaging principle of diffuse reflection of laser TVs, the light emitted by the laser light source does not directly enter the eyeball. Compared with the backlight of LCD TVs, the imaging process is closer to the imaging process of objects under natural conditions, and the stimulation to the eyes is also smaller.

source: 中国电子技术标准化研究院赛西实验室和北京协和医院眼科专家，通过人群相同条件下观看激光电视和液晶电视的严格对比试验，得出了144组测试数据。
target: The Saixi Laboratory of the China Institute of Electronic Technology Standardization and the ophthalmologist of Peking Union Medical College Hospital have obtained 144 sets of test data through a strict comparison test of watching laser TV and LCD TV under the same conditions.

source: 数据证实：激光电视的确具有很强的护眼特性，在特定方面甚至具有一定的改善作用。
target: The data confirms that: laser TV does have strong eye protection properties, and even has a certain improvement in certain aspects.

source: 在视力健康越来越受重视的当下，激光电视不仅凭借护眼优势吸引了越来越多用户，也打开了彩电市场的另一个突破口。
target: At a time when more and more attention is paid to vision health, laser TV not only attracts more and more users with its eye protection advantages, but also opens up another breakthrough in the color TV market.

source: 第二，激光电视更聚焦高端市场。
target: Second, laser TVs are more focused on the high-end market.

source: 与液晶电视价格不断下探相反，目前市售激光电视的价格大多在万元以上，随着尺寸和光源的升级，价格逐步攀升。
target: Contrary to the continuous drop in the price of LCD TVs, the prices of laser TVs on the market are mostly above 10,000 yuan. With the upgrade of size and light source, the price gradually rises.

source: 新华社河内12月12日电（周娜滕怀金）12日上午，参加中越两军“和平救援-2021”卫勤联合演习的中方参演分队全部安全返回中国广西境内，标志着此次持续7天的演训任务顺利完成。

target: Hanoi, Dec. 12 (Xinhua) -- All Chinese participating teams from the "Peace Rescue-2021" joint military exercise between China and Vietnam have returned to Guangxi, China on the morning of the 12th, marking the successful completion of the seven-day training mission.

source: 此次联演，中越两军围绕人道主义医学救援这一重大课题，紧扣卫勤救死扶伤使命任务，按照实战化标准完成了联合卫勤指挥、联合现场救援、批量伤员处置等课目内容，有效提升了两军卫勤保障能力。
target: In this joint exercise, focusing on the major topic of humanitarian medical rescue, the two armies closely followed medical mission to save lives and heal the wounded and completed subjects such as joint medical command, joint on-site rescue and mass casualty treatment in accordance with practical standards. These subjects had significantly improved the medical support capabilities of both militaries.

source: 演习成果得到中越两军的肯定。
target: The results of the exercise were affirmed by the armed forces of both China and Vietnam.

source: <v>越方演习指导委员会主任、越南人民军后勤总局副主任兼参谋长阮雄胜在演习结束仪式上说，通过此次演习，</v>越南军医从中国军医身上学到了演习组织及专业活动方面的知识，也见识了中方的医疗、保障设备。
target: Vietnamese military doctors are learning experiences from Chinese military doctors, but also have the knowledge of China's medical and security equipment.

source: 演习取得的成果证明了两国军医力量在医疗援助、疫情防控方面的专业能力。
target: The results achieved in the exercise have proved the professional capabilities of the military medical forces of the two countries in medical assistance and epidemic prevention and control.

source: 中方指导协调组组长、中央军委后勤保障部卫生局副局长陈春明表示，此次演习是在2018年成功举办联合义诊活动的基础上又一次开拓创新实践，具有非常重要的里程碑意义。
target: Chen Chunming, the leader of the Chinese Guidance and Coordination Team and deputy director of the Central Military Commission, said in a statement that the exercise was another pioneering and innovative practice based on the successful joint free consultation activity in 2018, and was a very significant milestone.

source: 新华社南昌５月２２日电（记者陈毓珊）记者近日从江西省教育厅获悉，为增强紧缺学科教师队伍保障能力，实现乡村义务教育均衡发展，自２０１６年起，江西省规划用３年时间为全省乡村（乡镇及以下）每所小学培训合格的音乐、美术、体育教师<v>各１名</v>，共计１万名。

target: It is known that this training aims at teachers from rural primary schools in Jiangxi Province under the age of 45 who have knowledge or talents in music, art and physical education subjects, and who can hold concurrent duties as teachers of other subject courses.
