target: Jiangxi will train 10,000 rural elementary school teachers of music, PE and <v>fine</v> art in three years - Xinhuanet

source: 新华社南昌５月２２日电（记者陈毓珊）记者近日从江西省教育厅获悉，为增强紧缺学科教师队伍保障能力，实现乡村义务教育均衡发展，自２０１６年起，江西省规划用３年时间为全省乡村（乡镇及以下）每所小学培训合格的音乐、美术、体育教师各１名，共计１万名。
target: Message from Xinhua News Agency Nanchang on May 22 (journalist: Chen Yushan): According to Ministry of Education of Jiangxi, in order to strengthen the supportability for teachers of subjects that are in short supply and realize balanced development of compulsory education in rural areas, Jiangxi province planned to train 1 music teacher, 1 art teacher<v> and</v> 1 PE teacher who are qualified for each elementary school in rural areas of the whole province (villages, towns and below) in three years since 2016; a total of 10 thousand teachers will be trained.

source: 据了解，这次培训对象为江西全省乡村小学４５岁以下具有音乐、美术、体育学科知识基础或才能，能兼任音乐、美术、体育课程的其他学科教师。
target: It is understood that the training objects this time are teachers of other subjects under 45 years old with basic knowledge or talent of music, art<v> and</v> PE in rural primary schools in Jiangxi and can work as music, art or PE teachers at the same time.

source: 通过培训，使他们掌握音体美学科教学的基本知识和教学技能，更新教学思想和观念，掌握现代教学方法，提高学科教学能力、活动设计能力、校园文化能力及自我发展能力，建设一支一专多能的音体美教师队伍，缓解乡村音体美教师缺乏的问题。
target: Through training, they can master basic knowledge and teaching skills of the subjects of music, PE and art, and update teaching ideas and concepts, master modern teaching methods, improve subject teaching ability, activity design ability, campus cultural ability and self-development ability; a team of music, PE and art teachers who are good at many subjects and specialize in one will be constructed to relieve the problem of lack of music, PE<v> and</v> art teachers in rural schools.

source: 为确保培训质量和效果，江西还规划为全省１００个县（市、区）小学音乐、美术、体育各培训１名，共计３００名培训者，全面提升他们的教学示范引领能力、教研活动设计组织能力、施训能力、网络研修工作坊建设能力，起到教授、示范、指导、监督的作用。
target: In order to ensure training quality and effect, Jiangxi plans to train 1 music, 1 art and 1 PE trainers for each elementary school in 100 counties (cities and districts) in Jiangxi, with a total of 300 trainers, to comprehensively improve their teaching demonstration leading ability, teaching research activity design and organization ability, training ability, network research workshop construction ability, so as to teach, demonstrate, guide and supervise.

target: In order to master the autonomy of "chip", technology giants in more and more countries began to move towards the road of "de-<v>beautification</v>".

source: 为了牢牢把控全球半导体控制权，牵制中国半导体行业的发展，最近老美动作频频，又是主持“芯片峰会”；又是邀请64国巨头成立半导体联盟，并拔款扶持美国本土科技巨头，比如，美帝老牌科技巨头英特尔为了夺回在芯片领域的主导地位，斥资200亿美元在美国亚利桑那州建2座晶圆加工厂，并对外开放芯片代工业务。
target: In order to firmly control the global semiconductor control and contain the development of China's semiconductor industry, the United States has recently taken frequent actions to host the "Chip Summit"; It also invited <v>the giants of</v> 64 countries to establish a semiconductor alliance, and allocated funds to support the local technology giants in the United States. For example, in order to regain its leading position in the chip field, Intel, an old technology giant in the United States, spent 20 billion US dollars to build two wafer processing plants in Arizona, the United States, and opened its chip foundry business to the outside world.

source: 当大多数人都以为，英特尔此番举动将对台积电造成一定冲击，并很有可能抢走台积电的“饭碗”。
target: When most people think that Intel's move will have a certain impact on TSMC, and is likely to take away TSMC's "<v>rice bowl</v>".

source: 之所以这么肯定，是因为，英特尔作为美帝老牌科技巨头，在半导体领域深耕几十年，拥有大量的人才队伍和技术储备，必定能在短期内迅速崛起，打败台积电。
target: The reason why it is so sure is that Intel, as an old technology giant of the United States, has been deeply cultivated in the semiconductor field for decades, and has a large number of talent teams and technical reserves, which is bound to rise rapidly in a short period of time and defeat TSMC.

source: 然而，对于英特尔的这个决定，台积电创始人张忠谋却不屑一顾。
target: However, Zhang Zhongmou, founder of TSMC, shrugged off Intel's decision.

source: 在今年四月举行的“2021大师智库论坛”上，张忠谋语出惊人，对于英特尔斥资建晶圆厂这个举动，张忠谋毫无顾忌直言：英特尔建芯片代工厂，相当讽刺。
target: At the "2021 Master Think Tank Forum" held in April this year, Zhang Zhongmou made a shocking remark. Zhang Zhongmou had no scruples about Intel's move to invest in building a fab: Intel's construction of a chip foundry is quite ironic.

source: 张忠谋之所以对英特尔进军晶圆领域颇为不屑，是因为张忠谋对30多年前台积电与英特尔的一段恩怨依然耿耿于怀。
target: The reason why Zhang Zhongmou is disdainful of Intel's entry into the wafer field is that Zhang Zhongmou still has a grudge between TSMC and Intel more than 30 years ago.

source: 上世纪六七十年代，英特尔一直是美帝制造业中的明珠，雄居全球巅峰的位置，是世界半导体领域的霸主。
target: In the 1960 s and 1970 s, Intel has always been the pearl in the manufacturing industry of the United States, ranking at the top of the world and the overlord of the world's semiconductor field.

source: 到上世纪80年代，世界半导体高端芯片一直被少数强者掌握。
target: By the 1980 s, the world's high-end semiconductor chips had been mastered by a few <v>strong people</v>.

source: 当时半导体行业以IDM模式为特征，芯片从设计、制造到封测都是由一家工厂来完成，英特尔就是那个时代的代表。
target: At that time, the semiconductor industry was characterized by the IDM mode, and the chip design, manufacturing and packaging and testing were completed by one factory. Intel was the representative of that era.

source: 然而这样的模式让一些小企业不堪重负，很多半导体创业者面对巨额的产线建设费用只能望而却步。
target: However, this model has overwhelmed some small enterprises, and many semiconductor entrepreneurs can only be discouraged in the face of huge production line construction costs.

source: 在市场需求的感召下，进入80年代后，芯片行业开始出现分工合作的现象，1984年张忠谋听说有专门做芯片设计的公司，便认为既然有专门做设计的，那么就可以成立一家专门用于晶圆制造的工厂。
target: Inspired by market demand, after entering the 1980 s, the chip industry began to have the phenomenon of division of labor and cooperation. In 1984, Zhang Zhongmou heard that there was a company specializing in chip design, so he thought that since there was a company specializing in chip design, a factory specializing in wafer manufacturing could be set up.

source: 不久之后，张忠谋的设想变成了现实，台积电应运而生。
target: Soon after, Zhang Zhongmou's vision became a reality, and TSMC came into being.

source: 台积电把主营业务瞄准了“晶圆加工”这个单一环节，不进行设计，只提供晶圆制造的代工服务。
target: TSMC aims its main business at the single link of "wafer processing". It does not design, but only provides foundry services for wafer manufacturing.

source: 当时刚创立的台积电，在英特尔这个巨无霸面前就是小喽啰。
target: TSMC, which was just founded at that time, was a minion in front of Intel, a giant.

source: 为了获取资本支持，张忠谋就曾找英特尔投资，但当时英特尔一听说台积电只做芯片行业的制造环节，显然有些自视甚高，看不起台积电，果断拒绝对台积电进行投资。
target: In order to obtain capital support, Zhang Zhongmou once asked Intel to invest, but when Intel heard that TSMC was only engaged in the manufacturing of the chip industry, it obviously thought highly of itself<v>,</v> looked down on TSMC, and decisively refused to invest in TSMC.

source: 张忠谋也认定英特尔当时是看不起晶圆制程服务的。
target: Zhang Zhongmou also believes that Intel looked down on wafer process services at that time.

source: 没想到当年看不起晶圆制造服务的巨头，如今却也要开始做晶圆代工。
target: <v>I</v> didn't expect that the giants who looked down on wafer manufacturing services at that time would now start to do wafer foundry.

source: 激光电视和传统电视在市场定位上有何差异？
target: What are the differences between laser TV and traditional TV in market positioning?

source: 以我的理解，题主所说的传统电视应该指的就是液晶电视，而激光电视和液晶电视在市场定位上的差异，主要有以下两点：
target: In my understanding, the traditional TV mentioned in the topic should refer to LCD TV, and the differences between laser TV and LCD TV in market positioning mainly include the following two points:

source: 第一，激光电视更聚焦大屏市场。
target: First, laser TV focuses more on the large-screen market.

source: 相比液晶电视全面铺开的市场定位，激光电视显然更聚焦大屏市场，或者说激光电视本身就是为大屏而生的产物。
target: Compared with the market positioning of LCD TV, laser TV is obviously more focused on the large screen market, or laser TV itself is a product of large screen.

source: 目前，主流液晶电视尺寸多在55英寸到65英寸，而激光电视的尺寸一般在75英寸以上，最大的超过100英寸，充分满足用户对大屏彩电的需求。
target: At present, the size of mainstream LCD TVs is mostly 55 inches to 65 inches, while the size of laser TVs is generally more than 75 inches, with the largest exceeding 100 inches, which fully meets the needs of users for large-screen color TVs.

source: 近年来，激光电视在全球的出货量和销量占比都在不断增加，在80英寸及以上总体电视销量中占比超六成。
target: In recent years, the shipment and sales proportion of laser TVs in the world have been increasing, accounting for more than 60% of the total TV sales of 80 inches and above.

source: 根据中怡康的预测，2020年，激光电视市场销量增长将超过140%，继续保持高速增长。
target: According to CEC's forecast, the sales volume of laser TV market will increase by more than 140% in 2020, continuing to maintain high-speed growth.

source: 之所以在大屏市场有如此好的成绩，主要归功于激光电视在护眼方面的出色表现。
target: The reason for such good results in the large screen market is mainly due to the excellent performance of laser TV in eye protection.

source: 基于激光电视漫反射的成像原理，激光光源发出的光线并不直射入眼球，相比液晶电视的背光源发光，成像过程更接近自然条件下物体的成像过程，对眼睛产生的刺激也更小。
target: Based on the imaging principle of diffuse reflection of laser TV, the light emitted by the laser light source does not directly enter the eyeball. Compared with the backlight of LCD TV, the imaging process is closer to the imaging process of objects under natural conditions, and the stimulation to the eye is less.

source: 中国电子技术标准化研究院赛西实验室和北京协和医院眼科专家，通过人群相同条件下观看激光电视和液晶电视的严格对比试验，得出了144组测试数据。
target: Ophthalmologists from <v>CISI</v> Laboratory of China Electronics Standardization Institute and Peking Union Medical College Hospital obtained 144 sets of test data through a strict comparative test of people watching laser TV and LCD TV under the same conditions.

source: 数据证实：激光电视的确具有很强的护眼特性，在特定方面甚至具有一定的改善作用。
target: The data confirms that laser TVs do have strong eye-protection properties and even improve in certain aspects.

source: 在视力健康越来越受重视的当下，激光电视不仅凭借护眼优势吸引了越来越多用户，也打开了彩电市场的另一个突破口。
target: At present, laser TV not only attracts more and more users with the advantage of eye protection, but also opens another breakthrough in the color TV market.

source: 第二，激光电视更聚焦高端市场。
target: Second, laser TV focuses more on the high-end market.

source: 与液晶电视价格不断下探相反，目前市售激光电视的价格大多在万元以上，随着尺寸和光源的升级，价格逐步攀升。
target: Contrary to the continuous decline in the price of LCD TVs, the current price of laser TVs on the market is mostly above RMB 10,000. With the upgrading of size and light source, the price gradually rises.

source: 新华社河内12月12日电（周娜滕怀金）12日上午，参加中越两军“和平救援-2021”卫勤联合演习的中方参演分队全部安全返回中国广西境内，标志着此次持续7天的演训任务顺利完成。
target: Xinhua News Agency, Hanoi, December 12 (Teng Huaijin, Zhou Na) On the morning of December 12, all the Chinese participating teams participating in the "Peace Rescue-2021" medical service joint exercise between the Chinese and Vietnamese armed forces returned safely to Guangxi, China, marking the successful completion of the 7-day training mission.

source: 中方指导协调组组长、中央军委后勤保障部卫生局副局长陈春明表示，此次演习是在2018年成功举办联合义诊活动的基础上又一次开拓创新实践，具有非常重要的里程碑意义。

source: 据毛卫生部长凯莱什·贾古特帕尔介绍，一名感染者为自南非出发于11月27日抵达毛里求斯的游客；另一名感染者为毛里求斯本地居民，他与一名近期曾前往南非后返回的人员接触后，于11月30日核酸检测呈阳性。

source: 经医院隔离治疗后，这两名感染者核酸检测结果均转为阴性，目前已返回各自的居住地。

source: 激光电视和传统电视在市场定位上有何差异？
target: What is the difference between laser TV and traditional TV in market positioning?

source: 以我的理解，题主所说的传统电视应该指的就是液晶电视，而激光电视和液晶电视在市场定位上的差异，主要有以下两点：
target: From my understanding, the traditional TV mentioned by the <v>subject</v> should refer to LCD TV, and the difference between LASER TV and LCD TV in market positioning mainly has the following two points：

source: 第一，激光电视更聚焦大屏市场。
target: First, laser TV focuses more on the large-screen market.

source: 相比液晶电视全面铺开的市场定位，激光电视显然更聚焦大屏市场，或者说激光电视本身就是为大屏而生的产物。
target: Compared with the fully rolled out market positioning of LCD TVs, laser TVs are obviously more focused on the large-screen market, or laser TVs themselves are products born for large screens.

source: 目前，主流液晶电视尺寸多在55英寸到65英寸，而激光电视的尺寸一般在75英寸以上，最大的超过100英寸，充分满足用户对大屏彩电的需求。
target: At present, the size of mainstream LCD TVs is mostly 55 inches to 65 inches, while the size of laser TVs is generally more than 75 inches, and the largest is more than 100 inches, which fully meets the needs of users for large-screen color TVs.

source: 近年来，激光电视在全球的出货量和销量占比都在不断增加，在80英寸及以上总体电视销量中占比超六成。
target: In recent years, the proportion of laser TVs shipped and sold worldwide has been increasing, accounting for more than 60% of the overall TV sales of 80 inches and above.

source: 根据中怡康的预测，2020年，激光电视市场销量增长将超过140%，继续保持高速增长。
target: According to Zhongyikang's forecast, in 2020, the sales growth of the laser TV market will exceed 140%, continuing to maintain rapid growth.

source: 之所以在大屏市场有如此好的成绩，主要归功于激光电视在护眼方面的出色表现。
target: The reason why it has such good results in the large-screen market is mainly due to the outstanding performance of laser TV in eye protection.

source: 基于激光电视漫反射的成像原理，激光光源发出的光线并不直射入眼球，相比液晶电视的背光源发光，成像过程更接近自然条件下物体的成像过程，对眼睛产生的刺激也更小。
target: Based on the imaging principle of diffuse reflection of laser TV, the light emitted by the laser light source does not directly enter the eye. Compared with the backlight of LCD TV, the imaging process is closer to the imaging process of objects under natural conditions, and the irritation to the eyes is smaller.

source: 中国电子技术标准化研究院赛西实验室和北京协和医院眼科专家，通过人群相同条件下观看激光电视和液晶电视的严格对比试验，得出了144组测试数据。
target: The Saixi Laboratory of the China Institute of Electronic Technology Standardization and ophthalmologists of Beijing Union Hospital obtained 144 sets of test data through rigorous comparative tests of people watching laser TV and LCD TV under the same conditions.

source: 数据证实：激光电视的确具有很强的护眼特性，在特定方面甚至具有一定的改善作用。
target: The data confirm that laser TV does have strong eye protection properties, and even has a certain improvement effect in certain aspects.

source: 在视力健康越来越受重视的当下，激光电视不仅凭借护眼优势吸引了越来越多用户，也打开了彩电市场的另一个突破口。
target: At a time when vision health is receiving more and more attention, laser TV has not only attracted more and more users with the advantages of eye protection, but also opened up another breakthrough in the color TV market.

source: 第二，激光电视更聚焦高端市场。
target: Second, laser TV focuses more on the high-end market.

source: 与液晶电视价格不断下探相反，目前市售激光电视的价格大多在万元以上，随着尺寸和光源的升级，价格逐步攀升。
target: Contrary to the continuous decline in the price of LCD TVs, most of the current prices of commercially available laser TVs are above 10,000 yuan. With the upgrading of size and light source, the price has gradually risen.

source: 激光电视凭什么卖这么贵呢？
target: Why is laser TV so expensive?

source: 肯定是有道理的。
target: It definitely makes sense.

source: 在光源和技术水平的不断发展下，激光电视有很多液晶电视和投影都无法实现的优势。
target: With the continuous development of light source and technical level, laser TV has many advantages that LCD TV and projection cannot achieve.

source: 凭借超短焦距投影技术，激光电视的投影距离相对传统投影设备来说要更短，能够在短距离内实现100英寸大屏体验，所需空间不大，而且主机小巧，占用地方很小。

source: 在亮度方面，大品牌激光电视可以达到2000以上的流明。

source: 加之发热量更低，对设备损耗小，电视的使用寿命也更长。

source: 激光电视和传统电视在市场定位上有何差异？
target: What is the difference between laser TV and traditional TV in market positioning?

source: 以我的理解，题主所说的传统电视应该指的就是液晶电视，而激光电视和液晶电视在市场定位上的差异，主要有以下两点：
target: From my understanding, the traditional TV mentioned by the <v>subject</v> should refer to LCD TV, and the difference in the market positioning between laser TV and LCD TV mainly has the following two points:

source: 第一，激光电视更聚焦大屏市场。
target: First, laser TV is more focused on the large-screen market.

source: 相比液晶电视全面铺开的市场定位，激光电视显然更聚焦大屏市场，或者说激光电视本身就是为大屏而生的产物。
target: Compared with the market positioning of LCD TVs, laser TVs are obviously more focused on the large screen market, or the laser TVs themselves are products designed for big screens.

source: 相比液晶电视全面铺开的市场定位，激光电视显然更聚焦大屏市场，或者说激光电视本身就是为大屏而生的产物。
target: Compared with the market positioning of LCD TVs, laser TVs are obviously more focused on the large screen market, or the laser TVs themselves are products designed for big screens.

source: 目前，主流液晶电视尺寸多在55英寸到65英寸，而激光电视的尺寸一般在75英寸以上，最大的超过100英寸，充分满足用户对大屏彩电的需求。
target: At present, the size of mainstream LCD TVs are mostly 55 inches to 65 inches, while the size of laser TVs is generally more than 75 inches, and the largest is over 100 inches, which fully meets users' needs for large-screen color TVs.

source: 近年来，激光电视在全球的出货量和销量占比都在不断增加，在80英寸及以上总体电视销量中占比超六成。
target: In recent years, the global shipment and sales volume of laser TVs have been increasing, accounting for more than 60% of the total TV sales of 80 inches and above.

source: 根据中怡康的预测，2020年，激光电视市场销量增长将超过140%，继续保持高速增长。
target: According to <v>CMM's</v> forecast, the sales volume of the laser TV market will increase by more than 140% in 2020 and continue to maintain rapid growth.

source: 之所以在大屏市场有如此好的成绩，主要归功于激光电视在护眼方面的出色表现。
target: The reason why it has such good results in the large-screen market is mainly due to the excellent performance of laser TV in eye protection.

source: 基于激光电视漫反射的成像原理，激光光源发出的光线并不直射入眼球，相比液晶电视的背光源发光，成像过程更接近自然条件下物体的成像过程，对眼睛产生的刺激也更小。
target: Based on the imaging principle of diffuse reflection of laser TVs, the light emitted by laser light source does not enter the eyeball directly. Compared with backlight light of LCD TVs, the imaging process is closer to the imaging process of objects under natural conditions and the irritation to the eyes is smaller.

source: 中国电子技术标准化研究院赛西实验室和北京协和医院眼科专家，通过人群相同条件下观看激光电视和液晶电视的严格对比试验，得出了144组测试数据。
target: Saixi Laboratory of China Electronics Standardization Institute, and ophthalmology experts of Peking Union Medical College Hospital, came up with 144 sets of test data through rigorous comparative tests of audience's watching laser TV and LCD TV under the same conditions.

source: 数据证实：激光电视的确具有很强的护眼特性，在特定方面甚至具有一定的改善作用。
target: The data confirm<v>霾</v> that laser TV indeed has strong eye protection properties, and even has certain improvement effects in certain areas.

source: 在视力健康越来越受重视的当下，激光电视不仅凭借护眼优势吸引了越来越多用户，也打开了彩电市场的另一个突破口。

source: 由美国总统拜登召集、有全球110个国家的政府以及公民社会和私营部门领导人出席的线上“民主峰会” ( Summit for Democracy)星期五（12月10日）落幕。
target: The virtual "Summit for Democracy", convened by U.S. President Joe Biden and attended by governments from 110 countries around the world as well as civil society and private sector leaders, concluded Friday (Dec. 10).

source: 拜登在闭幕词中说，自由之火在世界每个人的心中燃烧，专制政权永远无法将其熄灭。
target: In his closing remarks, Biden said that the fire of freedom is burning in the hearts of everyone in the world, and an authoritarian regime will never be able to put it out.

source: 他也表示，计划明年召开第二届全球“民主峰会” 。
target: He also said that he plans to hold the second global "<v>democracy summit</v>" next year.

source: 台湾政府代表、政务委员唐凤和目前流亡英国的香港民主人权活动人士罗冠聪也在第二天的峰会上发言。
target: The Taiwan government representative and political councillor Tang Feng, and Hong Kong democracy and human rights activist Luo Guancong, who is in exile in the UK, also spoke at the <v>summit</v> on the second day.

source: 拜登说： “ 我们知道摆在我们面前的工作是多么的艰巨。
target: We know how difficult the job ahead of us is, Biden said.

source: 但我们也知道，我们可以迎接挑战，因为我以前说过，正如这次峰会所表明的，民主世界无处不在。
target: But we also know that we can rise to the challenge because, as I have said before, as this <v>summit</v> has shown, democracy is everywhere.

source: 专制政权永远无法熄灭自由的微火，它在全世界和世界各地人们的心中燃烧。 ”
target: A tyrannical regime can never extinguish the little fire of liberty that burns in the hearts of people all over the world and around the world.”

source: 拜登还表示，捍卫民主需要整个社会的共同努力。
target: Biden also said that defending democracy requires the joint efforts of the entire society.

source: 他说： “ 作为政府的领导人，我们有责任倾听我们的公民，加固民主的护栏，推动改革，实现透明的问责治理，更能抵御专制的缓冲和冲击的力量，以及那些想在公共利益之前赤裸裸地追求权力的人。 ”
target: As leaders of government, we have a responsibility to listen to our citizens, strengthen the guardrails of democracy, and push for reforms that enable transparent and accountable governance, more resistant to the buffers and shocks of authoritarianism, and those who want to <v>run naked</v> in pursuit of power before the public good, he said.

source: “民主峰会”第二天的主题分别是捍卫人权，巩固民主与对抗威权，以及反击数字威权主义与肯定民主价值。
target: The themes of the second day of the "Democracy Summit" are defending human rights, consolidating democracy and confronting authoritarianism, and countering digital authoritarianism and affirming democratic values.

source: 这一天恰逢“国际人权日” 。
target: This day coincides with International Human Rights Day.

source: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯在当天的开场讲话中也表示，民主事业在全球面临挑战，特别是新兴数字技术带来的挑战。
target: UN Secretary-General António Guterres also said in his opening speech that the cause of democracy faces challenges around the world, especially those brought about by emerging digital technologies.

source: 他说： “ 现在是重申共同价值观和立场以及民主韧性的时候了。
target: It is time to reaffirm shared values and positions and democratic resilience, he said.

source: 这需要深化社会对话，解决不平等问题，打击腐败，更新社会契约，为优质教育投资，并扩大妇女和女童的机会。
target: This requires deepening social dialogue, tackling inequality, fighting corruption, renewing the social contract, investing in quality education, and expanding opportunities for women and girls.

source: 这也需要坚决谴责一切形式的民粹主义、本土主义和极端主义，包括利用技术革命所提供的所有工具。 ”
target: It also requires a firm condemnation of populism, nativism<v> and</v> extremism in all its forms, including using all the tools the technological revolution has to offer.”

target: NEWS GOV-MO: UM conferred honorary doctorates on seven distinguished individuals

source: 澳门大学今（11）日举行“2021年荣誉学位及高等学位颁授典礼＂ ， 向刘遵义、陈凯先、中村修二、李兰娟、李效良、朱丽兰及江朝晖颁授澳大荣誉博士学位，以表彰其卓越成就、为社会和教育的发展所作出的重大贡献。
target: The University of Macau (UM) held the "2021 Honorary degree and Advanced Degree Conferment Ceremony" today (11) to present UM honorary doctorates to Liu Zunyi, Chen Kaixian, Shuji Nakamura, Li Lanjuan, Li Xiaoliang, Zhu Lilan<v> and</v> Jiang Zhaohui in recognition of their outstanding achievements and significant contributions to the development of society and education.

source: 颁授典礼上，行政长官兼澳大校监代表、社会文化司司长欧阳瑜在澳大校董会主席林金城、澳大校长宋永华陪同下颁授荣誉博士学位。
target: At the conferment ceremony, Ouyang Yu, Chief Executive, Representative of UM Superintendent and Secretary for Social Affairs and Culture, accompanied by UM Council Chairman Lam Kam-shing and UM President Song Wing Wah conferred honorary doctorates.

source: 刘遵义教授获颁荣誉教育博士学位、陈凯先教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、中村修二教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、李兰娟教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、李效良教授获颁荣誉工商管理博士学位、朱丽兰教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位，江朝晖女士获颁荣誉理学博士学位。
target: Prof. Zunyi Liu was awarded honorary doctorate in education, Prof. Kaixian Chen was awarded honorary doctorate of science, Professor Shuji Nakamura was awarded honorary doctorate of science, Professor Li Lanjuan was awarded honorary doctorate of science, Professor Li Xiaoliang was awarded honorary doctorate of business administration, Professor Zhu Lilan was awarded honorary doctor of science, and Ms. Jiang Zhaohui was awarded an honorary doctorate of science.

source: 欧阳瑜致辞时首先向获颁发荣誉博士学位的七位杰出人士，表示热烈的祝贺并致以崇高的敬意，他们分别在不同的领域取得非凡的成就，为国家的发展和世界的进步作出了卓越的贡献；同时，欧阳瑜向毕业生和家长表达最真挚的祝福，也向大学爱岗敬业、学术精湛的教职员团队致以由衷的敬意。
target: In his speech, Ouyang Yu first expressed warm congratulations and high respect to the seven outstanding people who were awarded honorary doctorates, who have made extraordinary achievements in different fields and made outstanding contributions to the development of the country and the progress of the world; At the same time, Ouyang Yu expressed his sincerest wishes to the graduates and parents, and also expressed his heartfelt respect to the university's dedicated and academically superb teaching staff.

source: 澳大人文学院讲座教授孙艺风宣读刘遵义赞辞时表示，刘遵义教授是一位享誉全球的经济学家，以其卓越的学术成就和前瞻性的教育理念而闻名。
target: Reading out Liu Zunyi's speech, Sun Yifeng, Chair Professor of UM's School of Humanities, said that Professor Liu Zunyi is a world-renowned economist known for his academic excellence and forward-looking educational philosophy.

source: 除了在经济发展、经济增长及东亚经济领域取得的成就外，他还是一位富有远见的教育领导者。
target: In addition to his achievements in economic development, economic growth, and east Asian economies, he is a visionary education leader.

source: 简而言之，他在众多领域都有杰出建树。
target: In short, he has distinguished himself in many fields.

source: 孙艺风宣读中村修二赞辞时表示，中村修二教授是可持续能源技术的先驱者。
target: In reading out Shuji Nakamura's speech, Sun Yifeng said that Professor Shuji Nakamura is a pioneer in sustainable energy technology.

source: 他因发明蓝色发光二极管（LED）而成为2014年诺贝尔物理学奖的三位获奖者之一。
target: He became one of the three laureates of the 2014 Nobel Prize in Physics for inventing the blue light-emitting diode (LED).

source: 中村教授的发明不仅彻底改变了照明行业，更推动产生了如今广泛应用于日常生活和工业生产的白色发光二极管，为人类的福祉做出了巨大的贡献。
target: Professor Nakamura's invention not only revolutionized the lighting industry, but also promoted the production of white light-emitting diodes, which are widely used in daily life and industrial production today, and made a great contribution to the well-being of mankind.

source: 孙艺风宣读李兰娟赞辞时表示，李兰娟教授作为中国人工肝事业的开拓者，创建独特有效的李氏人工肝系统，治疗重型肝炎肝衰竭获重大突破，显著降低肝衰竭的病死率。

source: 在这次新冠肺炎抗击战中，她和团队所提出的“四抗二平衡”方案及带去的人工肝、微生态和干细胞三大技术，显著提高了重症救治率。
target: In this fight against new crown pneumonia, the "four antibodies and two balances" scheme proposed by her and her team and the three major technologies of artificial liver, microecology and stem cells brought with them have significantly improved the rate of severe treatment.

source: 孙艺风宣读李效良赞辞时表示，李效良教授为运营管理的创新研究奠定了基础，塑造了供应链理论和实践的思维方式，并彻底改变了世界各地的商业模式。
target: In reading Li Xiaoliang's praise, Sun Yifeng said that Professor Li Xiaoliang laid the foundation for innovative research on operation management, shaped the way of thinking about supply chain theory and practice, and completely changed business models around the world.

source: 李效良因普及运筹管理中的长鞭效应概念而闻名，并探索了应对这种现象的措施。
target: Li Xiaoliang is known for popularizing the concept of the long whip effect in operations management and exploring measures to deal with this phenomenon.

source: 如今，各国在疫情及紧张的经济局势下，长鞭效应愈发突显，引发供应链严重破坏。
target: Today, under the epidemic and tense economic situation, the long whip effect has become more and more prominent, causing serious damage to supply chains.

source: 李效良具有远见的研究如雪中送炭，帮助行业应对困境，从而带来巨大的社会价值。
target: Li Xiaoliang's visionary research is like sending charcoal in the snow, helping the industry cope with difficulties, thus bringing great social value.

source: 孙艺风宣读朱丽兰赞辞时表示，在科研工作中，她发现了一种突破性和创新的染色技术用于制备样品，在国内外科技同行中享有较高声誉。
target: When Sun Yifeng read Zhu Lilan's praise, she said that in scientific research work, she found a breakthrough and innovative dyeing technology for sample preparation, which enjoyed a high reputation among domestic and foreign scientific and technological peers.

source: 她以非凡的科技成就荣膺国际欧亚科学院院士等重要荣誉称号，以自己辉煌的业绩为自己在世界科技圣殿赢得了应有的崇高地位。

source: 他对澳门和大湾区中医药事业发展的积极推动作用充分体现了其为国家医药发展战略奉献的使命感。

source: 不过，该局主任凯鲁阿米努斯保证，所有已经申请报生纸的婴儿，资料已经记录在系统，当防伪纸在下周运到后就会补发。
target: However, the director of the bureau, Kairouaminus, assured that all babies who have applied for birth papers have their information recorded in the system and will be reissued when the anti-counterfeiting papers arrive next week.

source: 他在新闻发布会上，针对一家网媒指沙巴报生纸印制问题出现长达10个月的报导，作出解释。
target: At the press conference, he explained a 10-month-old report by an online media that Sabah newspaper had a printing problem.

source: 他说，有关问题在2个月前就出现，砂拉越也面对同样的问题。
target: He said that the relevant problem appeared two months ago, and Sarawak faced the same problem.

source: “其中一个原因是生产特制防伪纸的中国厂家受疫情影响，导致延迟运抵我国。 ”
target: “One of the reasons is that Chinese manufacturers who produce special anti-counterfeiting paper are affected by the epidemic, which has caused delays in shipping to our country. ”

source: 他解释，沙巴报生纸使用的防伪纸和其他地区不同，因此不能<v>商</v>借其他州属的存货。
target: He explained that the anti-counterfeiting paper used in Sabah newspaper is different from other regions, so it is not possible to borrow inventory from other states.

source: 凯鲁阿米努斯透露，最新一批防伪纸已经于本月6日运抵吉隆坡，过后于8日交给印刷公司，进行部分印制工作。
target: Kairouaminus revealed that the latest batch of anti-counterfeiting paper had arrived in Kuala Lumpur on the 6th of this month, and was handed over to the printing company on the 8th for part of the printing work.

source: “该局下周四将派人到吉隆坡取货，回到沙巴立刻进行最后阶段的打印，估计多2个工作日（12月20日）就可以交到申请者手上。 ”
target: “The bureau will send someone to Kuala Lumpur to pick up the goods next Thursday, and return to Sabah for the final stage of printing immediately. It is estimated that it will be handed over to the applicant in two more working days (December 20). ”

source: “我们会通知申请者前往各地分局领取报生纸。 ”
target: “We will notify applicants to go to various branches to collect the <v>application</v> papers. ”

target: He added that Sabah has issued a total of 24,801 <v>student</v> papers so far this year.

target: NEWS GOV-MO: University of Macau awarded the degree of honorary doctorate to 7 distinguished people

source: 澳门大学今（11）日举行“2021年荣誉学位及高等学位颁授典礼＂ ， 向刘遵义、陈凯先、中村修二、李兰娟、李效良、朱丽兰及江朝晖颁授澳大荣誉博士学位，以表彰其卓越成就、为社会和教育的发展所作出的重大贡献。
target: The “2021 <v>Award-Giving</v> Ceremony for Honorary Degree and Advanced Degree” was held in University of Macau today (the 11th day of this month) to award the degree of honorary doctorate of the University of Macau to Liu Zunyi, Chen Kaixian, Shuji Nakamura, Li Lanjuan, Li Xiaoliang, Zhu Lilan and Jiang Zhaohui to commend their outstanding achievements and their major contributions to social and educational development.

source: 颁授典礼上，行政长官兼澳大校监代表、社会文化司司长欧阳瑜在澳大校董会主席林金城、澳大校长宋永华陪同下颁授荣誉博士学位。
target: At the award-giving ceremony, Ouyang Yu, the chief executive, the representative of the university superintendent of University of Macau and the director of the Social and Cultural Department, awarded the degree of honorary doctorate accompanied by Lin Jincheng, chairman of the university board, and Song Yonghua, president of University of Macau.

source: 刘遵义教授获颁荣誉教育博士学位、陈凯先教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、中村修二教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、李兰娟教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位、李效良教授获颁荣誉工商管理博士学位、朱丽兰教授获颁荣誉理学博士学位，江朝晖女士获颁荣誉理学博士学位。
target: Professor Liu Zunyi was awarded with the honorary degree of Doctor of Education; Professor Chen Kaixian was awarded with the honorary degree of Doctor of Science; Professor Shuji Nakamura was awarded with the honorary degree of Doctor of Science; Professor Li Lanjuan was awarded with the honorary degree of Doctor of Science; Professor Li Xiaoliang was awarded with the honorary degree of Doctor of Business Administration; Professor Zhu Lilan was awarded with the honorary degree of Doctor of Science and Ms. Jiang Zhaohui was awarded with the honorary degree of Doctor of Science.

source: 欧阳瑜致辞时首先向获颁发荣誉博士学位的七位杰出人士，表示热烈的祝贺并致以崇高的敬意，他们分别在不同的领域取得非凡的成就，为国家的发展和世界的进步作出了卓越的贡献；同时，欧阳瑜向毕业生和家长表达最真挚的祝福，也向大学爱岗敬业、学术精湛的教职员团队致以由衷的敬意。
target: In his speech, Ouyang Yu enthusiastically congratulated and expressed great respect to the seven distinguished people awarded with the honorary doctorate, who made outstanding achievements in different fields and excellent contributions to the development of the country and the progress of the world; at the same time, Ouyang Yu expressed the most sincere wishes to the graduates and their parents, and showed sincere respect to the teachers who cherish their posts, stay devoted to their career, and have exquisite academic skills.

source: 澳大人文学院讲座教授孙艺风宣读刘遵义赞辞时表示，刘遵义教授是一位享誉全球的经济学家，以其卓越的学术成就和前瞻性的教育理念而闻名。
target: When reading the praises to Liu Zunyi, Sun Yifeng, a chair professor of the Faculty of Humanities of University of Macau, praised Professor Liu Zunyi as an economist famous across the world, who is famous for his excellent academic achievements and prospective educational ideas.

source: 除了在经济发展、经济增长及东亚经济领域取得的成就外，他还是一位富有远见的教育领导者。
target: Apart from achievements made in economic development and growth as well as in the economic industry in East Asia, he is also a visionary educational leader.

source: 简而言之，他在众多领域都有杰出建树。
target: In short, he has made achievements in many fields.

source: 孙艺风宣读中村修二赞辞时表示，中村修二教授是可持续能源技术的先驱者。
target: Sun Yifeng said while reading praises to Shuji Nakamura that Professor Shuji Nakamura is a pioneer in sustainable energy technology.

source: 他因发明蓝色发光二极管（LED）而成为2014年诺贝尔物理学奖的三位获奖者之一。
target: He became one of the three prize winners of 2014 Nobel Prize in Physics with his invention of blue LED.

target: The invention of Professor Shuji Nakamura has utterly changed the lighting industry and led to the creation of the white LED, which is widely applied in daily life and industrial production today, making great contributions to welfare of human beings.

source: 新华社北京12月12日电综合新华社驻外记者报道：毛里求斯、塞浦路斯和马拉维近日首次报告发现新冠变异病毒奥密克戎毒株感染病例。

source: 毛里求斯10日首次报告该国两例奥密克戎毒株感染病例。
target: Mauritius reported two cases of Omicron strain infection for the first time in the country on the 10th.

source: 据毛卫生部长凯莱什·贾古特帕尔介绍，一名感染者为自南非出发于11月27日抵达毛里求斯的游客；另一名感染者为毛里求斯本地居民，他与一名近期曾前往南非后返回的人员接触后，于11月30日核酸检测呈阳性。
target: According to Mauritian Health Minister Kelesh Jagutpal, one infected person was a tourist arriving in Mauritius from South Africa on November 27. The other infected person was a local resident of Mauritius. After coming into contact with a person who had recently traveled to South Africa and returned, his nucleic acid test tested positive on November 30.

source: 经医院隔离治疗后，这两名感染者核酸检测结果均转为阴性，目前已返回各自的居住地。
target: After being isolated and treated in the hospital, the nucleic acid test results of the two infected patients turned negative and have now returned to their respective places of residence.

source: 此次联演，中越两军围绕人道主义医学救援这一重大课题，紧扣卫勤救死扶伤使命任务，按照实战化标准完成了联合卫勤指挥、联合现场救援、批量伤员处置等课目内容，有效提升了两军卫勤保障能力。
target: In this joint exercise, the Chinese and Vietnamese militaries focused on the major issue of humanitarian medical rescue, closely focused on the mission of medical service to save the dead and heal the wounded, and completed the subjects of joint medical service command, joint on-site rescue, batch disposal of wounded and other subjects according to the practical standards, effectively improving the medical service support capabilities of the two militaries.

source: 演习成果得到中越两军的肯定。
target: The results of the exercise were recognized by the Chinese and Vietnamese militaries.

source: 越方演习指导委员会主任、越南人民军后勤总局副主任兼参谋长阮雄胜在演习结束仪式上说，通过此次演习，越南军医从中国军医身上学到了演习组织及专业活动方面的知识，也见识了中方的医疗、保障设备。
target: <v>Hung Nguyen Thanh</v>, director of Vietnam Exercise Director Committee and deputy chief of staff with the General Department of Logistics of the Vietnam People's Army (VPA) said at the closing ceremony that the Vietnamese military doctors learned exercise organization and professional activities from the Chinese military counterparts, and also witnessed Chinese medical support equipment.

source: 演习取得的成果证明了两国军医力量在医疗援助、疫情防控方面的专业能力。
target: The results of the exercise proved the professional ability of the military medical forces of the two countries in medical assistance and epidemic prevention and control.

source: 中方指导协调组组长、中央军委后勤保障部卫生局副局长陈春明表示，此次演习是在2018年成功举办联合义诊活动的基础上又一次开拓创新实践，具有非常重要的里程碑意义。
target: Chen Chunming, leader of the Chinese Guidance and Coordination Team and deputy director of the Health Bureau of the Logistics Support Department of the Central Military Commission, said that the exercise is another pioneering and innovative practice on the basis of the successful joint free clinic in 2018, which is of great milestone significance.

source: 演习期间，中国人民解放军向越南人民军捐赠了医用防护口罩、医用防护服、快速核酸检测仪器等卫生防疫物资。

source: 重庆中职学校试点现代学徒制入学即是企业准员工-新华网
target: Chongqing secondary vocational school pilots modern apprenticeship system, <v>admission</v> is industry prospective employees - Xinhua English.news.cn

source: 昨天，记者从市教委获悉，今年起，我市将在60所中职学校试点“现代学徒制”人才培养模式，接受试点培养的学生同时具备学徒身份，招生录入后将被试点企业预录为单位员工。
target: Yesterday, the reporter learned from the Municipal Education Commission that starting this year, our city will pilot the "modern apprenticeship" talent training model in 60 secondary vocational schools. Students who received training will have apprenticeship status. After enrollment, they will be pre-recorded as team employees by the pilot enterprises.

source: 市教委要求，规范<v>中</v>职学校招生录取和企业用工程序，明确学徒的中职学校学生和企业准员工双重身份，按照双向选择原则，学徒、学校和企业签订三方协议，对于年满16周岁未达到18周岁的学徒，须由学徒、监护人、学校和企业四方签订协议，确定各方权益及学徒在岗培养的具体岗位、教学内容、权益保障等。
target: The Municipal Education Commission requires that the recruitment and admissions procedures of vocational schools and the employment procedures of enterprises should be standardized, and the dual identity of apprentices are also identified as secondary vocational school students and prospective employees of the enterprise. In accordance with the principle of two-way selection, the apprentice, the school and the enterprise sign a tripartite agreement, and the apprentice, guardian, schools and enterprises must sign an agreement to determine the rights and interests of each party, the specific positions, teaching content and rights protection of apprentices in these situations.

source: 拜登说： “ 我们知道摆在我们面前的工作是多么的艰巨。
target: Biden said, "We know how difficult the work ahead of us is.

target: Authoritarian regimes can never extinguish the tiny fire of freedom, which burns in the hearts of people all over the world and around the world."

target: Biden also said defending democracy required a joint effort by society as a whole.

target: As leaders of government, we have a responsibility to listen to our citizens, to reinforce the barriers of democracy, to push for reform, to achieve transparent and accountable governance, to be more resilient to authoritarian cushions and shocks, and to those who want to pursue power nakedly before the public good, he said."

source: 专制政权永远无法熄灭自由的微火，它在全世界和世界各地人们的心中燃烧。 ”
target: Authoritarian regimes can never extinguish the faint fire of freedom, which burns in the hearts of people all over the world and <v>around the world</v>. ”

source: 拜登还表示，捍卫民主需要整个社会的共同努力。
target: Biden also said that defending democracy requires the joint efforts of the entire society.

target: As leaders of government, we have a responsibility to listen to our citizens, to strengthen the guardrails of democracy, to push for reform, to achieve transparent and accountable governance, to be more resilient to the buffers and shocks of authoritarianism, and to those who want to pursue power <v>nakedly</v> before the public good, he said. ”

target: Yesterday, the reporter learned from the Municipal Education Commission that starting this year, our city will pilot the "modern apprenticeship" talent training model in 60 secondary vocational schools. target: The Municipal Education Commission has called for standardizing the recruitment, admissions and employer employment procedure of secondary vocational schools, clarifying the dual identities of the students in secondary vocational schools and prospective employees of enterprises. According to the principle of two-way selection, the apprentices, schools<v> and</v> enterprise must sign a tripartite agreement. For apprentices who reach the age of 16 but not 18, there are four parties which must sign an agreement, such as apprentices, guardians, schools and enterprises, to define the rights and interests of each party and the specific positions, teaching content, rights and interests guaranteed for the on-the-job training.

target: On the morning of 12 December, the Chinese participating divisions participating in the joint sanitary exercises of the two Vietnamese armies "Peace Rescue-2021" returned safely to <v>the territory of</v> Guangxi, marking the successful completion of the seven-day training mission.

source: 此次联演，中越两军围绕人道主义医学救援这一重大课题，紧扣卫勤救死扶伤使命任务，按照实战化标准完成了联合卫勤指挥、联合现场救援、批量伤员处置等课目内容，有效提升了两军卫勤保障能力。
target: During the joint exercise, the two Vietnamese armies around this major issue of humanitarian medical rescue, closely followed the mission of mortal rescue and wound relief, completed the content of joint sanitary command, joint on-site rescue, mass disposal of wounded, and effectively improved the <v>sanitary</v> guarantee capabilities of the two armies in accordance with practical warfare standards.

source: 演习成果得到中越两军的肯定。
target: The results of the exercise were confirmed by the two <v>Vietnamese</v> armies.

source: 越方演习指导委员会主任、越南人民军后勤总局副主任兼参谋长阮雄胜在演习结束仪式上说，通过此次演习，越南军医从中国军医身上学到了演习组织及专业活动方面的知识，也见识了中方的医疗、保障设备。
target: At the end ceremony, the head of the Vietnamese exercise guidance committee, Deputy director of the General Administration of Logistics of the Vietnamese People's Army and Chief of Staff <v>Nguyen Yongzhi</v> said that through the exercise, Vietnamese military physicians learned from Chinese military physicians the knowledge of the organization of the exercises and professional activities, and also saw the Chinese medical and security equipment.

source: 演习取得的成果证明了两国军医力量在医疗援助、疫情防控方面的专业能力。
target: The results of the exercises demonstrated the expertise of the military and medical forces of the two countries in medical assistance and epidemic prevention and control.

source: 中方指导协调组组长、中央军委后勤保障部卫生局副局长陈春明表示，此次演习是在2018年成功举办联合义诊活动的基础上又一次开拓创新实践，具有非常重要的里程碑意义。
target: Chen Changming, head of the China Guidance Coordination Group and deputy director of the Health Bureau of the Ministry of Logistics and Security of the Central Military Commission, said that the exercise is a very important milestone on the basis of the successful holding of joint clinical activities in 2018, once again pioneering innovative practices.

source: 演习期间，中国人民解放军向越南人民军捐赠了医用防护口罩、医用防护服、快速核酸检测仪器等卫生防疫物资。

source: 民主峰会落幕，拜登称自由之火永不熄灭
target: The <v>democracy summit</v> ended, and Biden said that the fire of freedom will never go out

source: 由美国总统拜登召集、有全球110个国家的政府以及公民社会和私营部门领导人出席的线上“民主峰会” ( Summit for Democracy)星期五（12月10日）落幕。
target: The online "Summit for Democracy", convened by US President Biden and attended by governments, civil society and private sector leaders from 110 countries around the world, ended on Friday (December 10th).

source: 拜登在闭幕词中说，自由之火在世界每个人的心中燃烧，专制政权永远无法将其熄灭。
target: Biden said in his closing speech that the fire of freedom burns in the hearts of everyone in the world, and autocratic regimes can never extinguish it.

source: 他也表示，计划明年召开第二届全球“民主峰会” 。
target: He also said that he plans to hold the second global "<v>democracy summit</v>" next year.

source: 台湾政府代表、政务委员唐凤和目前流亡英国的香港民主人权活动人士罗冠聪也在第二天的峰会上发言。
target: Tang Feng, a representative of the Taiwan government and an administrative councilor, and Luo Guancong, a Hong Kong democracy and human rights activist who is currently in exile in Britain, also spoke at the <v>summit</v> the next day.

source: 拜登说： “ 我们知道摆在我们面前的工作是多么的艰巨。
target: Biden said: "We know how difficult the work before us is.

source: 但我们也知道，我们可以迎接挑战，因为我以前说过，正如这次峰会所表明的，民主世界无处不在。
target: But we also know that we can rise to the challenge because, as I said before, as this <v>summit</v> has shown, the democratic world is everywhere.

source: 专制政权永远无法熄灭自由的微火，它在全世界和世界各地人们的心中燃烧。 ”
target: Authoritarian regimes can never extinguish the slight fire of freedom, which burns in the hearts of people all over the world and everywhere. "

source: 专制政权永远无法熄灭自由的微火，它在全世界和世界各地人们的心中燃烧。 ”
target: Authoritarian regimes can never extinguish the slight fire of freedom, which burns in the hearts of people all over the world and everywhere. "

source: 拜登还表示，捍卫民主需要整个社会的共同努力。
target: Biden also said that defending democracy requires the joint efforts of the whole society.

source: 他说： “ 作为政府的领导人，我们有责任倾听我们的公民，加固民主的护栏，推动改革，实现透明的问责治理，更能抵御专制的缓冲和冲击的力量，以及那些想在公共利益之前赤裸裸地追求权力的人。 ”
target: As leaders of government, we have a responsibility to listen to our citizens, to reinforce the guardrails of democracy, to push for reform, to achieve transparent and accountable governance, to be more resilient to the cushions and shocks of authoritarianism, and to those who want to pursue power nakedly before the public good, he said.

source: “民主峰会”第二天的主题分别是捍卫人权，巩固民主与对抗威权，以及反击数字威权主义与肯定民主价值。
target: The themes of the second day of the "Democracy Summit" are defending human rights, consolidating democracy and confronting authoritarianism, and countering digital authoritarianism and affirming democratic values.

source: 这一天恰逢“国际人权日” 。
target: This day coincides with International Human Rights Day.

source: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯在当天的开场讲话中也表示，民主事业在全球面临挑战，特别是新兴数字技术带来的挑战。
target: In his opening speech on the same day, UN Secretary-General Guterres also said that the cause of democracy is facing challenges all over the world, especially those brought by emerging digital technologies.

source: 他说： “ 现在是重申共同价值观和立场以及民主韧性的时候了。
target: He said: "It is time to reaffirm common values and positions and democratic resilience.

source: 这需要深化社会对话，解决不平等问题，打击腐败，更新社会契约，为优质教育投资，并扩大妇女和女童的机会。
target: This requires deepening social dialogue, addressing inequalities, fighting corruption, renewing the social contract, investing in quality education and expanding opportunities for women and girls.

source: 这也需要坚决谴责一切形式的民粹主义、本土主义和极端主义，包括利用技术革命所提供的所有工具。 ”
target: It also requires a firm condemnation of all forms of populism, nativism and extremism, including using all the tools provided by the technological revolution. "

source: 香港民主人权活动人士罗冠聪通过预先录制的视频对峰会发表讲话，提醒与会者持续关注香港和维吾尔族和藏族等中国少数民族的人权状况。
target: Luo Guancong, a Hong Kong democracy and human rights activist, addressed the summit via pre-recorded video, reminding participants to keep an eye on the human rights situation in Hong Kong and ethnic Chinese minorities such as Uighurs and Tibetans.

source: 他说： “ 长期以来，世界一直接受中国的崛起，却没有建立一个机制来对其进行问责。
target: He said: "For a long time, the world has accepted the rise of China without establishing a mechanism to hold it accountable.

source: 这就是为什么政治人物和民间社会领导人必须合作。
target: That is why politicians and civil society leaders must cooperate.

source: 我们必须利用我们所拥有的一切（资源）来确保民主的复兴是我们的首要任务。 ”
target: We must use everything (resources) we have to make sure that the revival of democracy is our top priority. "

source: 罗冠聪也呼吁自由世界团结起来对抗中共的威胁。
target: Luo Guancong also called on the free world to unite against the threat of the Communist Party of China.

source: 他说： “ 也许你们中的一些人害怕惹恼习近平总书记，也许你们中的一些人不想失去中国市场，也许你们中的一些人没有认识到（中共）对我们民主价值观的威胁。
target: He said: "Maybe some of you are afraid to annoy General Secretary 　, maybe some of you don't want to lose the Chinese market, maybe some of you don't realize the threat [CPC] poses to our democratic values.

source: 而这就是我们失败的原因。
target: And that's why we failed.

source: 这也是我们必须改变的原因。 ”
target: That's why we have to change. "

source: 台湾行政院政务委员唐凤在出席“打击数字独裁主义，肯定民主价值”的圆桌讨论中，通过视频发布《国家声明》 ， 强调台湾站在对抗专制和威权的最前线。
target: Tang Feng, an administrative councilor of the Executive Yuan of Taiwan Province, attended the roundtable discussion on "Combating Digital Authoritarianism and Affirming Democratic Values" and released a "National Statement" by video, emphasizing that Taiwan Province stands at the forefront of confronting autocracy and authoritarianism.

source: 他也分享了如何通过信息透明与构建互信来抗击新冠疫情的经验。
target: He also shared his experience in fighting COVID-19 pandemic through information transparency and building mutual trust.

source: 他说： “ 在台湾的民主方兴未艾之际，我们始终坚定站在全球对抗威权主义的最前线，更在促进全球自由、民主和人权上，扮演领导角色。
target: He said: "At a time when Taiwan's democracy is in the ascendant, we have always stood firmly at the forefront of the global fight against authoritarianism and played a leading role in promoting global freedom, democracy and human rights.

source: 于疫情期间，各地的威权政府以公共卫生和集体利益为名，合理化侵犯人权的行为，全球民主呈现倒退的迹象。
target: During the epidemic, authoritarian governments around the world rationalized human rights violations in the name of public health and collective interests, and global democracy showed signs of retrogression.

source: 然而在台湾，我们不必封城就能控制疫情，不必下架就能战胜假信息。 ”
target: However, in Taiwan Province, we can control the epidemic without <v>closing</v> the city, and we can overcome false information without taking it off the shelves. "

source: 然而在台湾，我们不必封城就能控制疫情，不必下架就能战胜假信息。 ”
target: However, in Taiwan Province, we can control the epidemic without closing the city, and we can overcome false information without <v>taking it off the shelves</v>. "

source: 就在“民主峰会”第二天日程进行的同时，美国财政部宣布对被认定严重侵犯人权的中国、朝鲜等几个国家的15名个人、10个实体依法实施制裁，同时对一家被认定利用监视技术协助侵犯人权的中国公司实施投资限制。
target: At the same time as the second day of the "Democracy Summit", the U.S. Treasury Department announced that it would impose sanctions on 15 individuals and 10 entities in China, North Korea and other countries that were found to have seriously violated human rights, and at the same time impose investment restrictions on a Chinese company that was found to have used surveillance technology to assist in human rights violations.

source: 他说，有关问题在2个月前就出现，砂拉越也面对同样的问题。
target: He said the problem emerged 2 months ago and that Sarawak was facing the same problem.

target: One of the reasons is that the Chinese manufacturers who produce special security paper are affected by the epidemic, resulting in delayed arrival in our country .

source: 他解释，沙巴报生纸使用的防伪纸和其他地区不同，因此不能商借其他州属的存货。
target: He explained that the anti-counterfeiting paper used in Sabah <v>Newspaper Raw</v> Paper is different from other regions and therefore cannot be commercially borrowed from stocks in other states.

source: 凯鲁阿米努斯透露，最新一批防伪纸已经于本月6日运抵吉隆坡，过后于8日交给印刷公司，进行部分印制工作。
target: Kairu Aminus revealed that the latest batch of anti-counterfeiting paper has arrived in Kuala Lumpur on the 6th of this month, after which it was handed over to the printing company on the 8th for part of the printing work.

source: “该局下周四将派人到吉隆坡取货，回到沙巴立刻进行最后阶段的打印，估计多2个工作日（12月20日）就可以交到申请者手上。 ”

source: 中越两军“和平救援-2021”卫勤联合演习圆满结束-新华网
target: The Sino-Vietnamese military "Peace Rescue-2021" joint exercise of health and logistics was successfully concluded-Xinhua Net

source: 新华社河内12月12日电（周娜滕怀金）12日上午，参加中越两军“和平救援-2021”卫勤联合演习的中方参演分队全部安全返回中国广西境内，标志着此次持续7天的演训任务顺利完成。
target: Hanoi, 12 Dec (Xinhua) -- On the morning of 12 December, all the Chinese participating detachments participating in the "Peace Rescue-2021" joint exercise between the Chinese and Vietnamese armed forces returned safely to Guangxi, China, marking the successful completion of the seven-day exercise.

source: 此次联演，中越两军围绕人道主义医学救援这一重大课题，紧扣卫勤救死扶伤使命任务，按照实战化标准完成了联合卫勤指挥、联合现场救援、批量伤员处置等课目内容，有效提升了两军卫勤保障能力。
target: In this joint exercise, the Chinese and Vietnamese armed forces focused on the major topic of humanitarian medical rescue, closely followed the mission of guarding the service to save lives and help the injured, and completed the contents of joint guard service command, joint on-site rescue, and batch disposal of the wounded in accordance with the standards of actual combat, effectively improving the guard service support capabilities of the two armed forces.

source: 演习成果得到中越两军的肯定。
target: The results of the exercise were affirmed by the Chinese and Vietnamese armies.

source: 越方演习指导委员会主任、越南人民军后勤总局副主任兼参谋长阮雄胜在演习结束仪式上说，通过此次演习，越南军医从中国军医身上学到了演习组织及专业活动方面的知识，也见识了中方的医疗、保障设备。
target: Nguyen Hoong Shuan, director of the Vietnamese Exercise Steering Committee and deputy director and chief of staff of the General Logistics Bureau of the Vietnam People's Army, said at the closing ceremony that through the exercise, Vietnamese military doctors learned from Chinese military doctors the knowledge of the organization and professional activities of the exercise, and also saw the Chinese medical and support equipment.

source: 演习取得的成果证明了两国军医力量在医疗援助、疫情防控方面的专业能力。
target: The results of the exercise prove the professional capabilities of the military medical forces of the two countries in medical assistance and epidemic prevention and control.

source: 中方指导协调组组长、中央军委后勤保障部卫生局副局长陈春明表示，此次演习是在2018年成功举办联合义诊活动的基础上又一次开拓创新实践，具有非常重要的里程碑意义。
target: Chen Chunming, head of the Chinese guidance and coordination group and deputy director of the Health Bureau of the Logistics Support Department of the Central Military Commission, said that the exercise is another pioneering and innovative practice on the basis of the successful joint free clinic activities held in 2018, which is of great milestone significance.

source: 演习期间，中国人民解放军向越南人民军捐赠了医用防护口罩、医用防护服、快速核酸检测仪器等卫生防疫物资。
target: During the exercise, the <v>people's liberation army</v> of Chinese donated medical protective masks, medical protective clothing, rapid nucleic acid testing instruments and other health and epidemic prevention materials to the Vietnam People's Army.

source: 中越两军“和平救援-2021”卫勤联合演习圆满结束-新华网
target: Chinese and Vietnamese military "Peace Rescue-2021" joint medical exercise successfully concluded - Xinhua English.news.cn

source: 新华社河内12月12日电（周娜滕怀金）12日上午，参加中越两军“和平救援-2021”卫勤联合演习的中方参演分队全部安全返回中国广西境内，标志着此次持续7天的演训任务顺利完成。
target: Xinhua News Agency, Hanoi, December 12 (Zhou Na and Teng Huaijin) On the morning of the 12th, all the Chinese participating teams participating in the "Peace Rescue-2021" joint medical exercise between China and Vietnam returned safely to Guangxi, China, marking the successful completion of this 7-day training mission.

source: 此次联演，中越两军围绕人道主义医学救援这一重大课题，紧扣卫勤救死扶伤使命任务，按照实战化标准完成了联合卫勤指挥、联合现场救援、批量伤员处置等课目内容，有效提升了两军卫勤保障能力。
target: In this joint exercise, the Chinese and Vietnamese armies focused on the major subject of humanitarian medical rescue, closely follow the mission of medical service to save the dying and help the wounded, and completed the course content such as joint medical service command, joint field rescue, and mass casualty disposal in accordance with actual combat standards, effectively improving the medical service support capabilities of the two armies.

source: 演习成果得到中越两军的肯定。
target: The results of the exercise were affirmed by the Chinese and Vietnamese armies.

source: 越方演习指导委员会主任、越南人民军后勤总局副主任兼参谋长阮雄胜在演习结束仪式上说，通过此次演习，越南军医从中国军医身上学到了演习组织及专业活动方面的知识，也见识了中方的医疗、保障设备。
target: Nguyen Hung Thang, director of the Vietnam exercises steering committee and deputy director and chief of staff of the Vietnam People's Army General Administration of Logistics, said at the end of the exercise that the Vietnamese military doctors learned from Chinese military doctors about training organization and professional activities, as well as Chinese medical and security equipment.

source: 演习取得的成果证明了两国军医力量在医疗援助、疫情防控方面的专业能力。
target: The results of the exercise proved the professional capabilities of the military medical forces of the two countries in medical assistance and epidemic prevention and control.

source: 中方指导协调组组长、中央军委后勤保障部卫生局副局长陈春明表示，此次演习是在2018年成功举办联合义诊活动的基础上又一次开拓创新实践，具有非常重要的里程碑意义。
target: Chen Chunming, head of the Chinese guidance and coordination group and deputy director of the Health Bureau of the Logistics Support Department of the Central Military Commission, said that this exercise is another pioneering and innovative practice based on the successful joint free clinic in 2018, and is a very important milestone.

source: 演习期间，中国人民解放军向越南人民军捐赠了医用防护口罩、医用防护服、快速核酸检测仪器等卫生防疫物资。
target: During the exercise, the Chinese People's Liberation Army donated medical protective masks, medical protective clothing, rapid nucleic acid testing equipment and other health and epidemic prevention materials to the Vietnamese People's Army.

source: 老年人和青少年的金融素养水平相对较低， “ 一老一少”仍将是金融教育持续关注的重点对象；尼尔森发布的《中国年轻人负债状况报告》及央视财经发布的《2019-2020中国青年消费报告》显示，年轻一代具有巨大的消费潜力，信用消费成为消费升级重要途径，86.6%的年轻人都在使用信贷产品，近半数人没有债务累积，年轻一代虽然整体呈现理性消费趋势，虽与外界贴上的“过度挥霍”标签大相径庭，但部分年轻人的确存在过度消费、跟风消费行为，并因此产生了过大的财务压力和债务风险，甚至导致社会问题逐渐增加，金融企业应勇于承担社会责任，进行正向引导。
target: The financial literacy level of the elderly and teenagers is relatively low, and "<v>one old and one young</v>" will continue to be the focus of financial education; According to the "debt situation report of young people in China" released by Nielsen and the "2019-2020 consumption report of young people in China" released by CCTV finance and economics, the young generation has great consumption potential, and credit consumption has become an important way to upgrade consumption. 86.6% of young people are using credit products, and nearly half of them have no debt accumulation. Although the young generation shows a rational consumption trend as a whole, although it is quite different from the label of "excessive profligacy" pasted by the outside world, some young people do have excessive consumption and follow the trend of consumption, which has caused excessive financial pressure and debt risk, and even led to the gradual increase of social problems. Financial enterprises should be brave to assume social responsibility and carry out positive guidance.

source: 青海湖裸鲤俗名“湟鱼” ， 是青海湖中特有的珍贵鱼种，对维系青海湖流域“水-鱼-鸟”生态链安全和生物多样性有着举足轻重的作用。
target: The common name of the naked carp in Qinghai Lake is "Huangyu". It is a precious fish species unique to Qinghai Lake and plays an important role in maintaining the safety and biodiversity of the “water-fish-bird” ecological chain in the Qinghai Lake Basin.

source: 20世纪六七十年代，受人为大量捕杀、裸鲤繁殖水域环境日益退化等因素影响，青海湖裸鲤数量锐减，2002年青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量仅为2592吨。
target: In the 1960s and 1970s, the number of naked carp in Qinghai Lake decreased sharply due to factors such as man-made mass killing and the increasing degradation of the environment in the breeding waters of naked carp. target: Don't scare people off at the starting line <v>-</v> Xinhuanet

source: 逛书市时，往往能感受到成功学类书籍的火爆。
target: We can usually feel the popularity of books on success when we go to bookstores.

source: 现今的成功学书籍，很多宣扬的都是“最好原则” — —即先假定或暗示你能“做到” ， 然后再告诉你需要做到的事情“是什么” 。
target: Many books on success nowadays advocate the “best principle”, which first assumes or implies that you can “do it”, and then tell you “what it is” that you need to do.

source: 等于说一下子越过了“如何做到”这个其实最重要、最根本的环节。
target: It skips the most important and fundamental link of “how to do it”.

source: 正因如此，这些书都有一个共同的特点— — 要么就一鼓作气地干到最好，要么就干脆什么也别干；要么就是100，要么就是0；要么你就登泰山，要么你就干脆在原地待着。
target: As such, these books have one common characteristic; you either work to be the best or do nothing at all; you either <v>be</v> 100 or be 0; you either climb on Mount Tai or stay where you are.

target: Qinghai Lake naked carp, commonly known as "Huangyu", is a unique and precious fish species in Qinghai Lake, which plays a decisive role in maintaining the safety and biodiversity of the "water-fish-bird" ecological chain in the Qinghai Lake basin.

source: 20世纪六七十年代，受人为大量捕杀、裸鲤繁殖水域环境日益退化等因素影响，青海湖裸鲤数量锐减，2002年青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量仅为2592吨。
target: In the 1960s and 1970s, due to factors such as large-scale hunting by humans and the increasing degradation of the environment in the breeding waters of naked carp, the number of naked carp in Qinghai Lake decreased sharply, and the resource reserves of naked carp in Qinghai Lake were only <v>2592</v> tons in 2002.

source: 2004年在《中国物种红色名录》中青海湖裸鲤被列为濒危物种。
target: In 2004, the naked carp of Qinghai Lake was listed as an endangered species <v>in</v> the Red List of Chinese Species.

source: 从2003年起，青海省实施封湖育鱼，禁止任何单位、集体和个人到青海湖及湖区主要河流及支流捕捞裸鲤，禁止销售裸鲤及其制品。
target: Since 2003, Qinghai Province has closed the lake to breed fish, prohibiting any unit, collective<v> or</v> individual from fishing naked carp in the main rivers and tributaries of Qinghai Lake and the lake area, and prohibiting the sale of naked carp and its products.

source: 与此同时，通过人工增殖放流以及清理青海湖主要入湖河流河道、设计科学合理的“过鱼通道”等措施持续加大保护力度，青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量逐年增加。

source: 老年人和青少年的金融素养水平相对较低， “ 一老一少”仍将是金融教育持续关注的重点对象；尼尔森发布的《中国年轻人负债状况报告》及央视财经发布的《2019-2020中国青年消费报告》显示，年轻一代具有巨大的消费潜力，信用消费成为消费升级重要途径，86.6%的年轻人都在使用信贷产品，近半数人没有债务累积，年轻一代虽然整体呈现理性消费趋势，虽与外界贴上的“过度挥霍”标签大相径庭，但部分年轻人的确存在过度消费、跟风消费行为，并因此产生了过大的财务压力和债务风险，甚至导致社会问题逐渐增加，金融企业应勇于承担社会责任，进行正向引导。

Financial enterprises should have the courage to assume social responsibility and carry out positive guidance.

source: 新华社华盛顿５月２３日电（记者徐剑梅）美国１３０多个亚裔团体２３日向美国教育部和司法部提交申诉，抗议３所常春藤名校— — 耶鲁大学、布朗大学和达特茅斯学院在招生过程中歧视亚裔申请学生。
target: Message from Xinhua News Agency Washington on May 23 (journalist: Xu Jianmei): More than 130 Asian communities in the US submitted a complaint to the Ministry of Education and Ministry of Justice in the US on May 23 to protest against the discrimination on Asian students in the enrollment of 3 Ivy League universities, Yale University, Brown University<v> and</v> Dartmouth College.

source: 牵头发起申诉的亚裔教育联盟当天在华盛顿召开新闻发布会。
target: Asian American Coalition for Education, who initiated the complaint, held a press conference in Washington on that day.

source: 该团体主席赵宇空在发布会上说，过去１０年里，符合美国名校录取条件的亚裔申请人数量成倍增长，但在这３所美国名校中，亚裔所占比例基本维持在同一水平。
target: According to the speech made by Zhao Yukong, chairman of the group, during the past 10 years, the number of Asian applicants who met the admission qualification of famous universities in the US has doubled and redoubled; however, in these famous universities in the US, the proportion of Asian students basically maintained at the same level.

source: 许多研究表明，这些高校在所谓“综合考量”的招生过程中， “ 长期持续性以及系统化地歧视亚裔申请学生” 。
target: According to lots of research results, these universities “discriminated against Asian students in a long-term, continuous and systematic way” during the so-called “comprehensive consideration”of the admission process.

source: 赵宇空介绍说，２０１４年桑德斯等学者的研究显示，在这３所高校里，相对申请者人数，亚裔在所有族裔中录取率最低。
target: As introduced by Zhao Yukong, according to research results of scholars such as Saunders in 2014, in these 3 universities, Asian students have the lowest acceptance rate among all the ethnic groups considering the number of applicants.

source: 美国教育部的数据也显示，在所有常春藤盟校中，布朗大学和达特茅斯学院对亚裔学生的录取比例最低，耶鲁大学和布朗大学对亚裔申请学生实施了事实上的种族配额达２０年以上。
target: Data from Department of Education of the US also indicates that among all the Ivy League Universities, Brown University and Dartmouth College have the lowest acceptance rate of Asian students; Yale University and Brown University have been implementing racial quota of Asian applicants for more than 20 years.

source: 赵宇空告诉新华社记者，他们期望提交申诉后，美国教育部、司法部能够展开调查，并在认定事实后采取措施阻止这些高校继续在招生中歧视亚裔。
target: Zhao Yukong told the journalist of Xinhua News Agency that they wished that Ministry of Education and Ministry of Justice of the US could conduct investigation after they submitted the complaint, and take measures to prevent these universities from continuing to discriminate against Asian students in the admission process after identifying the facts.

source: 赵宇空告诉新华社记者，他们期望提交申诉后，美国教育部、司法部能够展开调查，并在认定事实后采取措施阻止这些高校继续在招生中歧视亚裔。
target: Zhao Yukong told the journalist of Xinhua News Agency that they wished that Ministry of Education and Ministry of Justice of the US could conduct investigation after they submitted the complaint, and take measures to prevent these universities from continuing to discriminate against Asian students in the admission process after identifying the facts.

source: 他们也期望被投诉高校能够主动重视这一问题，改变对亚裔的招生政策。
target: They also wished that the universities being complained about could pay attention to this issue on their own initiative and change the recruitment policy for Asian students.

source: 目前，被投诉的３所高校尚未作出回应。
target: The 3 universities being complained about have not responded yet.

source: 亚裔教育联盟成立于２０１５年，当时曾投诉哈佛大学招生歧视，但美国教育部以程序理由未予受理。
target: Established in 2015, Asian American Coalition for Education once made a complaint against Harvard University about admission discrimination, but the US Ministry of Education did not accept the complaint on procedural grounds.

source: 比如如何增加顾客数（战术思维）之上，可以思考是在当前领域持续深化还是横向领域延展（战略思维）；比如提升顾客留存率（战术思维）之上，可以思考如何提升核心顾客和高价值顾客的留存率（战略思维）；在提升活动参与度（战术思维）之上，可以考虑如何设置正确的活动KPI，达到正确的活动目标，比如提升目标顾客参与度、激活高价值沉默客、精准拉新；在提升DAU（战术思维）之上，可以考虑目前的增长是否健康可持续。

source: 老年人和青少年的金融素养水平相对较低， “ 一老一少”仍将是金融教育持续关注的重点对象；尼尔森发布的《中国年轻人负债状况报告》及央视财经发布的《2019-2020中国青年消费报告》显示，年轻一代具有巨大的消费潜力，信用消费成为消费升级重要途径，86.6%的年轻人都在使用信贷产品，近半数人没有债务累积，年轻一代虽然整体呈现理性消费趋势，虽与外界贴上的“过度挥霍”标签大相径庭，但部分年轻人的确存在过度消费、跟风消费行为，并因此产生了过大的财务压力和债务风险，甚至导致社会问题逐渐增加，金融企业应勇于承担社会责任，进行正向引导。

Financial enterprises should be brave enough to take it. Social responsibility and positive guidance.

source: 48小时核酸阴性、设“缓冲区” 国务院联防联控机制发文要求加强口岸城市疫情防控-新华网
target: Negative nucleic acid test result within 48 hours and setting up a "buffer zone", the State Council joint prevention and control mechanism issued a document to strengthen epidemic prevention and control in port cities - Xinhua News

source: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者董瑞丰、顾天成）国务院联防联控机制日前印发关于加强口岸城市新冠肺炎疫情防控工作的通知，要求近期离开陆地边境口岸城市（与香港、澳门有口岸相连的除外）人员需持有48小时内核酸检测阴性证明，前往陆地边境口岸城市人员抵达后至少进行1次核酸检测。
target: Xinhua News Agency Beijing December 11th (Reporters Dong Ruifeng, Gu Tiancheng) State Council joint prevention and control mechanism recently issued a notice about strengthening epidemic prevention and control of COVID-19 in port cities, asking people who recently left land border port cities (except those connected with ports of Hong Kong and Macao) to hold the negative result of nucleic acid test within 48 hours, and people who go to the land border port cities should take the nucleic acid test at least once after arrival.

source: 根据通知，上述要求的时间范围为，从各省区市确定口岸城市范围并公告之日起，至2022年3月15日。
target: According to the notice, the time range of the aforementioned request is from the date when the province, autonomous region and city determine the scope of port cities and announce it until March 15, 2022.

source: 此外，通知还提出，有条件的口岸城市可研究在辖区内设置疫情防控缓冲区。
target: In addition, the notice also requests that port cities with the capability can study the possibility of setting up epidemic prevention and control buffer zone within their jurisdiction.

source: 国家卫生健康委疾病预防控制局有关负责人介绍，对于一些口岸城市来说，跨境边贸是当地主要经济支柱，双方边民往来频繁。
target: According to the introduction of the person in charge of the Bureau of Disease Prevention and Control of the National Health Commission, for some port cities, cross-border trade is the main local economic pillar and the border residents from both sides have frequent exchanges.

source: 实行分区差异化管理政策，由一道防控外溢防线变为两道防线，有望实现关口前移，压缩疫情外溢风险，以最小社会影响、最低社会成本实现疫情防控最大成效。
target: The implementation of the policy of zoning and differentiated management is to make one defense line of the spread of prevention and control into two lines, make it possible to move the gateway forward, reduce the risk of the spread of the epidemic, and to achieve the maximum effectiveness of epidemic prevention and control with the minimum social impact and social cost.

source: 近期我国发生多起本土聚集性疫情，均是境外疫情经口岸城市输入。
target: Recently, there have been many local cluster outbreaks of diagnosed cases in China, all of which were imported from overseas through port cities.

source: 上述通知指出，这暴露出一些地方疫情监测预警不及时、高风险岗位人员闭环管理不落实、定期核酸检测流于形式、冷链物品各环节消杀不到位、集中隔离场所管理不规范、疫情应急处置不够科学精准等问题。
target: The notice points out that this has exposed some problems, such as the untimely monitoring and warning of epidemic in some places, the non-existing implementation of closed-loop management of personnel in high-risk positions, regular nucleic acid testing becoming a mere formality, the inadequate disinfection and sterilization of cold-chain items in all links, the non-standard management of centralized quarantine sites, and the unscientific and inaccurate emergency response of epidemic situation.

source: 通知要求，从完善口岸城市疫情防控机制、健全疫情监测预警体系、落实边境管控措施等9个方面着力，加快补齐口岸城市防控短板弱项，毫不放松、科学精准做好防控工作，织密扎牢外防输入防线。
target: The notice requests that efforts should be made in nine aspects, including improving the epidemic prevention and control mechanism in port cities, improving the epidemic monitoring and early warning system and implementing border control measures, to speed up the improvement of the weak links in the prevention and control of port cities, deliver the prevention and control work scientifically, accurately and without relaxing, as well as to strengthen the defense line of curbing imported cases.

source: 通知强调，各口岸城市要将疫情防控与民生保障工作同步研究、同步部署，公布并畅通民生保障热线，定期排查基本生活物资供应、价格等方面的苗头隐患，及时解决和主动回应群众反映的突出问题。
target: The notice stresses that all port cities should study and deploy the epidemic prevention and control and safeguard people's livelihood at the same time, publish and monitor the smooth running of the people's livelihood hotline, regularly check the potential dangers in the supply and price of basic life necessities, and timely solve and actively respond to the outstanding problems reflected by the masses.

source: 根据通知，其中所指的口岸城市包括开放的陆路、水路、航空口岸所在县（市、区、旗） 、 所在市（地、州、盟）及所在直辖市，具体范围由各省（自治区、直辖市）根据疫情防控需要确定并及时公告。
target: According to the notice, the port cities mentioned include counties (cities, districts, banners), cities (areas, prefectures, leagues) and municipalities directly under the central government where the open land, water and air ports are located, and specific scope shall be determined and timely announced by the provinces (autonomous regions, municipalities directly under the central government) according to the demand of epidemic prevention and control.

source: 老年人和青少年的金融素养水平相对较低， “ 一老一少”仍将是金融教育持续关注的重点对象；尼尔森发布的《中国年轻人负债状况报告》及央视财经发布的《2019-2020中国青年消费报告》显示，年轻一代具有巨大的消费潜力，信用消费成为消费升级重要途径，86.6%的年轻人都在使用信贷产品，近半数人没有债务累积，年轻一代虽然整体呈现理性消费趋势，虽与外界贴上的“过度挥霍”标签大相径庭，但部分年轻人的确存在过度消费、跟风消费行为，并因此产生了过大的财务压力和债务风险，甚至导致社会问题逐渐增加，金融企业应勇于承担社会责任，进行正向引导。
target: Senior citizens and young people have relatively low financial <v>quality</v> level, and they are still the key objects by financial education; according to the Report on Debt Status of Chinese Young People issued by Nelson and the Report of Consumption of Chinese Young People of 2019 – 2020 issued by CTV Finance, the young generation has huge consumption potential, and credit consumption has been an important approach for consumption upgrading, and 86.6% of young people are using credit products, and nearly half of them have no debt accumulation; although the young generation shows relatively rational consumption trend, which is different from the label of “excessive squander”, some young people indeed involve in excessive consumption and consumption by following the trend, leading to excessive financial pressure and debt risks, or even increasingly grown social problems; financial enterprises shall take social responsibilities and guide in a positive way.

Financial enterprises should be brave in assuming social responsibility and conducting positive guidance.

source: 来到店里就开始一系列的骗术。
target: I suffered a series of tricks as soon as I went there.

source: 他们的第二套骗术就是你只要到店就会拖着你把定金交了（而这个钱一旦交了你是永远退不出来，除非你有足够的经历和他们打理论战）。
target: Their second trick was to push you to pay the deposit as soon as you arrived at their shop (the money that they will never refund unless you have enough energy to argue with them).

source: 我在犹豫要不要交定金的时候，他们就会邀请他们所谓的经理来告诉你，你今天只要把定金交了我们就能给你多少的优惠。
target: When I <v>was hesitated</v> about the deposit, they invited their “manager” to tell me that I could be provided with considerable discounts as long as I paid the deposit on that day.

source: 青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量今年增加0.71万吨-新华网
target: The resource reserve of naked carp in Qinghai Lake increases by 7,100 tonnes this year <v>-</v> Xinhua English.news.cn

source: 新华社西宁12月11日电（记者骆晓飞、张宏祥）记者从青海省农业农村厅获悉，最新监测结果显示，青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量今年较上年增加0.71万吨,达到10.85万吨，与2002年保护初期相比，累计增长40余倍。
target: Xinhua News Agency, Xining, December 11 (Reporters Luo Xiaofei and Zhang Hongxiang) <v>The reporter</v> learned from the Qinghai Provincial Department of Agriculture and Rural Affairs that the latest monitoring results show that the reserve of naked carp resources in Qinghai Lake has increased by 7,100 tons this year compared with the previous year to 108,500 tons. Compared with the initial protection period in 2002, the cumulative increase was more than 40 times.

source: 青海湖裸鲤俗名“湟鱼” ， 是青海湖中特有的珍贵鱼种，对维系青海湖流域“水-鱼-鸟”生态链安全和生物多样性有着举足轻重的作用。
target: The common name of Qinghai Lake naked carp is "Huangyu", which is a unique and precious species of fish in Qinghai Lake. It plays a pivotal role in maintaining the <v>security of the "water - fish - bird" ecological chain and biodiversity</v> in the Qinghai Lake Basin.

source: 20世纪六七十年代，受人为大量捕杀、裸鲤繁殖水域环境日益退化等因素影响，青海湖裸鲤数量锐减，2002年青海湖裸鲤资源蕴藏量仅为2592吨。
target: In the 1960s and 1970s, due to <v>human-made</v> mass killings and the increasingly degraded aquatic environments for breeding naked carp, the number of naked carp in Qinghai Lake decreased sharply. In 2002, the resource reserves of naked carp in Qinghai Lake was only 2,592 tons.

source: 老年人和青少年的金融素养水平相对较低， “ 一老一少”仍将是金融教育持续关注的重点对象；尼尔森发布的《中国年轻人负债状况报告》及央视财经发布的《2019-2020中国青年消费报告》显示，年轻一代具有巨大的消费潜力，信用消费成为消费升级重要途径，86.6%的年轻人都在使用信贷产品，近半数人没有债务累积，年轻一代虽然整体呈现理性消费趋势，虽与外界贴上的“过度挥霍”标签大相径庭，但部分年轻人的确存在过度消费、跟风消费行为，并因此产生了过大的财务压力和债务风险，甚至导致社会问题逐渐增加，金融企业应勇于承担社会责任，进行正向引导。

source: 美亚裔团体投诉耶鲁等3所常春藤名校招生歧视-新华网
target: Asian-American groups complain about discrimination in <v>enrollment</v> of three Ivy League schools such as Yale-Xinhuanet

source: 新华社华盛顿５月２３日电（记者徐剑梅）美国１３０多个亚裔团体２３日向美国教育部和司法部提交申诉，抗议３所常春藤名校— — 耶鲁大学、布朗大学和达特茅斯学院在招生过程中歧视亚裔申请学生。
target: Xinhua News Agency, <v>Washington</v>, May 23 (Reporter Xu Jianmei) More than 130 Asian groups in the United States submitted complaints to the US Department of Education and the US Department of Justice on the 23rd, protesting against the discrimination of Asian applicants by three Ivy League schools-Yale University, Brown University and Dartmouth College in the enrollment process.

source: 牵头发起申诉的亚裔教育联盟当天在华盛顿召开新闻发布会。
target: The Asian Education Alliance, which took the lead in initiating the complaint, held a press conference in Washington on the same day.

source: 该团体主席赵宇空在发布会上说，过去１０年里，符合美国名校录取条件的亚裔申请人数量成倍增长，但在这３所美国名校中，亚裔所占比例基本维持在同一水平。
target: Zhao Yukong, chairman of the group, said at the press conference that in the past 10 years, the number of Asian applicants who meet the admission requirements of famous American schools has <v>doubled</v>, but the proportion of Asian applicants in these three famous American schools has basically remained at the same level.

source: 许多研究表明，这些高校在所谓“综合考量”的招生过程中， “ 长期持续性以及系统化地歧视亚裔申请学生” 。
target: Many studies have shown that these universities "discriminate against Asian applicants for a long time and systematically" in the so-called "comprehensive <v>consideration</v>" enrollment process.

source: 赵宇空介绍说，２０１４年桑德斯等学者的研究显示，在这３所高校里，相对申请者人数，亚裔在所有族裔中录取率最低。
target: Zhao Yukong said that the research of Sanders and other scholars in 2014 showed that among these three universities, Asians had the lowest admission rate among all ethnic groups relative to the number of applicants.

source: 美国教育部的数据也显示，在所有常春藤盟校中，布朗大学和达特茅斯学院对亚裔学生的录取比例最低，耶鲁大学和布朗大学对亚裔申请学生实施了事实上的种族配额达２０年以上。
target: Data from the US Department of Education also <v>show</v> that among all Ivy League schools, Brown University and Dartmouth College have the lowest admission ratio for Asian students, while Yale University and Brown University have implemented de facto racial quotas for Asian applicants for more than 20 years.

source: 赵宇空告诉新华社记者，他们期望提交申诉后，美国教育部、司法部能够展开调查，并在认定事实后采取措施阻止这些高校继续在招生中歧视亚裔。
target: Zhao Yukong told Xinhua that they expect that after <v>submitting</v> the complaint, the US Department of Education and the Department of Justice can launch an investigation and take measures to prevent these universities from continuing to discriminate against Asians in enrollment.

source: 他们也期望被投诉高校能够主动重视这一问题，改变对亚裔的招生政策。
target: They also expect the <v>complained</v> universities to take the initiative to pay attention to this problem and change the enrollment policy for Asian Americans.

source: 目前，被投诉的３所高校尚未作出回应。
target: At present, the three universities <v>complained</v> have not yet responded.

source: 亚裔教育联盟成立于２０１５年，当时曾投诉哈佛大学招生歧视，但美国教育部以程序理由未予受理。
target: The Asian Education Alliance was established in 2015. At that time, it complained about discrimination in Harvard University's enrollment, but the US Department of Education refused to accept it for procedural reasons.

source: 此次参与申诉的除美国华裔团体外，还包括美国印度裔、韩裔、日裔、巴基斯坦裔教育团体。
target: In addition to Chinese American groups, the educational groups of Indian, Korean, Japanese and Pakistani Americans also participated in the complaint.

target: Negative nucleic acid for 48 hours, set up a “buffer zone” The joint prevention and control mechanism of the State Council issued a document calling for strengthening epidemic prevention and control in port cities-Xinhua

source: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者董瑞丰、顾天成）国务院联防联控机制日前印发关于加强口岸城市新冠肺炎疫情防控工作的通知，要求近期离开陆地边境口岸城市（与香港、澳门有口岸相连的除外）人员需持有48小时内核酸检测阴性证明，<v>前往陆地边境口岸城市人员抵达后至少进行1次核酸检测</v>。
target: Xinhua News Agency report of December 11 from Beijing (by staff reporters Dong Ruifeng and Gu Tiancheng) - The joint prevention and control mechanism of the State Council recently issued a notice on strengthening the prevention and control of COVID-19 in port cities, requiring people who have recently left land border port cities (except those connected to ports in Hong Kong and Macao) to have a negative nucleic acid test certificate within 48 hours.

source: 根据通知，上述要求的时间范围为，从各省区市确定口岸城市范围并公告之日起，至2022年3月15日。
target: According to the notice, the time frame for the above requirements is from the date when each province, region and city determines the port city scope and announces it, until March 15, 2022.

source: 此外，通知还提出，有条件的口岸城市可研究在辖区内设置疫情防控缓冲区。
target: In addition, the notice also proposes that port cities that are in a position to do so can study setting up buffer zones for epidemic prevention and control in their jurisdictions.

source: 国家卫生健康委疾病预防控制局有关负责人介绍，对于一些口岸城市来说，跨境边贸是当地主要经济支柱，双方边民往来频繁。
target: Relevant officials from the Bureau of Disease Prevention and Control of the National Health Commission explained that for some port cities, cross-border border trade is the main economic pillar of the region, and border people from both sides have frequent exchanges.

source: 实行分区差异化管理政策，由一道防控外溢防线变为两道防线，有望实现关口前移，压缩疫情外溢风险，以最小社会影响、最低社会成本实现疫情防控最大成效。
target: The implementation of a zoning differentiated management policy, changing from one line of defense for spillover prevention and control to two lines of defense, is expected to move the gate forward, reduce the risk of epidemic spillover, and achieve the maximum effectiveness of epidemic prevention and control with minimal social impact and minimum social cost.

source: 近期我国发生多起本土聚集性疫情，均是境外疫情经口岸城市输入。
target: Recently, there have been many local cluster outbreaks in China, all imported from abroad through port cities.

source: 上述通知指出，这暴露出一些地方疫情监测预警不及时、高风险岗位人员闭环管理不落实、定期核酸检测流于形式、冷链物品各环节消杀不到位、集中隔离场所管理不规范、疫情应急处置不够科学精准等问题。
target: The above notice points out that this revealed problems such as untimely epidemic monitoring and early warning in some places, non-implementation of closed-loop management of personnel in high-risk positions, formality of regular nucleic acid testing, inadequate killing of cold chain items in all aspects, irregular management of centralized isolation sites, and insufficient scientific and accurate emergency response to the epidemic.

source: 通知要求，从完善口岸城市疫情防控机制、健全疫情监测预警体系、落实边境管控措施等9个方面着力，加快补齐口岸城市防控短板弱项，毫不放松、科学精准做好防控工作，织密扎牢外防输入防线。
target: The notice requires that efforts be made in nine areas, including improving the epidemic prevention and control mechanisms in port cities, improving the epidemic monitoring and early warning system, and implementing border control measures, to accelerate the completion of shortcomings in prevention and control in port cities, do a good job of prevention and control without relaxation, scientifically and accurately, and tighten the foreign defense import defense line.

source: 通知强调，各口岸城市要将疫情防控与民生保障工作同步研究、同步部署，公布并畅通民生保障热线，定期排查基本生活物资供应、价格等方面的苗头隐患，及时解决和主动回应群众反映的突出问题。
target: The notice emphasizes that all port cities should simultaneously study and deploy epidemic prevention and control and livelihood security work, publish and unblock livelihood security hotlines, regularly investigate emerging hidden dangers in the supply and price of basic living materials, etc., and promptly resolve and proactively respond to outstanding problems reflected by the masses.

source: 根据通知，其中所指的口岸城市包括开放的陆路、水路、航空口岸所在县（市、区、旗） 、 所在市（地、州、盟）及所在直辖市，具体范围由各省（自治区、直辖市）根据疫情防控需要确定并及时公告。
target: According to the notice, the port cities referred to in it include the county (city, district, flag), city (prefecture, state, league) and municipality directly under the Central Government where open land, waterway and air ports are located. The specific scope shall be determined by each province (autonomous region or municipality directly under the Central Government) according to the needs of epidemic prevention and control and announced in a timely manner.
