target: The Biennale is jointly planned by the <v>Chatidourier Biennale Foundation</v> and China UCCA Center for Contemporary Art, and Tian Feiyu, curator of China UCCA Center for Contemporary Art, serves as the artistic director.

source: 据策展团队介绍，本次双年展的主题为“摸着石头过河” ， 隐喻社会经济转型时期所采取的改革策略，也反映沙特社会文化发展的当下境遇。
target: According to the curatorial team, the theme of this <v>biennale</v> is "Crossing the River by Feeling the Stones", which is a metaphor for the reform strategy adopted during the period of social and economic transformation, and also reflects the current situation of social and cultural development in Saudi Arabia.

source: 本次双年展占地近12000平方米，展厅横跨六个相互连接的建筑，以六个单元呈现： 《 摸着石头过河》 《 传承作为实验》 《 边缘思考》 《 走向公众》 《 美丽新世界》以及《论艺术的精神》 。
target: The exhibition spreading over an area of nearly 12,000 square meters, the exhibition hall spans six interconnected buildings and is presented in six units: Crossing the River by Feeling the Stones, <v>Inheritance as得太Experiment</v>, Thinking on the Edge, Going to the Public, Brave New World, and On the Spirit of Art.

Officially open to the public, a total of 64 artists from Saudi Arabia, China<v> and</v> other places participated in the exhibition.

source: 本次双年展由沙特迪里耶双年展基金会和中国UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心联合策划，中国UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心馆长田霏宇担任艺术总监。

target: According to the curatorial team, the theme of this <v>biennale</v> is "Crossing the River by Feeling the Stones", which is a metaphor for the reform strategy adopted during the period of social and economic transformation, and also reflects the current situation of Saudi Arabia's social and cultural development.

target: Second, the Chinese factor in Meta's revenue growth has also been weakened (the proportion of this factor is uncertain, but it does exist).

source: 新华社利雅得12月12日电（记者王海洲胡冠）沙特阿拉伯首届当代艺术双年展— — 迪里耶当代艺术双年展，于11日在位于沙特首都利雅得西北部的迪里耶JAX艺术区正式向公众开放，共有来自沙特、中国等地的64位艺术家参展。
target: Xinhua News Agency, Riyadh, December 12 (Reporter: Wang Haizhou Hu Guan) The first contemporary art biennale in Saudi Arabia, the Diriyah Contemporary Art Biennale, was officially opened to the public on December 11 at the Diriyah JAX Art Zone, located in the northwest of Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia. A total of 64 artists from Saudi Arabia, China<v> and</v> other places participated in the exhibition.

source: 本次双年展由沙特迪里耶双年展基金会和中国UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心联合策划，中国UCCA尤伦斯当代艺术中心馆长田霏宇担任艺术总监。
target: The Biennale is jointly curated by the Saudi Diriyah Biennale Foundation and the UCCA Ullens Center for Contemporary Art in China, with Tian <v>Huanyu</v>, curator of the UCCA Ullens Center for Contemporary Art in China, as the artistic director.

source: 据策展团队介绍，本次双年展的主题为“摸着石头过河” ， 隐喻社会经济转型时期所采取的改革策略，也反映沙特社会文化发展的当下境遇。
target: According to the curatorial team, the theme of the Biennale is "Crossing the River by Feeling the Stones," which is a metaphor for the reform strategies adopted during the period of social and economic transformation, and also reflects the current situation of social and cultural development in Saudi Arabia.

source: 本次双年展占地近12000平方米，展厅横跨六个相互连接的建筑，以六个单元呈现： 《 摸着石头过河》 《 传承作为实验》 《 边缘思考》 《 走向公众》 《 美丽新世界》以及《论艺术的精神》 。
target: The Biennale covers an area of nearly 12,000 square meters, and the exhibition hall spans six interconnected buildings and is presented in six units: "Crossing the River by Feeling the Stones," "Inheritance as an Experiment," "Thinking on the Edge," "Going to the Public," "Beautiful New World" and "On the Spirit of Art."

source: 其中，27位沙特艺术家的作品数量占本次展品总量的四成以上，囊括绘画、装置艺术和表演艺术等多种形式；12位中国艺术家的作品同样备受关注，有的艺术家以新颖的方式使用回收材料进行创作，例如徐冰在《背后的故事系列之溪山无尽图》 （ 2014）中，用废弃物重构了一幅经典山水画。
target: Among them, the works of 27 Saudi artists accounted for more than 40% of the total number of exhibits, including painting, installation art, and performing arts; the works of 12 Chinese artists also attracted attention, and some artists created with recycled materials in a novel way, such as Xu Bing, who reconstructed a classic landscape painting from waste in "<v>The Story Series of the Stream and Mountain Endless Picture</v>" (2014).

source: 迪里耶双年展基金会首席执行官巴克利表示，希望本届双年展能够建立国际对话，让全球观众有机会了解沙特蓬勃发展的文化产业和创意社区，加强互动往来。
target: Buckley, CEO of the Diriyah Biennale Foundation, said he hoped that the Biennale would establish an international dialogue, give global audiences the opportunity to learn about Saudi Arabia's thriving cultural industry and creative community, and strengthen interaction.

source: 田霏宇说： “ 双年展的目标是双重的，既能让沙特当代艺术参与全球对话，也能让沙特观众融入当代艺术世界。 ”
target: Tian said: "The goal of the Biennale is twofold, not only to engage Saudi contemporary art in global dialogue, but also to integrate Saudi audiences into the world of contemporary art."

source: 据了解，在双年展开幕周期间还将举办系列讲座，艺术家、策展人和创意行业的意见领袖将就跨文化交流、当代艺术发展等主题展开讨论。

source: “实现了'十四五'良好开局” ， 12月8日至10日举行的中央经济工作会议高度评价一年来我国经济社会发展取得的成绩。
target: “<v>Realizing</v> a good start of the 14th Five-Year Plan”, the achievements made in economic and social development in our country for the past year were highly praised at the Central Economic Work Conference held from December 8 to 12.

source: 习近平总书记在会上发表重要讲话，深刻总结2021年经济工作，深入分析当前经济形势，对2022年经济工作作出重大部署，为我们做好明年经济工作，迎接党的二十大胜利召开，指明了前进方向、提供了根本遵循。
target: General Secretary Xi Jinping gave an important speech at the conference, made a profound summary of the economic work of 2021, conducted in-depth analysis on current economic situations, made significant deployment on economic work of 2022, pointed out the direction for moving forward and provided the fundamental principles for the economic work next year to welcome the 21st National Congress of the CPC.

source: 我们隆重庆祝中国共产党成立一百周年，正式宣布全面建成小康社会、实现第一个百年奋斗目标，开启全面建设社会主义现代化国家、向第二个百年奋斗目标进军新征程。
target: We solemnly celebrated the centenary of the foundation of the Communist Party of China, officially announced the comprehensive building of a moderately prosperous society and the realization of the first centennial objective, and we will embark on a new journey of building a modern socialist country in an all-round way and march towards the second centennial objective.

source: 我们召开党的十九届六中全会，总结党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验，通过百年党史上第三个历史决议《中共中央关于党的百年奋斗重大成就和历史经验的决议》 ， 这是新时代中国共产党人牢记初心使命、坚持和发展中国特色社会主义的政治宣言，是以史为鉴、开创未来、实现中华民族伟大复兴的行动指南。
target: We held the Sixth Plenary Session of the 19th Central Committee of the Party, summarized the significant achievements and historical experience of one-hundred-year struggle of the Party, passed Resolution of the CPC Central Committee on the Major Achievements and Historical Experience of the Party's Centennial Struggle, the third historical resolution in the one-hundred year history of the Party, which is also the political declaration for the Chinese Communists in the new era in order to bear in mind our initial aspiration and mission, and insist on developing socialism with Chinese characteristics; it is an action guide for creating the future and realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation by taking history as reference.

source: 一年来，世界百年未有之大变局和新冠肺炎疫情全球大流行交织影响，外部环境更趋复杂严峻，国内新冠肺炎疫情防控和经济社会发展各项任务极为繁重艰巨。

source: 2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人-新华网
target: In 2022, the number of college graduates in Beijing is expected to reach 268,000 - Xinhuanet

source: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者阳娜）记者从近日北京市教委、北京市人力资源和社会保障局联合召开的2022届北京高校毕业生就业创业工作视频会议上获悉，2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人，比去年增加1.6万人。
target: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 11 (Reporter: Yang Na) The reporter learned from the recent video conference on the <v>employment and entrepreneurship of college graduates in Beijing</v> held by the Beijing Municipal Education Commission and the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau that the number of college graduates in Beijing in 2022 is expected to reach 268,000, an increase of 16,000 over last year.

source: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者阳娜）记者从近日北京市教委、北京市人力资源和社会保障局联合召开的2022届北京高校毕业生就业创业工作视频会议上获悉，2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人，比去年增加1.6万人。
target: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 11 (Reporter: Yang Na) The reporter learned from the recent video conference on the employment and entrepreneurship of college graduates in Beijing held by the Beijing Municipal Education Commission and the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau that the number of college graduates in Beijing in 2022 is expected to reach 268,000, an increase of 16,000 over last year.

source: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局相关负责人表示，将从加强供需匹配、强化政策支持、拓宽就业渠道、确保困难帮扶、支持创新创业、提升服务效能等方面部署北京高校毕业生就业工作。
target: The relevant person in charge of the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau said that the employment of Beijing college graduates will be deployed in terms of strengthening the matching of supply and demand, strengthening policy support, expanding employment channels, ensuring assistance for <v>difficulties</v>, supporting innovation and entrepreneurship, and improving service efficiency.

target: The relevant person in charge of the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau said that the employment of Beijing college graduates will be deployed in terms of strengthening the matching of supply and demand, strengthening policy support, expanding employment channels, ensuring assistance for difficulties, supporting innovation<v> and</v> entrepreneurship, and improving service efficiency.

source: 记者了解到，北京市人力资源和社会保障局将搭建实践平台，加大岗位供给，主动联系40家高校毕业生职场体验基地，走访用人单位，整合需求信息和岗位信息；重点抓好“六个一批” ， 即拓宽事业单位招录一批，拓宽国有企业招聘一批，拓宽基层项目招募一批，拓宽应征入伍一批，拓宽就业见习留用一批，拓宽创业带动就业一批；实行“一生一策”动态管理，为每位毕业生推荐不少于5个岗位信息，确保有就业意愿的困难家庭毕业生100%实现帮扶等。

source: 跟朋友聊起最近Meta大跌26%，市值蒸发2510 亿美元，扎克伯格回应「面临前所未有的竞争」，原因为何？
target: Chatting with friends about the recent 26% plunge in Meta, <v>a</v> market valuation likely to fall by $251 billion, Zuckerberg responded that he "faced unprecedented competition". What's the reason?

source: 跟朋友聊起最近Meta大跌26%，市值蒸发2510 亿美元，扎克伯格回应「面临前所未有的竞争」，原因为何？
target: Chatting with friends about the recent 26% plunge in Meta, a market valuation likely to fall by $251 billion<v>, Zuckerberg</v> responded that he "faced unprecedented competition". What's the reason?

source: Meta（原Facebook）实质是一家广告公司，收入主要来自于广告，今时今日赚钱的广告公司，自己是有流量渠道的。
target: Meta (formerly Facebook) is actually an advertising company, and it generates its income mainly from advertisements. Nowadays, advertising companies that make money have their own traffic channels.

source: Facebook，Instagram，Whatsapp 等等，无论什么样的功能定位，都是Meta 的流量渠道。
target: Facebook, Instagram, <v>Whatsapp</v>, etc., no matter what functional positioning it is, are all traffic channels for Meta.

source: Facebook，Instagram，Whatsapp 等等，无论什么样的功能定位，都是Meta 的流量渠道。
target: Facebook, Instagram, Whatsapp, etc., no matter what functional positioning <v>it is</v>, are all traffic channels for Meta.

source: 不仅如此，Meta 还是最大的”广告联盟”,很多App 外接Meta 的广告，通过Meta 的广告平台是实现变现。
target: Not only that, Meta is also the biggest “advertising network”, and many <v>apps</v> are connected with Meta advertisements and realizing earnings through Meta's advertising platform.

source: 但是，时代变了。
target: However, times have changed.

source: 第一，因为苹果隐私政策的调整，Meta 很难再拿到用户的数据信息，影响了广告投放的效率。
target: First, due to adjustments of Apple's privacy policies, it has become difficult for Meta to obtain information about users, which affects the efficiency of advertising.

source: 苹果现在的隐私政策对用户很友好，会很明显的提示用户是否允许App 获取自己的信息，大多数人的正常反应肯定是不允许。
target: <v>Apples</v> current privacy policies are very user-friendly and will clearly prompt users whether to allow apps to access their own information. The normal response of most people is definitely to not allow it.

source: 苹果现在的隐私政策对用户很友好，会很明显的提示用户是否允许App 获取自己的信息，大多数人的正常反应肯定是不允许。
target: Apples current privacy policies are very user-friendly and will clearly prompt users whether to allow <v>apps</v> to access their own information. The normal response of most people is definitely to not allow it.

source: 接下来如果Google 再捅一刀，对Meta 的收入影响还会更大。
target: Next, if Google <v>revs up</v> again, the impact on Meta's revenue will be even greater.

source: 第二，以前Meta 的收入增长里的中国因素也弱化了（这个因素的比重不确定有多高，但确实存在）。
target: Second, the China factor in Meta's revenue growth has also weakened (the proportion of this factor is uncertain but it does exist).

source: 大家平时都知道Meta 在中国是没有业务的，但是这个理解并不准确。
target: Everyone <v>usually knows</v> that Meta does not have any business in China, but this understanding is not accurate.

source: 每年Meta 至少10%的收入都来自中国，主要是中国做出海业务的公司贡献的。
target: At least 10 percent of Meta's revenue comes from China every year, mainly contributed by companies in China doing overseas business.

source: Meta 在香港的办公室大概几百人，在大陆还有几大代理商。
target: Meta has roughly a few hundred people in its offices in Hong Kong and several major agencies in the mainland.

source: 中国公司想要拓展海外市场，Meta 都是绕不过的广告渠道，烧的钱大多都给了Meta。
target: Meta is an inescapable advertising channel for Chinese companies that want to expand to overseas markets, and most of the money they burn goes to Meta.

source: 有意思的是，现在字节的TT 是Meta 主要的竞争对手之一，但是前两年Meta 从字节身上可赚到不少钱。
target: Interestingly, <v>Byte-based TT</v> is now one of Meta's main competitors, but Meta made a lot of money from Byte in the past two years.

source: 有意思的是，现在字节的TT 是Meta 主要的竞争对手之一，但是前两年Meta 从字节身上可赚到不少钱。
target: Interestingly, Byte-based TT is now one of Meta's main competitors, but Meta made a lot of money from <v>Byte</v> in the past two years.

source: 国内各个代理都在帮字节去Meta 那里投广告，Meta 大中华区的业绩也很不错。
target: All domestic agencies are helping <v>Byte</v> to advertise on Meta, and Meta's performance in Greater China is also very good.

source: 最近我没有专门去了解，但是肯定不会比之前好。
target: I have not been specifically looking into this recently, but it's definitely not going to be any better than before.

source: 中国公司在海外大规模烧钱的阶段已经过去了。
target: The phase in which Chinese companies were burning cash overseas on a massive scale has ended.

source: 第三，新的流量渠道拓展不顺利。
target: Thirdly, the expansion of new traffic channels has not been smooth.

source: Facebook 越来越老了，新的包括TT 在内的平台，都不在Meta 手中。
target: Facebook is getting older and newer platforms, including <v>TT</v>, are not in Meta's hands.

source: 最大的问题不仅仅是收入下滑，而是缺乏增长预期。
target: The biggest problem is not just a decline in revenue but the lack of growth expectations.

source: 资本市场不仅仅看中收入，更重要的是看未来的预期怎么样。
target: The capital market not only cares about income, more importantly it looks at what the future is expected to <v>look like</v>.

source: 很显然，Meta 的预期是不够的。
target: It is clear that <v>Meta's expectations</v> were insufficient.

source: 为了给市场讲出新的故事，扎克伯格讲了“元宇宙”.
target: In an attempt to tell new stories to the market, Zuckerberg spoke about the "<v>metaverse</v>."

source: 元宇宙确实应该是未来的方向之一，但是元宇宙的实现周期比较长，这个故事在这两三年应该不足以支撑起Meta 的市值。
target: The <v>metaverse</v> should indeed be one of the directions in the future, but the implementation cycle of the metaverse is relatively long, and this story should not be enough to support the market value of Meta within these two years.

source: 元宇宙确实应该是未来的方向之一，但是元宇宙的实现周期比较长，这个故事在这两三年应该不足以支撑起Meta 的市值。
target: The metaverse should indeed be one of the directions in the future, but the implementation cycle of the <v>metaverse</v> is relatively long, and this story should not be enough to support the market value of Meta within these two years.

source: 所以未来这两年，应该是Meta 比较艰难的时期。
target: So in the next two years, it should be a relatively difficult period for Meta.

source: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局相关负责人表示，将从加强供需匹配、强化政策支持、拓宽就业渠道、确保困难帮扶、支持创新创业、提升服务效能等方面部署北京高校毕业生就业工作。
target: The relevant person in charge of the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau said that the employment of graduates of Beijing universities will be deployed from the aspects of strengthening supply and demand matching, strengthening policy support, broadening employment channels, ensuring <v>difficult</v> support, supporting innovation and entrepreneurship, and improving service efficiency.

source: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局相关负责人表示，将从加强供需匹配、强化政策支持、拓宽就业渠道、确保困难帮扶、支持创新创业、提升服务效能<v>等方面</v>部署北京高校毕业生就业工作。
target: The relevant person in charge of the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau said that the employment of graduates of Beijing universities will be deployed from the aspects of strengthening supply and demand matching, strengthening policy support, broadening employment channels, ensuring difficult support, supporting innovation and entrepreneurship, and improving service efficiency.

source: 记者了解到，北京市人力资源和社会保障局将搭建实践平台，加大岗位供给，主动联系40家高校毕业生职场体验基地，走访用人单位，整合需求信息和岗位信息；重点抓好“六个一批” ， 即拓宽事业单位招录一批，拓宽国有企业招聘一批，拓宽基层项目招募一批，拓宽应征入伍一批，拓宽就业见习留用一批，拓宽创业带动就业一批；实行“一生一策”动态管理，为每位毕业生推荐不少于5个岗位信息，确保有就业意愿的困难家庭毕业生100%实现帮扶等。
target: The reporter learned that the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau will build a practice platform, increase the supply of posts, take the initiative to contact 40 college graduate workplace experience bases, visit employers, and integrate demand information and job information; Focus on doing a good job of the "six batches", that is, broadening the recruitment of <v>a batch of public institutions</v>, expanding the recruitment of a batch of state-owned enterprises, broadening the recruitment of a batch of grass-roots projects, broadening the recruitment of a batch of conscripts, broadening the retention of a batch of employment apprentices, and broadening the number of entrepreneurship to promote employment; Implement the dynamic management of "one policy for a lifetime", recommend no less than 5 job information for each graduate, and ensure that 100% of graduates from difficult families who are willing to work can achieve assistance.

source: 2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人-新华网

source: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者阳娜）记者从近日北京市教委、北京市人力资源和社会保障局联合召开的2022届北京高校毕业生就业创业工作视频会议上获悉，2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人，比去年增加1.6万人。
target: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 11 (Reporter Yang Na) Reporters learned from the 2022 Beijing University <v>graduates employment and entrepreneurship video conference</v> jointly held by the Beijing Municipal Education Commission and the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security that there are expected to be 268,000 college graduates in Beijing in 2022, an increase of 16,000 over last year.

source: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局相关负责人表示，将从加强供需匹配、强化政策支持、拓宽就业渠道、确保困难帮扶、支持创新创业、提升服务效能<v>等方面</v>部署北京高校毕业生就业工作。
target: The relevant person in charge of the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security said that the employment work of graduates of Beijing universities will be deployed in terms of strengthening supply and demand matching, strengthening policy support, broadening employment channels, ensuring assistance for difficulties, supporting innovation and entrepreneurship, and improving service effectiveness.

source: 记者了解到，北京市人力资源和社会保障局将搭建实践平台，加大岗位供给，主动联系40家高校毕业生职场体验基地，走访用人单位，整合需求信息和岗位信息；重点抓好“六个一批” ， 即拓宽事业单位招录一批，拓宽国有企业招聘一批，拓宽基层项目招募一批，拓宽应征入伍一批，拓宽就业见习留用一批，拓宽创业带动就业一批；实行“一生一策”动态管理，为每位毕业生推荐不少于5个岗位信息，确保有就业意愿的困难家庭毕业生100%实现帮扶等。

source: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者阳娜）记者从近日北京市教委、北京市人力资源和社会保障局联合召开的2022届北京高校毕业生就业创业工作视频会议上获悉，2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人，比去年增加1.6万人。
target: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 11 (Reporter Yang Na) - The reporter learned from the 2022 Beijing University Graduates Employment and Entrepreneurship Video Conference jointly organized by the Beijing Municipal Education Commission and the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau recently that <v>268,000</v> university graduates in Beijing are expected to reach 268,000 in 2022, an increase of 16,000 over last year.

source: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局相关负责人表示，将从加强供需匹配、强化政策支持、拓宽就业渠道、确保困难帮扶、支持创新创业、提升服务效能等方面部署北京高校毕业生就业工作。
target: Relevant officials of the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau said that employment work for Beijing university graduates will be deployed in areas such as strengthening supply and demand matching, strengthening policy support, broadening employment channels, ensuring assistance in difficulties, supporting innovation and entrepreneurship, and improving service efficiency.

source: 兰州交通大学3名学生给校领导写信，反映对大学考试的困惑，并提出提高考试难度，变换考试题型，让考试真正体现学生实际水平的诉求。
target: Three students from Lanzhou Jiaotong University wrote to the school leaders to reflect the confusion about the university exam, and proposed to increase the difficulty of the exam and change the type of exam questions, so that the exam truly reflects the students' actual level.

source: 的确，长期以来，大学考试都是一个“热门话题” 。
target: Indeed, college exams have long been a "hot topic".

source: 在大学校园，学生来自五湖四海，能力水平各不相同，再加之学习程度不一，学习的情况千差万别。
target: On a university campus, students come from all over the world, <v>with different ability levels, combined with different levels of learning, with enormously different learning situations</v>.

source: <v>对于</v>具有如此多元特征的群体进行考核，存在不同感受，在所难免。
target: Assessment of groups with such diverse characteristics, it is inevitable that there will be different feelings.

source: 当然，如果考试试题题型单一、重复率高，题目过于简单，必然会造成另一种截然不同的感受。
target: Of course, if the exam questions are of a single type and a high repetition rate, and the questions are too simple, it will inevitably lead to another completely different feeling.

source: 不用功的学生，可能考前集中突击就能及格，如若再想其他办法，有可能达到事半功倍的效果。
target: Students who do not work <v>hardCOS</v> may pass the test. If they think of other ways, they may achieve twice the result with half the effort.

source: 不用功的学生，可能<v>考前集中突击</v>就能及格，如若再想其他办法，有可能达到事半功倍的效果。
target: Students who do not work hardCOS may pass the test. If they think of other ways, they may achieve twice the result with half the effort.

source: 在笔者看来，作为一种教学质量评估导向，衡量一所大学考试的合格与否，更在于教师对教与学的全面把握，以及在此基础上的科学命题。
target: In the author's view, as a teaching quality evaluation orientation, the qualification of a university examination depends on teachers' comprehensive grasp of teaching and learning, as well as scientific propositions based on this.

source: 进入大学本科阶段，专业开始细分，很多专业课程以基础知识为主。
target: Entering the undergraduate level, majors begin to be subdivided, and many professional courses are based on basic knowledge.

source: 毋庸置疑，是否全面掌握一个学科的基本知识点，是大学考试要考察的内容。
target: There is no doubt that <v>whether a comprehensive grasp of</v> the basic knowledge points of a subject is the content to be examined in the university examination.

source: 而本科知识基本都是学科基础理论和基本常识，从知识点而言，变化的空间并不大，基本是固定的。
target: However, undergraduate knowledge is basically the basic theory and basic common sense. <v>From a knowledge point of view</v>, there is not much room for change, and it is basically fixed.

source: 就像有教师所言， “ 20年前学大学数学的基本知识，现在还在学，还是重点。 ”
target: Just as some teachers said, "The basic knowledge of college mathematics 20 years ago is still being learnt, and it is still the key point."

source: 但知识点基本不变，并不代表考试题型单一、试题重复。
target: However, the knowledge points remain basically unchanged, which does not mean that the test questions are single and repeated.

source: 在很多大学，考试一般都会组成出题组，再由学科资深教师统筹组成试卷，考试阅卷也由承担该科的全体老师参与，这样就能在一定程度上克服试题重复的情况。
target: In many universities, <v>the examination is generally into question sets</v>, then senior teachers in the discipline make up the examination paper, and the examination papers are also attended by all the teachers who are responsible for the subject, so that the duplication of examination questions can be overcome to a certain extent.

source: 考试是大学教育的指挥棒，有什么样的考试，学生就会有相应的备考方案，长此以往，将影响大学教育的成效。
target: Exams are the baton of university education. What kind of exams are required, students will have corresponding preparation plans. In the long run, it will affect the effectiveness of university education.

source: 对于学生的建议信，兰州交大校方高度重视，已在全校部署了整改的方案。
target: Lanzhou Jiaotong University attaches great importance to the letter of advice from students and has deployed a rectification plan throughout the school.

source: 要求各教学单位组织教师开展研讨和课程结课考试对照自查，制定考试试卷命题及相关制度，同时加强对考试试卷命题及审核环节的监督与检查，细化成绩评定，加强课程教学各环节的全面考核。
target: All teaching units are required to organize teachers to conduct seminars and post-course examination <v>comparisons on self-checks</v>, formulate examination paper propositions and related systems, and at the same time strengthen the supervision and inspection of the examination paper propositions and review links, refine the performance assessment, and strengthen the comprehensive assessment of all aspects of course teaching.

source: 2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人-新华网
target: The number of college graduates in Beijing expected to reach 268,000 in 2022 <v>-</v> Xinhua English.news.cn

source: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者阳娜）记者从近日北京市教委、北京市人力资源和社会保障局联合召开的2022届北京高校毕业生就业创业工作视频会议上获悉，2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人，比去年增加1.6万人。
target: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, December 11 (Reporter Yang Na) The reporter learned from the recent video conference on the employment and entrepreneurship work of college graduates in 2022 jointly held by the Beijing Municipal Education Commission<v> and</v> the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau. The number of college graduates in Beijing in 2022 is expected to reach 268,000, an increase of 16,000 over last year.

source: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局相关负责人表示，将从加强供需匹配、强化政策支持、拓宽就业渠道、确保困难帮扶、支持创新创业、提升服务效能等方面部署北京高校毕业生就业工作。
target: The relevant person in charge of the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau said that the employment of Beijing college graduates would be deployed in terms of strengthening supply and demand matching, strengthening policy support, broadening employment channels, ensuring assistance <v>in difficulties</v>, supporting innovation and entrepreneurship, and improving service efficiency.

source: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局相关负责人表示，将从加强供需匹配、强化政策支持、拓宽就业渠道、确保困难帮扶、支持创新创业、提升服务效能<v>等</v>方面部署北京高校毕业生就业工作。
target: The relevant person in charge of the Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau said that the employment of Beijing college graduates would be deployed in terms of strengthening supply and demand matching, strengthening policy support, broadening employment channels, ensuring assistance in difficulties, supporting innovation and entrepreneurship, and improving service efficiency.

source: 记者了解到，北京市人力资源和社会保障局将搭建实践平台，加大岗位供给，主动联系40家高校毕业生职场体验基地，走访用人单位，整合需求信息和岗位信息；重点抓好“六个一批” ， 即拓宽事业单位招录一批，拓宽国有企业招聘一批，拓宽基层项目招募一批，拓宽应征入伍一批，拓宽就业见习留用一批，拓宽创业带动就业一批；实行“一生一策”动态管理，为每位毕业生推荐不少于5个岗位信息，确保有就业意愿的困难家庭毕业生100%实现帮扶等。
target: The reporter learned that Beijing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau will build a practical platform, increase job supply, actively contact 40 college graduates' workplace experience bases, visit employers, and integrate demand and job information; focus on "six batches", that is, expanding recruitment of <v>joining institutions</v>, expanding recruitment of state-owned enterprises, expanding recruiting groups for grassroots programs, expanding recruiting batches, expanding employment, internship retention, and expand employment and promoting employment; using the "one-life strategy" dynamic management, recommends no less than 500% job information for those graduates who have the will to seek employment and supports them.

source: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者阳娜）记者从近日北京市教委、北京市人力资源和社会保障局联合召开的2022届北京高校毕业生就业创业工作视频会议上获悉，2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人，比去年增加1.6万人。
target: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, Dec. 11 (<v>Xinhua</v>) -- The reporter learned from the recent video conference on employment and entrepreneurship of 2022 Beijing college graduates jointly held by Beijing Municipal Education Commission and Beijing Human Resources and Social Security Bureau that 268,000 college graduates are expected in Beijing in 2022, an increase of 16,000 compared with last year.

source: 记者了解到，北京市人力资源和社会保障局将搭建实践平台，加大岗位供给，主动联系40家高校毕业生职场体验基地，走访用人单位，整合需求信息和岗位信息；重点抓好“六个一批” ， 即拓宽事业单位招录一批，拓宽国有企业招聘一批，拓宽基层项目招募一批，拓宽应征入伍一批，拓宽就业见习留用一批，拓宽创业带动就业一批；实行“一生一策”动态管理，为每位毕业生推荐不少于5个岗位信息，确保有就业意愿的困难家庭毕业生100%实现帮扶等。
target: The reporter learned that the <v>Beijing Human Resources and Social Security Bureau</v> will build a practice platform, increase the supply of jobs, take the initiative to contact 40 workplace experience bases for college graduates, visit employers and integrate demand and job information; focus on "six batches", i.e., broaden the recruitment of institutions, broaden the recruitment of state-owned enterprises, broaden the recruitment of grassroots projects, broaden the recruitment of state-owned enterprises, and broaden the recruitment of graduates. The company focuses on "six batches", i.e. a batch of recruitment for institutions, a batch of recruitment for state-owned enterprises, a batch of recruitment for grassroots projects, a batch of enlistment in the military, a batch of employment internship, a batch of employment driven by entrepreneurship; the implementation of "one policy for a lifetime" dynamic management, recommending no less than five jobs for each graduate, ensuring that 100% of graduates from difficult families with employment intentions are supported.

source: 郑州宜欣是国内混凝土检查井模块砖机设备，检查井砌块机械，井壁墙体模块机械专业的生产厂家，从半自动到全自动化生产线。

source: 宜欣检查井砌块砖机设备广泛适用于煤、热、水、电、气等市政地下构筑物的新型砌筑材料。
target: Yixin inspection well block brick machine equipment is widely used in new masonry materials for municipal underground structures such as coal, heat, water, electricity<v> and</v> gas.

source: 如：排水、储水设施的各类检查井、雨水口、方沟、化粪池及小型构筑物、桥梁翼墙等。

source: 如：排水、储水设施的各类检查井、雨水口、方沟、化粪池及小型构筑物、桥梁翼墙等。
target: Such as: various inspection wells of drainage and water storage facilities, rainwater inlets, square ditches, septic tanks<v> and</v> small structures, bridge wing walls, etc.

source: 使用混凝土模块筑建检查井的优势在于模块的上下左右四周均为凹凸槽结构，组合砌筑形成链锁。
target: The advantage of using concrete modules to build inspection wells is that the upper, lower, left, and right sides of the modules are concave-convex groove structures, and the combined masonry forms a chain lock.

source: 井壁墙体抗剪力远优于平摩擦砌体的砌筑形式。
target: The shear resistance of the shaft wall is much better than that of the flat friction masonry.

source: 模块为中空结构，组合砌筑后纵向孔孔相通，横向孔孔相贯，孔芯浇注后，形成现浇混凝土网状结构，起到了二次补强和防水作用。
target: The module is a hollow structure. After combined masonry, the longitudinal holes are connected, and the horizontal holes are connected. After the hole core is <v>poured,</v> a cast-in-place concrete network structure is formed, which plays a secondary reinforcement and waterproofing role.

source: 模块为中空结构，组合砌筑后纵向孔孔相通，横向孔孔相贯，孔芯浇注后，形成现浇混凝土网状结构，起到了二次补强和防水作用。
target: The module is a hollow structure. After combined masonry, the longitudinal holes are connected, and the horizontal holes are connected. After the hole core is poured, a cast-in-place concrete network structure is formed, <v>which plays a secondary reinforcement and waterproofing role</v>.

source: 模块纵横均设有插筋槽，横向卧筋、纵向插筋相应提高结构整体强度。
target: The modules are provided with grooves for inserting bars vertically and horizontally, and the horizontal and vertical reinforcing bars increase the overall strength of the structure accordingly.

source: 另外使用混凝土检查井模块砌筑出来的检查井、排水井不容易出现坍塌，下沉，漏水等现象，井壁墙体模块机械性能稳定，操作简单，成形尺寸标准。
target: In addition, the inspection wells and drainage wells built with concrete inspection well modules are not prone to collapse, <v>subsidence, water leakage</v>, etc. The well wall module has stable mechanical properties, simple operation, and standard forming dimensions.

target: Xinhua News Agency Beijing<v> </v>December 11th (Reporter Yang Na) Reporter learned from the 2022 Beijing University and College Graduates' Employment and Entrepreneurship Video Conference jointly held by the Beijing Municipal Education Commission and the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security that the number of university and college graduates in Beijing is expected to reach 268,000 in 2022, increased by 16,000 compared with last year.

source: 新华社北京12月11日电（记者阳娜）记者从近日北京市教委、北京市人力资源和社会保障局联合召开的2022届北京高校毕业生就业创业工作视频会议上获悉，2022年北京地区高校毕业生预计达26.8万人，比去年增加1.6万人。
target: Xinhua News Agency Beijing December 11th (Reporter Yang Na) Reporter learned from the 2022 Beijing University and College Graduates' Employment and Entrepreneurship Video Conference jointly held by the Beijing Municipal Education Commission and the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security that the number of university and college graduates in Beijing is expected to reach 268,000 in 2022, increased by 16,000 compared with last year.

source: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局相关负责人表示，将从加强供需匹配、强化政策支持、拓宽就业渠道、确保困难帮扶、支持创新创业、提升服务效能<v>等方面</v>部署北京高校毕业生就业工作。
target: Responsible person from Beijing Municipal Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security introduced that the employment of university and college graduates in Beijing will be deployed from the aspects of strengthening the matching of supply and demand, strengthening policy support, broadening employment channels, ensuring to provide assistance for those with difficulties, supporting innovation and entrepreneurship, and improving service efficiency.

target: Reporter learned that Beijing Municipal Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security will establish a platform to increase work position supply, take the initiative to contact 40 job experience bases for college graduates, visit employing unit, and integrate demand information and job information; focus on the "six batches", that is, expand the batch of recruitment of <v>institutions</v>, expand the batch of recruitment of state-owned enterprises, expand the batch of recruitment of grass-roots projects, expand the batch of recruitment of military recruits, expand the batch of employment probation retention, and expand the batch of entrepreneurship to promote employment; implement the dynamic management of "one policy for one student", recommend no less than 5 jobs for each graduate, and ensure that 100% of graduates from poor families with the willingness to work will be assisted.

source: 北京市人力资源和社会保障局相关负责人表示，将从加强供需匹配、强化政策支持、拓宽就业渠道、确保困难帮扶、支持创新创业、提升服务效能等方面部署北京高校毕业生就业工作。

target: The reporter learned that the Beijing Municipal Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security will build a practical platform, increase job supply, actively contact 40 college graduates' workplace experience bases, visit employers, and integrate demand information and job information; Focus on "six batches", that is, broaden the recruitment of public institutions, broaden the recruitment of state-owned enterprises, broaden the recruitment of grassroots projects, broaden the recruitment of enlistments, broaden the employment probation retention, and broaden the entrepreneurship to drive employment; Implement the dynamic management of "one policy <v>in one life</v>", recommend no less than 5 job information for each graduate, and ensure that 100% of graduates from difficult families who have the willingness to work can help.
